zh-tw.editorNote: 衝刺期把目標從「考高分」降級成「活著走出考場」的考生 OS，傳班群秒引發接龍。
variations: 可以加：「我的目標不是上榜，是平安回家。」
也能改：「計畫、恐慌、求生，這三步我每次都很穩，穩穩地原地踏步。」

en.content:
My exam prep has exactly three steps:
make a plan, full panic, survive.
Passing is a bonus — staying alive already counts as a win.
As for that beautiful study schedule,
it died somewhere around step two.
en.editorNote: For when your goal downgrades from 'ace it' to 'walk out breathing' — instant group-chat relate.
variations: Add: "My goal isn't to pass. It's to make it home."
Try: "Plan, panic, survive — I nail all three every time. Nailing them in place, going nowhere."

items.sourceNote: summer studying while everyone else relaxes register — 全世界放暑假只有我在讀 frame

zh-tw.content:
全世界都在放暑假，
限動裡都是海邊、冷氣、手搖跟笑容。
只有我，在七月最熱的時候，
抱著一本參考書，
替全班守著最後一個還沒下課的教室。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科考生七月還在衝刺、看著同學玩瘋的孤單限動，配張只有自己亮燈的書桌照超有畫面。
variations: 可以加：「別人的暑假是放假，我的暑假是加映場。」
也能改：「我不是不想去海邊，是我先去考場替大家探路。」

en.content:
The whole world is on summer break.
Everyone's story is beaches, AC, bubble tea, and smiles.
Just me, in the hottest week of July,
clutching a review book,
holding down the last classroom that never got to dismiss.
en.editorNote: For the July subject-exam grinder watching everyone else's vacation — pair with a lone-desk-lamp photo for full loneliness.
variations: Add: "Everyone else's summer is a break. Mine is an extra screening."
Try: "It's not that I don't want the beach. I'm just scouting the exam hall for everyone first."

items.sourceNote: 115 分科測驗 7/11-12 倒數一個月 register — 暑假變第三學期 frame

zh-tw.content:
別人的暑假從放榜開始，
我的暑假從分科測驗結束才開始。
所以嚴格來說，
我這個暑假只有兩個月，
而學校偷偷把第三學期塞了進來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科考生七月還在備戰、看著同學早早放假的限動神句，配張月曆被紅筆圈住 7/11 的照片更有畫面。
variations: 可以加：「我的暑假是有附帶條件的，條件叫做分科測驗。」
也能改：「同學在倒數放假，我在倒數開考，明明是同一個七月。」

en.content:
Everyone else's summer starts on results day.
Mine doesn't start until after the subject exam.
So technically my summer is only two months long,
and the school quietly slipped in a third semester.
en.editorNote: For the July subject-exam grinder watching classmates clock out early — pair with a calendar photo of the exam date circled in red.
variations: Add: "My summer comes with terms and conditions. The condition is the subject exam."
Try: "They're counting down to vacation. I'm counting down to an exam. Same July."

items.sourceNote: procrastination is my cardio register — 拖延運動化 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
醫生問我有沒有運動習慣。
我說有，我每天都在拖延。
從打開課本到真正讀進去那段心理拉扯，
消耗的熱量絕對不輸跑步機。
zh-tw.editorNote: 幫自己的拖延找藉口時的萬用句，配張攤在沙發上手裡還抓著課本的廢照剛剛好。
variations: 可以加：「我不是懶，我是把運動量都花在猶豫要不要讀書上。」
也能改：「拖延是我唯一持之以恆的有氧運動。」

en.content:
My doctor asked if I exercise.
I said yes — I procrastinate daily.
The mental tug-of-war between opening the book and actually reading it
burns more calories than a treadmill.
en.editorNote: The all-purpose excuse for your own procrastination — pair with a couch-slumped photo, textbook still in hand.
variations: Add: "I'm not lazy. I spend all my energy deciding whether to study."
Try: "Procrastinating is the only cardio I've ever stayed consistent with."

items.sourceNote: 2 AM download knowledge register — 凌晨下載知識 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
凌晨兩點，
我試圖把兩個月的進度，
一次下載進這顆只有 8GB 的腦袋。
結果跳出的不是「下載完成」，
是「儲存空間不足，是否刪除睡眠？」
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前一夜瘋狂塞知識的限動文案，配張凌晨書桌只剩檯燈亮著的照片超寫實。
variations: 可以加：「我選了刪除睡眠，結果連原本記得的也一起被清掉了。」
也能改：「腦袋容量沒升級，我的野心倒是每年都在更新。」

en.content:
2 AM,
I'm trying to download two months of material
into this brain that ships with only 8GB.
Instead of "download complete" it popped up:
"Storage full — delete sleep to continue?"
en.editorNote: For the night-before cram spiral — pair with a 2am desk photo lit by a single lamp.
variations: Add: "I chose to delete sleep. It also wiped the stuff I already remembered."
Try: "My brain never got a storage upgrade. My ambition updates every year."

items.sourceNote: study group 20/30/50 register — 讀書會分工真相 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我們開了一個讀書會。
二成的時間在讀書，
三成在互相解釋誰也不會的題目，
剩下五成在一起懷疑當初為什麼選這個科系。
所以讀書會最大的收穫，是確認了我們一起爛。
zh-tw.editorNote: 揪讀書會結果變聊天會的考生 OS，傳到群組保證有人回「這就是我們」。
variations: 可以加：「讀書會唯一複習成功的，是去年的八卦。」
也能改：「我們不是來讀書的，是來確認彼此都沒讀。」

en.content:
We started a study group.
20% of the time we study,
30% we explain questions none of us understand,
and 50% we sit there questioning why we picked this major.
The real takeaway from study group: confirming we're all equally doomed.
en.editorNote: For the study group that became a chat group — post it and watch someone reply "this is literally us."
variations: Add: "The only thing our study group successfully reviewed was last year's gossip."
Try: "We're not here to study. We're here to confirm none of us did."

items.sourceNote: exams don't scare me my procrastination does register — 真正的恐懼來源 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
考試本身不可怕。
真正讓我半夜驚醒的，
是那個明明知道要讀、
卻一路滑手機滑到考前一晚的自己。
敵人從來不是考卷，是鏡子裡那位。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前自我覺察又救不了自己的限動文案，配張深夜手機螢幕亮著的自拍剛剛好。
variations: 可以加：「考卷我還有機會猜，我自己的拖延我連猜都不敢猜。」
也能改：「會讓我考砸的不是難題，是那個說『等一下再讀』的我。」

en.content:
The exam itself isn't what scares me.
What jolts me awake at night
is the version of me who knew I had to study
and scrolled my phone right up to the night before.
The enemy was never the test paper — it's the one in the mirror.
en.editorNote: For the pre-exam self-awareness that still can't save you — pair with a late-night selfie lit by a phone screen.
variations: Add: "I can at least guess on the test. My own procrastination I can't even predict."
Try: "It's not the hard questions that'll sink me. It's the me who said 'I'll study in a bit.'"

items.sourceNote: 115 分科測驗 7/11-12 倒數一個月 register — 八科自由選考 frame

zh-tw.content:
分科測驗最自由的地方，是科目可以自己選。
最不自由的地方，是不管選哪科，
打開講義那一刻，我都一樣不會。
所以我選的不是科目，是要被哪一科電。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科前一個月選考糾結的考生 OS，傳到班群保證有人回「選擇你想死的方式」。
variations: 可以加：「自由選考的意思是：自由地選一個會讓你後悔的未來。」
也能改：「我以為選考是權利，後來發現它是判決。」

en.content:
The free part about this exam is you get to pick your subjects.
The un-free part is that no matter which I pick,
the second I open the textbook I'm equally lost.
So I'm not choosing a subject — I'm choosing which one gets to wreck me.
en.editorNote: For the agony of picking electives a month before the exam — post it and someone replies "choose your fighter."
variations: Add: "Free choice of subjects just means freely choosing a future you'll regret."
Try: "I thought picking subjects was a right. Turns out it's a sentence."

items.sourceNote: 115 分科測驗 不考國英 register — 學測成績沿用 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
分科不考國文英文，
因為這兩科直接沿用學測成績。
意思是：那兩科我考爛的後果，
會像影子一樣一路跟到分科。
原來有些錯，是會分期付款追著你跑的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 學測國英失常又要拚分科的考生 OS，傳到重考群會引起一排「+1」。
variations: 可以加：「我以為學測結束了，結果它只是換了個方式繼續折磨我。」
也能改：「分科不考國英，但國英會用成績單默默地補刀。」

en.content:
This exam doesn't test Chinese or English —
those scores just carry over from the earlier exam.
Meaning: the way I bombed those two
follows me here like a shadow.
Turns out some mistakes come with an installment plan that chases you down.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose earlier-exam scores haunt the next round — drop it in the resit chat for a chorus of "same."
variations: Add: "I thought that exam was over. It just changed costume and kept tormenting me."
Try: "The scores don't reset. They just follow you to the next building."

items.sourceNote: my brain is 90% song lyrics 10% exam knowledge register — 記憶分配 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我的腦容量分配是這樣的：
九成裝廣告歌跟迷因，
一成裝考試會用到的東西。
而且偏偏考前那一晚，
還是那九成在我腦袋裡開演唱會。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前明明要背書腦袋卻自動播放神曲的考生 OS，配個耳機放在課本上的照片剛剛好。
variations: 可以加：「我記得每一句洗腦廣告詞，就是記不得課本第三章。」
也能改：「我的記憶體很大，只是全被沒用的東西先佔走了。」

en.content:
Here's how my memory is allocated:
90% jingles and memes,
10% things that actually show up on the exam.
And of course, the night before the test,
it's the 90% throwing a concert in my head.
en.editorNote: For when your brain auto-plays a catchy ad instead of chapter three — pair with a photo of earbuds resting on a textbook.
variations: Add: "I remember every line of that annoying jingle. Chapter three, not so much."
Try: "My memory has tons of storage. It's just all taken up by useless stuff first."

items.sourceNote: time to forget everything in 3 2 1 register — 考完瞬間清空 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
考完最後一科那一刻，
我大腦啟動了自動清除程式。
三、二、一——清空完畢。
剛剛那些公式去哪了我不知道，
我只知道我現在連自己背過它們都不記得。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完走出考場腦袋瞬間格式化的考生 OS，配張交完卷比讚的自拍很搭。
variations: 可以加：「我不是學完就忘，我是交卷的同時連同記憶一起繳回去了。」
也能改：「考完三秒，我的腦袋已經回到出廠設定。」

en.content:
The moment I handed in the last paper,
my brain ran its auto-wipe.
Three, two, one — cleared.
Where those formulas went I have no idea.
I don't even remember that I once memorized them.
en.editorNote: For the post-exam brain format — pair with a thumbs-up selfie taken right after handing in the paper.
variations: Add: "I don't forget after learning. I turn in the memory along with the paper."
Try: "Three seconds after the exam, my brain was back to factory settings."

items.sourceNote: GPA and my mood have a complicated relationship register — 成績與心情連動 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我的心情跟我的成績，是一段很複雜的關係。
它好，我就好；它不好，我整個人就跟著沉。
問題是它從來沒問過我願不願意，
就擅自決定了我今天能不能笑得出來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 放榜當天心情被分數綁架的考生 OS，傳到班群會有人回「成績單就是我的情緒開關」。
variations: 可以加：「我不是情緒化，我只是把心情的主控權外包給了成績單。」
也能改：「成績一出，我的快樂就被設成了唯讀。」

en.content:
My mood and my grades have a very complicated relationship.
When it's good, I'm good; when it's bad, I sink right along with it.
The problem is it never asks for my consent —
it just decides whether I get to smile today.
en.editorNote: For results day when a number hijacks your whole vibe — post it and someone replies "my report card is my mood switch."
variations: Add: "I'm not moody. I just outsourced control of my feelings to a grade report."
Try: "The grades dropped and my happiness got set to read-only."

items.sourceNote: 115 分科測驗 7/11-12 倒數約一個月 register — 暑假被沒收 frame

zh-tw.content:
別人的暑假從七月開始。
我的暑假從七月十三號開始。
中間那兩天叫做分科測驗，
是這個世界跟我收的「進場費」。
繳完才准放假，逾期不候。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科前一個月看著別人放暑假自己還在拚的考生 OS，傳到班群會引起一排「同病相憐」愛心。
variations: 可以加：「我的暑假不是延後，是要先通關才解鎖。」
也能改：「七月十三號之前，我沒有暑假，只有考程。」

en.content:
Everyone else's summer starts in July.
Mine starts on July 13th.
The two days before that are the exam —
the entry fee this world charges me
before I'm allowed to rest. No refunds, no extensions.
en.editorNote: For watching everyone else's vacation start while you're still grinding — drop it in the group chat for a wave of "same" hearts.
variations: Add: "My summer isn't delayed. It's locked behind a boss fight."
Try: "Before the 13th, I don't have a summer. I have a test schedule."

items.sourceNote: panic now cry later somehow pass register — 三步驟讀書法 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我的讀書三步驟很穩定：
先慌、再哭、最後莫名其妙低空飛過。
這套流程我已經跑了三年，
從來沒準備好過，
但也從來沒真的死過，神奇。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前明明沒讀完卻又每次低空通關的考生 OS，配個攤在書堆上的自拍剛剛好。
variations: 可以加：「我不是有實力，我是有運氣加上一點不要臉。」
也能改：「慌、哭、過——這三個字就是我的考試攻略全文。」

en.content:
My three-step study method is very reliable:
panic first, cry next, then somehow scrape a pass.
I've run this routine for three years straight.
Never once been ready,
yet never actually died. Honestly impressive.
en.editorNote: For the chronic last-minute survivor who keeps clearing the bar somehow — pair with a selfie collapsed on a pile of books.
variations: Add: "It's not skill. It's luck plus a little shamelessness."
Try: "Panic, cry, pass — that's my entire exam strategy in three words."

items.sourceNote: local student discovers textbook exists register — 課本陌生人 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
考前三天，我翻開課本，
它跟我對看了三秒。
那一刻我們都很尷尬——
它不認識我，我也不認識它。
原來整個學期，我們只是同班同學，不是朋友。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前才第一次認真翻課本的考生 OS，配張全新到反光的課本照超有畫面。
variations: 可以加：「我跟課本的關係，止步於『點頭之交』。」
也能改：「課本：好久不見。我：我們見過嗎？」

en.content:
Three days before the exam I opened the textbook.
We stared at each other for three seconds.
It was awkward for both of us —
it didn't recognize me, and I didn't recognize it.
Turns out all semester we were just classmates, never friends.
en.editorNote: For cracking the book open for the first time right before the test — pair with a photo of a textbook so pristine it still shines.
variations: Add: "Me and my textbook? Strictly a nodding acquaintance."
Try: "Textbook: long time no see. Me: have we met?"

items.sourceNote: I came I saw I panicked register — 凱撒名言惡搞 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
凱撒說：「我來，我見，我征服。」
我說：「我來，我看，我傻眼。」
進考場、翻考卷、瞬間失去語言能力，
三步驟一氣呵成，比羅馬帝國垮得還快。
zh-tw.editorNote: 拿到考卷瞬間腦袋空白的考生 OS，配張一臉死寂的考場自拍很搭。
variations: 可以加：「征服世界很難，征服這張考卷我連邊都沒摸到。」
也能改：「我來，我看，我交白卷。」

en.content:
Caesar said: "I came, I saw, I conquered."
I say: "I came, I saw, I blanked."
Walk in, flip the paper, instantly lose the ability to speak —
three steps, seamless, falling faster than the Roman Empire.
en.editorNote: For the mind-goes-blank moment of opening the paper — pair with a dead-eyed exam-hall selfie.
variations: Add: "Conquering the world is hard. I didn't even get near conquering this test."
Try: "I came, I saw, I left it blank."

items.sourceNote: 分科測驗 7/11-12 倒數一個月 register — 暑假被綁架 frame

zh-tw.content:
別人的暑假從六月放到開學，
我的暑假被分科測驗綁在七月中。
所以我現在不是在放暑假，
是在替七月那兩天，先繳一個月的焦慮當訂金。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科測驗倒數一個月、看著別人放暑假的考生 OS，配張開著冷氣讀書的桌面照超有共鳴。
variations: 可以加：「我的暑假是分期付款，七月考完才一次入帳。」
也能改：「七月十一號之前，我沒有暑假，只有倒數。」

en.content:
Everyone else's summer runs from June to the new term.
Mine is hostage to a test in mid-July.
So I'm not on vacation right now —
I'm paying a month of anxiety up front as a deposit on those two days.
en.editorNote: For watching everyone's summer start while you grind toward a July test — pair with a photo of your desk under the AC.
variations: Add: "My summer is on an installment plan. It only pays out once the test is over."
Try: "Before July 11th, I don't have a summer. I have a countdown."

items.sourceNote: brain 90% song lyrics 10% knowledge register — 腦容量分配 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我的腦袋容量分配是這樣的：
九成是歌詞跟迷因，一成是考試範圍。
難怪我背不起公式——
那一成的空間，早就被昨天循環的副歌占滿了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 讀不進書、腦袋卻記得整首歌的考生 OS，配個邊讀書邊戴耳機的自拍剛剛好。
variations: 可以加：「課文記不住，但廣告台詞我能一字不漏。」
也能改：「我的記憶體很滿，只是裝的都不是考試會考的東西。」

en.content:
Here's how my brain allocates storage:
ninety percent song lyrics and memes, ten percent exam material.
No wonder the formulas won't stick —
that ten percent got claimed by the chorus I had on loop yesterday.
en.editorNote: For the brain that won't hold a formula but knows every word of a song — pair with a headphones-on study selfie.
variations: Add: "Can't recall the textbook, but I've got the ad jingle memorized word for word."
Try: "My memory's full. Just not with anything that's on the test."

items.sourceNote: energy-saving mode until exams over register — 省電模式 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我不是懶，
我是開了省電模式，
要等考試結束才會恢復滿速運轉。
問題是這個模式我從學期初就開著，
而那顆「考完再說」的按鈕，按到現在還沒亮。
zh-tw.editorNote: 整學期都在「考完再說」的考生自我平反，配張攤在沙發上的廢人自拍超精準。
variations: 可以加：「省電模式的副作用是：連讀書的力氣也一起省掉了。」
也能改：「我沒有關機，我只是把效能調到剛好能呼吸。」

en.content:
I'm not lazy.
I'm in energy-saving mode,
full speed won't resume until exams are over.
Problem is I switched it on at the start of the semester,
and the "deal with it after the test" button still hasn't lit up.
en.editorNote: Self-defense for anyone who's been on 'after the exam' mode all term — pair with a collapsed-on-the-couch selfie.
variations: Add: "Side effect of energy-saving mode: it also saved up the energy I needed to study."
Try: "I'm not shut down. I just dialed performance to barely-breathing."

items.sourceNote: A+xiety wordplay register — 焦慮雙關 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我想要的是 A＋，
拿到的是 A 開頭的焦慮（anxiety）。
原來這兩個從頭到尾共用同一個開頭，
而我這幾年努力的，好像一直是後面那個。
zh-tw.editorNote: 想拿高分結果只收穫焦慮的考生 OS，配張盯著成績欄發呆的迷因效果最強。
variations: 可以加：「我的成績單上沒有 A＋，但我的精神狀態全是 A 開頭的字。」
也能改：「想要 A＋，得到 anxiety，這大概就是考試最誠實的兌換率。」

en.content:
What I wanted was an A+.
What I got was A-xiety.
Turns out they share the exact same opening letter,
and the thing I've actually been earning all these years is the second one.
en.editorNote: For chasing top marks and collecting stress instead — pair with a meme of someone staring blankly at a grade column.
variations: Add: "No A+ on my report card, but my mental state is all A-words."
Try: "Want an A+, get anxiety — honestly the most honest exchange rate exams offer."

items.sourceNote: finals = how clean your room can get register — 整理逃避 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
考試真正測驗的，
是你的房間能被整理到多乾淨。
我這禮拜把抽屜分了類、衣櫃換了季、書桌擦到反光，
唯一沒碰的，是那本明天要考的課本。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前突然有強烈打掃慾的考生 OS，配張亮晶晶但課本沒翻的書桌照超寫實。
variations: 可以加：「我的房間從沒這麼整齊過，因為我的腦袋從沒這麼想逃過。」
也能改：「不是我愛乾淨，是課本太可怕，連灰塵都比它好相處。」

en.content:
What exams really test
is how spotless your room can get.
This week I sorted every drawer, swapped my whole closet, polished my desk till it shines —
the only thing I didn't touch is the textbook I'm tested on tomorrow.
en.editorNote: For the sudden urge to deep-clean before a final — pair with a sparkling desk and an unopened book.
variations: Add: "My room has never been this clean, because my brain has never wanted to flee this badly."
Try: "I'm not tidy. The textbook is just scarier than dust."

items.sourceNote: coffee vs sleep tradeoff register — 用睡眠換清醒 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
咖啡是給那些明天要考有機化學、又不能睡的人喝的。
我喝了三杯，換來一整晚的清醒，
然後在考卷上，把這份清醒全部還了回去。
等價交換，一滴都沒賺到。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前靠咖啡硬撐、考場卻當機的考生自我吐槽，配張排成一列的空咖啡杯照剛剛好。
variations: 可以加：「咖啡因不會讓我變聰明，只會讓我清醒地看著自己不會寫。」
也能改：「我用睡眠換清醒，考場用清醒換我崩潰，這條供應鏈非常順暢。」

en.content:
Coffee is for people who can't sleep because organic chem is tomorrow morning.
I drank three cups, traded them for a whole night awake,
then handed all that alertness right back on the answer sheet.
A fair exchange — didn't profit a single drop.
en.editorNote: For surviving on caffeine the night before and blanking anyway — pair with a row of empty cups.
variations: Add: "Caffeine doesn't make me smarter. It just keeps me awake to watch myself not know the answer."
Try: "I traded sleep for alertness, the exam traded alertness for my breakdown — very smooth supply chain."

items.sourceNote: 100% sure I studied just forgot where register — 讀過但忘了放哪 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我百分之百確定我讀過這個，
我只是想不起來我把它讀到哪去了。
知識在我腦袋裡，就像收進一個我自己也找不到密碼的雲端，
檔案都在，就是打不開。
zh-tw.editorNote: 明明複習過、考場卻一片空白的考生內心戲，傳到班群會收到整排「+1」。
variations: 可以加：「不是我沒讀，是我的腦袋把它存成了唯讀檔，還忘了給我權限。」
也能改：「我記得我懂過，這份記得本身，就是我考場上唯一的答案。」

en.content:
I'm 100% sure I studied this.
I just can't remember where I filed it.
Knowledge sits in my head like a cloud drive I locked myself out of —
the files are all there, they just won't open.
en.editorNote: For reviewing everything and blanking anyway — drop it in the group chat for a chorus of '+1'.
variations: Add: "I did study. My brain just saved it as read-only and forgot to give me access."
Try: "I remember understanding it once. That memory was my only answer in the exam."

items.sourceNote: brain 90% song lyrics 10% knowledge register — 腦容量分配 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我的腦袋有百分之九十存的是歌詞，
剩下百分之十才是考試範圍。
所以考卷上我什麼都想不起來，
但隔壁班播一首歌，我能跟著唱完整首副歌。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前發現腦袋裝錯東西的考生 OS，配張戴耳機唸書、書卻沒翻的迷因效果最強。
variations: 可以加：「老師問我課文背得怎樣，我只能回他：『要不要聽我唱歌？』」
也能改：「考試考的是課本，我會的全在 KTV 點歌單裡。」

en.content:
Ninety percent of my brain is song lyrics.
The remaining ten percent is the exam scope.
So on the paper I can't recall a thing,
but play one song next door and I'll nail the entire chorus.
en.editorNote: For realizing your brain stored the wrong files before an exam — pair with a headphones-on, book-unopened meme.
variations: Add: "Teacher asked how my recitation was going. All I could say was: 'Wanna hear me sing instead?'"
Try: "The exam tests the textbook. Everything I know lives in my karaoke queue."

items.sourceNote: study break longer than study session register — 休息比讀書久 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我讀十五分鐘，休息四十五分鐘。
嚴格說起來，這不是讀書配休息，
是休息中間穿插了一點讀書。
我的進度條跑得比我的休息時間慢多了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 讀沒幾分鐘就想滑手機的考生自我吐槽，配張書攤開但人躺平的限動超寫實。
variations: 可以加：「我把番茄鐘設成『讀五分鐘、躺一小時』，效率高到自己都怕。」
也能改：「我不是在讀書中間休息，是在休息中間不小心讀到書。」

en.content:
I study for fifteen minutes and rest for forty-five.
Technically that's not studying with breaks —
it's resting with the occasional study sprinkled in.
My progress bar moves way slower than my break timer.
en.editorNote: For the kind of cram session where the breaks outlast the studying — pair with an open book and a flopped-over selfie.
variations: Add: "I set my Pomodoro to 'study five minutes, lie down one hour.' Terrifyingly efficient."
Try: "I'm not taking breaks between studying. I'm accidentally studying between breaks."

items.sourceNote: 分科歷屆越寫越慌 register — 寫越多越沒信心 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
歷屆試題越寫越慌。
寫第一回我覺得自己還有救，
寫到第五回我開始懷疑這幾年到底在學校做了什麼。
原來考古題的功能不是複習，是讓我提前認清現實。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科測驗前狂寫考古題、越寫越沒信心的考生 OS，配張寫滿紅筆叉叉的考卷照超有感。
variations: 可以加：「考古題教會我的不是知識，是接受失敗的能力。」
也能改：「我不是越寫越強，是越寫越清楚自己有多弱。」

en.content:
The more past papers I do, the more I panic.
After the first one I thought there was hope.
By the fifth I started questioning what I'd been doing in school all these years.
Turns out past papers aren't for review — they're for facing reality early.
en.editorNote: For grinding past exams before a big test and losing confidence with each one — pair with a paper covered in red X's.
variations: Add: "Past papers didn't teach me knowledge. They taught me how to accept defeat."
Try: "I'm not getting stronger with each one. I'm just getting clearer on how weak I am."

items.sourceNote: when in doubt C in doubt register — 不會就選 C frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
不會的時候就選 C。
這是我從國小用到現在的策略，
命中率穩定維持在四分之一。
與其說是答題，不如說是我跟出題老師之間的一場擲筊。
zh-tw.editorNote: 選擇題全靠直覺猜的考生自嘲，配張答案卡塗成一直線的迷因效果最強。
variations: 可以加：「我的答案卡看起來不像在考試，像在畫抽象藝術。」
也能改：「三長一短選最短，四個都長我選 C，這就是我的全部準備。」

en.content:
When in doubt, pick C.
I've used this strategy since elementary school,
with a hit rate steadily holding at one in four.
It's less answering questions and more a coin flip between me and the test setter.
en.editorNote: For the student whose multiple-choice plan is pure vibes — pair with an answer sheet bubbled into a straight line.
variations: Add: "My answer sheet doesn't look like an exam. It looks like abstract art."
Try: "Three long one short, pick the short. All four long, pick C. That's my entire prep."

items.sourceNote: not drunk just finals week register — 期末憔悴 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我沒喝醉，我只是在期末週。
走路會撞牆、講話會跳針、看人會對焦三秒，
這些都不是酒精的功勞，
是連續熬夜加上對人生的全面放棄。
zh-tw.editorNote: 期末週把人榨乾、整個人恍神的考生 OS，配張黑眼圈深到不行的自拍剛剛好。
variations: 可以加：「我這個狀態不需要喝酒，期末週已經幫我搞定了。」
也能改：「別人喝醉是放鬆，我這樣是期末週的標準配備。」

en.content:
I'm not drunk, I'm just in finals week.
Walking into walls, talking in loops, taking three seconds to focus on a face —
none of it is alcohol.
It's back-to-back all-nighters plus a total surrender to life.
en.editorNote: For looking absolutely wrecked during finals — pair with a selfie sporting the deepest possible eye bags.
variations: Add: "I don't need a drink to look like this. Finals week handled it."
Try: "For other people being drunk is relaxing. For me this is just standard finals issue."

items.sourceNote: brain 90% song lyrics register — 大腦記憶體配置 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我的大腦記憶體：
九成是歌詞，一成是考試範圍。
所以考前我能完整唱完三張專輯，
卻背不起來一條公式。
看來我的腦袋從一開始就選錯了主修。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前發現自己只記得起歌詞的考生 OS，配張戴耳機翻課本的限動超有畫面。
variations: 可以加：「公式進不去，副歌一聽就會。我的腦袋有它自己的標準。」
也能改：「我不是記性差，我是把記憶體留給更重要的歌單。」

en.content:
My brain's storage:
ninety percent song lyrics, ten percent exam material.
Before the test I can sing three full albums front to back,
but I can't remember a single formula.
Guess my brain picked the wrong major from day one.
en.editorNote: For the student who realizes they only retained lyrics — pair with a headphones-and-textbook story shot.
variations: Add: "Formulas won't go in. The chorus loads instantly. My brain has its own standards."
Try: "I don't have a bad memory. I just saved the storage for a better playlist."

items.sourceNote: study breaks longer than sessions register — 休息與讀書比例失衡 frame

zh-tw.content:
我的讀書空檔比讀書時間還長。
讀十分鐘，休息一小時。
嚴格說起來，
我不是在讀書中間休息，
是在休息中間不小心讀了一下書。
zh-tw.editorNote: 明明坐在書桌前一整天卻什麼都沒讀進去的考生 OS，配張螢幕停在 YouTube 的桌面照超寫實。
variations: 可以加：「我的番茄鐘只剩番茄，鐘早就被我關掉了。」
也能改：「別人讀書休息五分鐘，我休息讀書五分鐘。」

en.content:
My study breaks are longer than my study sessions.
Ten minutes of reading, one hour of rest.
Strictly speaking,
I'm not resting between studying —
I accidentally studied a bit between resting.
en.editorNote: For the student who sat at the desk all day and absorbed nothing — pair with a desktop frozen on YouTube.
variations: Add: "My pomodoro timer is all tomato, no timer. I muted that part ages ago."
Try: "Other people study, then rest five minutes. I rest, then study five minutes."

items.sourceNote: pen writes faster when clueless register — 不會寫反而寫更快 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
奇怪的是，
我越不會的題目，筆寫得越快。
會的題目我慢慢寫，怕寫錯；
不會的題目我用力寫，怕停下來就被自己看穿。
所以滿滿一頁答案，其實是滿滿一頁的心虛。
zh-tw.editorNote: 申論題不會寫卻硬要湊滿格子的考生 OS，配張寫得密密麻麻卻離題的考卷迷因效果最強。
variations: 可以加：「字寫越多代表我越不確定，這是考卷的隱藏密碼。」
也能改：「我不是文思泉湧，我是在用字數掩護我的空白。」

en.content:
Funny thing —
the less I know an answer, the faster my pen moves.
I write slowly on the ones I know, scared of a slip;
I write furiously on the ones I don't, scared that stopping will give me away.
So a full page of answers is really a full page of bluffing.
en.editorNote: For padding an essay question you have no clue about — pair with a meme of a densely written but off-topic paper.
variations: Add: "More words means less certainty. That's the hidden code of every exam sheet."
Try: "It's not inspiration flowing. It's word count covering for the blank in my head."

items.sourceNote: blame the syllabus register — 都是課綱的錯 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
保持冷靜，然後怪課綱。
不是我不會，是課綱排太多。
不是我沒讀，是進度跑太快。
甩鍋給課綱是我考前唯一不會出錯的科目，
而且我這科一定滿分。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考差想找台階下的考生自嘲，傳到班群同學會一秒接龍「對啦都是課綱」。
variations: 可以加：「課綱無聲無息地承擔了我所有的失誤，謝謝你課綱。」
也能改：「我的成績不能代表我，只能代表課綱對我太狠。」

en.content:
Keep calm and blame the syllabus.
It's not that I can't do it — the syllabus crammed in too much.
It's not that I didn't study — the pace ran too fast.
Blaming the syllabus is the one subject I never get wrong before an exam,
and I'm definitely scoring full marks in it.
en.editorNote: For the student looking for an exit after a bad test — drop it in the group chat for instant 'yeah, it's the syllabus' replies.
variations: Add: "The syllabus silently absorbs all my mistakes. Thank you, syllabus."
Try: "My grade doesn't represent me. It just represents how brutal the syllabus was."

items.sourceNote: exams where confidence disappears register — 自信消失點 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
考場是我自信消失的地方。
進去前我覺得我什麼都會，
坐下來那一刻，自信就像鉛筆屑一樣被吹走了。
出來之後我才慢慢把它撿回來，
撿到一半，成績單來了，又全部掉光。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前信心滿滿、考後瞬間崩盤的考生 OS，配張空蕩考場座位的照片超有戲。
variations: 可以加：「我的自信只在進考場前那十秒鐘存在過。」
也能改：「考場像個磁場，專門吸走我的自信跟記憶，順便附贈胃痛。」

en.content:
The exam hall is where my confidence goes to disappear.
Before I walk in I feel like I know everything;
the second I sit down, it gets swept away like pencil shavings.
I slowly pick it back up after I leave —
half-collected, the score report arrives, and it all drops again.
en.editorNote: For the confident-before, shattered-after exam arc — pair with a photo of an empty exam seat.
variations: Add: "My confidence only existed for the ten seconds before I walked in."
Try: "The exam hall is a magnet — it pulls out my confidence, my memory, and throws in a stomachache for free."

items.sourceNote: exams over brain has left the chat register — 大腦已離開聊天室 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
考完最後一科，
我的大腦傳了一句「已退出群組」就再也沒回我訊息。
別問我剛剛寫了什麼，
那個人已經離職了，現在這具身體由本能代班。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完整個人放空、靈魂出竅的限動文案，配張眼神死的自拍效果最強。
variations: 可以加：「現在回我訊息的不是大腦，是慣性。」
也能改：「大腦：已讀不回。我：那我也下班。」

en.content:
Right after the last exam,
my brain typed "left the group" and never replied again.
Don't ask what I just wrote —
that guy already quit, and instinct is covering his shift.
en.editorNote: For the post-exam empty-shell mood — pair with a dead-eyed selfie.
variations: Add: "What's replying to you now isn't my brain. It's momentum."
Try: "Brain: seen, no reply. Me: cool, I'm clocking out too."

items.sourceNote: knowledge magically disappears register — 知識魔術消失 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我發現自己有個超能力：
只要一坐進考場，腦袋裡的知識就會集體變不見。
它們昨晚還在，
今天早上就像被魔術師的黑布一蓋，
「噹」一聲，全部變成鴿子飛走了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 進考場瞬間全部忘光的考生 OS，配張一臉茫然盯著考卷的迷因正中紅心。
variations: 可以加：「考完走出考場，鴿子又自己飛回來了，時機抓得剛剛好。」
也能改：「我不是沒讀，我是把知識存在一個叫『考場外』的雲端。」

en.content:
Turns out I have a superpower:
the second I sit down for an exam, every fact in my head vanishes at once.
They were there last night.
This morning a magician threw a black cloth over them,
shouted "ta-da," and they all turned into pigeons and flew off.
en.editorNote: For the instant-amnesia-on-sitting-down moment — pair with a blank-stare-at-the-paper meme.
variations: Add: "The pigeons fly right back the moment I leave the hall. Impeccable timing."
Try: "I did study. I just saved everything to a cloud called 'outside the exam room.'"

items.sourceNote: walked out like a boss answered like nobody register — 走出來像老闆答題像菜鳥 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我走出考場的氣勢，像剛簽下百億合約的老闆。
但我作答的樣子，像第一天上工還搞不清楚廁所在哪的菜鳥。
這兩個我之間的落差，
大概就是成績單存在的意義。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完故作淡定、其實裡面亂七八糟的考生自嘲，配張背影離場的帥照超有反差。
variations: 可以加：「外表是 CEO，內在是試用期還沒過。」
也能改：「走出來的我跟寫考卷的我，建議互相不要認識比較好。」

en.content:
I walked out of the exam like a boss who just signed a billion-dollar deal.
But the way I actually answered? Like a first-day intern who still can't find the bathroom.
The gap between those two versions of me
is basically why score reports exist.
en.editorNote: For the fake-it-walking-out, chaos-inside energy — pair with a cool back-view exit shot.
variations: Add: "CEO on the outside, still on probation on the inside."
Try: "The me who walked out and the me who took the test should probably stay strangers."

items.sourceNote: committed relationship with textbooks register — 跟課本交往 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
這學期我談了一場最認真的戀愛，
對象是我的課本。
它佔據我每個夜晚、每個週末、每一頓沒吃完的飯。
結果考完那天它頭也不回地走了，
而且還把我的分數一起帶走當贍養費。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前跟課本形影不離、考完被無情拋棄的考生 OS，配張抱著一疊書的照片超有戲。
variations: 可以加：「我們在一起最久，分手卻最痛，因為它連成績都要分走。」
也能改：「課本是這學期唯一沒缺席過我夜晚的對象，謝謝你，也再也不見。」

en.content:
This semester I was in the most committed relationship of my life —
with my textbook.
It took up every night, every weekend, every meal I never finished.
Then on exam day it walked off without looking back,
and took my grade with it as alimony.
en.editorNote: For the inseparable-then-dumped-by-your-textbook arc — pair with a photo hugging a stack of books.
variations: Add: "Longest relationship, worst breakup — it even split the score with me."
Try: "My textbook was the only one who never missed a single night this semester. Thanks, and goodbye forever."

items.sourceNote: when in doubt C in doubt register — 不會就選 C frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
選擇題不會的時候，我有一套縝密的策略：
看哪個選項最眼熟，看哪個排版最順，最後再相信一下直覺。
聽起來很科學，
其實翻成白話就是——閉著眼睛猜。
zh-tw.editorNote: 選擇題用玄學作答的考生自嘲，傳到班群一定有人回「我都選 C」。
variations: 可以加：「我的答案卡像心電圖，因為它記錄的是我每一次心虛的起伏。」
也能改：「考試教會我最實用的技能，是把『不知道』包裝成『我選好了』。」

en.content:
When I don't know a multiple-choice answer, I have a rigorous strategy:
pick the one that looks most familiar, the one that's laid out the cleanest, then trust my gut.
Sounds scientific.
Translated into plain English it means — guessing with my eyes closed.
en.editorNote: For the multiple-choice fortune-teller mood — drop it in the group chat and someone will reply 'I just always pick C.'
variations: Add: "My answer sheet looks like a heartbeat monitor — it records every spike of my self-doubt."
Try: "The most useful skill exams taught me is dressing up 'no idea' as 'final answer.'"

items.sourceNote: A+xiety wordplay register — 焦慮諧音梗在地化 frame

zh-tw.content:
別人準備考試靠的是 A 計畫、B 計畫，
我準備考試靠的是 A 焦慮、B 焦慮、C 焦慮。
等到 D 焦慮都用完了，
我才發現我根本沒有 E 計畫，只有 E 連發的胃痛。
zh-tw.editorNote: 期末焦慮型考生的限動文案，配張抓著肚子盯課本的自拍最有戲。
variations: 可以加：「我的讀書進度條沒在跑，焦慮進度條倒是 100% 滿格。」
也能改：「我不是在讀書，我是在用焦慮幫自己加油，加的還是劣質汽油。」

en.content:
Other people prep for exams with Plan A and Plan B.
I prep with Anxiety A, Anxiety B, Anxiety C.
By the time I'd used up Anxiety D,
I realized I never had a Plan E — just an E-shaped stomachache on repeat.
en.editorNote: For the finals-anxiety spiral — pair with a selfie clutching your stomach over a textbook.
variations: Add: "My study progress bar isn't moving. My anxiety bar, however, is sitting at 100%."
Try: "I'm not studying. I'm fueling myself with anxiety — and it's the cheap kind."

items.sourceNote: survived season finale of least favorite show register — 爛劇大結局 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
考完最後一科的感覺，
就像追完一部你根本不喜歡、卻被逼著看完的爛劇。
結局爛、過程更爛，
但你還是莫名其妙鬆了一口氣——
至少它播完了，至少我不用再追第二季。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完那種「終於解脫但也沒比較開心」的複雜心情，配張關掉檯燈的限動超應景。
variations: 可以加：「我不是看完它，是熬到它自己播完。」
也能改：「這部叫《我的學期》的爛劇，總算下檔了，編劇我有意見但算了。」

en.content:
Finishing the last exam feels like
binge-watching a show you never liked but were forced to finish.
The ending was bad, the plot was worse,
but somehow you still let out a sigh of relief —
at least it's over, at least there's no season two to chase.
en.editorNote: For the 'finally free but not exactly happy' post-exam mood — pair with a switched-off-desk-lamp story.
variations: Add: "I didn't finish it. I just outlasted it until it ended on its own."
Try: "This trainwreck show called 'My Semester' is finally cancelled. I have notes for the writers, but never mind."

items.sourceNote: procaffeinating register — 咖啡因拖延諧音梗在地化 frame

zh-tw.content:
我發明了一個讀書步驟，叫做「先泡咖啡」。
問題是泡完咖啡要等它涼，等涼的時候要滑一下手機，
滑完手機咖啡冷了要再泡一杯。
於是我一整晚都在準備讀書，唯獨沒有讀到書。
zh-tw.editorNote: 用泡咖啡當拖延藉口的考生 OS，配張桌上三杯沒喝完的咖啡照超寫實。
variations: 可以加：「咖啡因進到我身體裡的唯一作用，是讓我更清醒地拖延。」
也能改：「我不是邊喝咖啡邊讀書，我是邊讀咖啡邊喝書，順序好像哪裡不對。」

en.content:
I invented a study step called "first, make coffee."
Problem is, after making it I have to wait for it to cool, and while it cools I scroll my phone,
and after scrolling the coffee's cold so I make another cup.
So I spent all night preparing to study — and never actually studied.
en.editorNote: For the coffee-as-procrastination crowd — pair with a photo of three half-finished mugs on your desk.
variations: Add: "The only thing caffeine does for me is make me more alert while I procrastinate."
Try: "I'm not drinking coffee while studying. I'm studying the coffee while drinking the book. Something's off."

items.sourceNote: stressed blessed caffeinated register — 三連狀態在地化 frame

zh-tw.content:
目前狀態：壓力滿、福報空、咖啡因爆表。
三個指數裡有兩個是紅的，
而那個沒爆的，是因為它從學期初就一直是零。
沒事，至少咖啡因幫我撐到現在。
zh-tw.editorNote: 期末週身心崩潰但還在硬撐的考生限動，配張黑眼圈自拍加一杯咖啡剛剛好。
variations: 可以加：「支撐我的不是夢想，是這杯第幾杯我已經算不清楚的咖啡。」
也能改：「壓力是滿的，電量是空的，這台人類已進入低耗電模式。」

en.content:
Current status: stress full, blessings empty, caffeine off the charts.
Two of the three gauges are in the red,
and the one that isn't has been sitting at zero since week one.
It's fine — at least the caffeine got me this far.
en.editorNote: For the finals-week running-on-fumes mood — pair with an eye-bags selfie and a coffee cup.
variations: Add: "What's holding me up isn't dreams. It's this coffee — and I've lost count of which cup it is."
Try: "Stress: full. Battery: empty. This human has entered low-power mode."

items.sourceNote: studying like my grade depends on it because it does register — 賭上成績 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我現在讀書的拼命程度，好像成績決定了我的人生。
冷靜想一下——
它好像真的決定了我的人生。
所以這不是過度認真，是遲到了一整個學期才開始的合理恐慌。
zh-tw.editorNote: 期末前一晚突然頓悟、開始狂讀的考生 OS，配張深夜書堆爆滿的桌面照超有感。
variations: 可以加：「我用考前一晚的速度，補完整學期的進度，這叫物理上的奇蹟。」
也能改：「我不是臨時抱佛腳，我是臨時抱整座廟。」

en.content:
I'm studying like my whole life depends on this grade.
Then I stopped to think —
it kind of actually does.
So this isn't me being dramatic; it's reasonable panic that just showed up a full semester late.
en.editorNote: For the night-before epiphany cram — pair with a photo of a desk buried in books at 2am.
variations: Add: "Cramming a whole semester into one night is, physically speaking, a miracle."
Try: "I'm not clinging to the Buddha's leg last minute. I'm clutching the entire temple."

items.sourceNote: what do you call a student who finished finals — survivor frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
考完所有科目的學生，正式的身分不是「畢業生」，
是「倖存者」。
我沒有畢業證書，但我有一張看不見的證明：
我活著走出來了，而且還記得自己叫什麼名字。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完最後一科那天發限動最對味，配張走出校門背影照超有畫面。
variations: 可以加：「畢業典禮應該改名叫『倖存者大會』，每個人上台都該被鼓掌。」
也能改：「我不是考完，我是逃出來的。」

en.content:
A student who's finished every exam isn't a "graduate."
They're a "survivor."
I don't have a diploma yet, but I've got an invisible certificate:
I walked out alive, and I still remember my own name.
en.editorNote: Perfect for the day you finish your last paper — pair with a walking-out-the-gate shot.
variations: Add: "Graduation should be renamed 'Survivors' Reunion.' Everyone who walks up deserves applause."
Try: "I didn't finish the exams. I escaped them."

items.sourceNote: GPA and will to live same trend line register — 趨勢線 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我的成績跟我的求生意志，最近走的是同一條趨勢線。
兩條都在往下，
而且斜率穩定到可以拿去當數學課的範例。
老師說這叫負相關，我說這叫人生。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完看到成績那種「連數學都來補刀」的崩潰，傳到理組班群秒被截圖。
variations: 可以加：「至少這兩條線很有默契，從來不會背叛彼此往上走。」
也能改：「我的分數圖跟心電圖最大的差別是——心電圖偶爾還會跳一下。」

en.content:
My grades and my will to live are riding the same trend line lately.
Both heading down,
with a slope so steady you could use it as a textbook example.
My teacher calls it negative correlation. I call it life.
en.editorNote: For the moment even the math comes back to roast you — instant screenshot in any STEM group chat.
variations: Add: "At least the two lines are loyal — neither one ever betrays the other by going up."
Try: "The difference between my score chart and a heart monitor? The heart monitor still spikes sometimes."

items.sourceNote: swapped grades for shades summer mode register — 暑假切換 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
考試結束的那一秒，
我把計算機收進抽屜，把墨鏡戴上。
從今天起，我的身分從「考生」切換成「無業遊民（暑假限定）」。
這個轉職沒有教學關卡，但我天生就會。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完進入暑假模式的限動神句，配張海邊或冷氣房躺平的照片最對味。
variations: 可以加：「考完隔天的我，連鬧鐘都不認識我了。」
也能改：「課本收進箱子，靈魂放進冰箱，這個夏天我要冷藏自己。」

en.content:
The second the exam ended,
I put the calculator in the drawer and the sunglasses on.
From today, my title switches from "exam candidate" to "professionally unemployed (summer edition)."
There's no tutorial for this job change, but I was born for it.
en.editorNote: The official switch into summer mode — pair with a beach or AC-room sprawl photo.
variations: Add: "The morning after the exam, even my alarm clock didn't recognize me."
Try: "Textbooks in a box, soul in the fridge. This summer I'm storing myself cold."

items.sourceNote: 分科測驗 7月中 倒數 register — 學測完還沒結束 frame

zh-tw.content:
別人放暑假，我準備分科測驗。
當全世界都在喊「畢業快樂」的時候，
我還困在七月那場考試的倒數裡。
原來夏天對某些人來說，不是放假，是延長賽。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科測驗考生看到同學玩水卻還要讀書的內心 OS，傳到重考或社會組群組超有共鳴。
variations: 可以加：「我的暑假從分科測驗結束那天才正式開始，目前剩負三十天。」
也能改：「全世界都在過暑假，只有我還在過學期。」

en.content:
Everyone else is on summer break. I'm prepping for the July exam.
While the whole world is shouting "happy graduation,"
I'm still trapped in a countdown to a test in the middle of summer.
Turns out for some of us, summer isn't a vacation — it's overtime.
en.editorNote: For the student still studying while classmates hit the pool — pure relate for the resit and summer-exam crowd.
variations: Add: "My summer officially starts the day this exam ends. Currently at negative thirty days."
Try: "The whole world is on summer break. Only I'm still on the semester."

items.sourceNote: certified chillologist register — 認證系廢文 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
考完之後我幫自己頒了一張證照：
「國家級放空師」。
專長是躺著、發呆、把整個下午過成一秒。
這是我這輩子唯一一張不用補習、不用考試、一次就過的證照。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完進入廢人模式的自嘲文，配張躺沙發配冷氣的照片就是夏天本人。
variations: 可以加：「這張證照沒有有效期限，因為我打算終身執業。」
也能改：「別人考多益，我考『一整天什麼都不做』，滿分。」

en.content:
After the exam I awarded myself a certification:
"Nationally Licensed Professional Chiller."
Specialties: lying down, zoning out, turning an entire afternoon into one second.
It's the only license I'll ever earn with no cram school, no test, and a first-try pass.
en.editorNote: For the slide into full couch-potato mode — pair with a sofa-and-AC photo, peak summer energy.
variations: Add: "This license never expires, because I plan to practice for life."
Try: "Other people sit the TOEIC. I sat 'do absolutely nothing all day' and aced it."

items.sourceNote: 115 分科測驗 7/11-12 倒數十一天 register — 暑假與考試並存的荒謬 frame

zh-tw.content:
全世界的暑假從七月一日開始。
我的暑假從七月十三日開始。
中間那十二天，
別人叫它「放假」，
我叫它「人生最後的補考機會」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 七月初分科測驗考生的限動神句，發出去同學會默默按愛心然後繼續去讀書。
variations: 可以加：「我的暑假比別人晚兩天開始，但壓力提早一年到貨。」
也能改：「別人在數暑假第幾天，我在數考前還剩幾天。」

en.content:
The world's summer break started on July 1st.
Mine starts on July 13th.
Those twelve days in between —
everyone else calls it "vacation."
I call it "my last chance to retake my life."
en.editorNote: Story-post gold for the summer-exam crowd — classmates will quietly heart it, then go back to studying.
variations: Add: "My summer starts two days later than everyone's. The pressure arrived a year early."
Try: "Other people count which day of vacation it is. I count how many days till the exam."

items.sourceNote: brain has left the chat register — 大腦離線 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
考完最後一科那一刻，
我的大腦傳了一句：「對方已離開聊天室。」
然後就再也叫不回來了。
它說它需要至少一個暑假的已讀不回。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完進入腦袋當機模式的自嘲文，配張放空看天花板的照片就是夏天本人。
variations: 可以加：「想複習一下剛剛考的內容，結果大腦回我：『此帳號已停用。』」
也能改：「我的大腦不是壞掉，是設了一整個暑假的勿擾模式。」

en.content:
The second I finished the last exam,
my brain sent one message: "User has left the chat."
And it never came back.
It says it needs at least one whole summer of leaving me on read.
en.editorNote: For the post-exam brain-offline mode — pair with a ceiling-staring photo, peak summer energy.
variations: Add: "Tried to review what I just took. My brain replied: 'This account has been deactivated.'"
Try: "My brain isn't broken. It just set Do Not Disturb for the entire summer."

items.sourceNote: 115 分科 7/29 成績公告 8/13 放榜 register — 等待期煎熬 frame

zh-tw.content:
考完不是結束，是進入「薛丁格的成績」階段。
在放榜之前，
我同時考得很好，也考得很爛。
我選擇活在那個考得很好的版本裡，
反正房租是一樣的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科測驗考完等放榜的考生內心 OS，傳到群組會一排同學回「先別開盒子」。
variations: 可以加：「成績單還沒寄到之前，我就是個準台大生，謝謝。」
也能改：「放榜前我都是潛力股，放榜後才知道是地雷股還是金雞母。」

en.content:
Finishing the exam isn't the end — it's the start of "Schrödinger's grade."
Until results come out,
I both aced it and bombed it.
I choose to live in the version where I aced it.
The rent's the same either way.
en.editorNote: For the agonizing wait between the exam and results day — drop it in the group chat and watch everyone reply 'don't open the box yet.'
variations: Add: "Until the score report lands, I'm a future Ivy Leaguer, thank you."
Try: "Before results I'm a promising stock. After results I find out if I'm a unicorn or a landmine."

items.sourceNote: swapped grades for shades register — 從分數到墨鏡 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
我把標準答案換成了夾腳拖，
把准考證換成了海邊的入場券。
從今天起，
我的唯一一題是：「等一下要吃剉冰還是冰淇淋？」
而且這題我打算寫到八月底。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完衝去海邊的解放系限動文案，配張夾腳拖加沙灘的照片就是整個夏天。
variations: 可以加：「考完之後我的程度只剩看得懂菜單。」
也能改：「課本收進櫃子，防曬拿出來，這就是我的暑假升學規劃。」

en.content:
I swapped the answer key for flip-flops,
and my admission ticket for a beach pass.
Starting today,
my only question is: "shaved ice or ice cream next?"
And I plan to keep answering it until the end of August.
en.editorNote: The beach-run liberation caption — pair with a flip-flops-on-sand photo for full summer effect.
variations: Add: "Post-exam, my reading level is back down to 'can understand a menu.'"
Try: "Textbooks in the drawer, sunscreen out. That's my summer study plan."

items.sourceNote: remembering how to be a person register — 重新學當人 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
考完之後，
我得重新學習怎麼當一個人類。
怎麼睡到自然醒、怎麼吃飯不配講義、
怎麼跟朋友聊天不講「你那題寫什麼」。
進度緩慢，但我很有信心，
畢竟這科我以前考很好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完從考生模式切換回人類模式的自嘲文，配張賴床到中午的照片超有共鳴。
variations: 可以加：「重新做人第一天：成功在沒有鬧鐘的情況下醒在下午。」
也能改：「我以前是個正常人，考試把我訓練成只會劃卡的生物。」

en.content:
After the exam,
I have to relearn how to be a human.
How to sleep in without guilt, how to eat without a textbook open,
how to talk to friends without asking "what did you put for that question."
Progress is slow, but I'm confident —
after all, I used to ace this subject.
en.editorNote: For the switch from exam-mode back to human-mode — pair with a slept-till-noon photo, instant relate.
variations: Add: "Day one of being human again: successfully woke up in the afternoon with no alarm."
Try: "I used to be a normal person. The exam trained me into a creature that only fills in bubbles."

items.sourceNote: 115 分科測驗 7/11-7/12 倒數 register — 別人放暑假我還在考 frame

zh-tw.content:
全世界的學生都在放暑假，
只有分科測驗的考生，
七月還在跟考卷談一場沒有結局的戀愛。
別人的暑假是海邊，我的暑假是冷氣教室加一張准考證。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科測驗倒數那幾天的限動神句，配張課本疊在電風扇前的照片超寫實。
variations: 可以加：「等我考完，暑假只剩一半，但至少那一半是真的暑假。」
也能改：「別人在數浪，我在數還剩幾章沒讀。」

en.content:
The whole world is on summer break.
Only the students taking the subject-specific test
are still in July, stuck in a romance with a test paper that has no ending.
Everyone else's summer is the beach. Mine is an air-conditioned classroom and an admission ticket.
en.editorNote: For the last stretch before a summer exam — pair with a textbook-stacked-by-the-fan photo.
variations: Add: "By the time I'm done, half of summer is gone. But at least that half is real summer."
Try: "Everyone's counting waves. I'm counting how many chapters I haven't read."

items.sourceNote: 會考免試放榜 7/7 register — 落點分析 vs 玄學 對照 frame

zh-tw.content:
選填志願的時候，
學校教我們做落點分析，
爸媽教我們拜文昌，
補習班教我們排序策略。
最後我是閉著眼睛、憑感覺、加上一點點運氣填的。
所謂科學選校，到頭來還是一場玄學。
zh-tw.editorNote: 會考放榜前後選志願的內心戲，傳到家族群組長輩會突然安靜。
variations: 可以加：「落點分析算出來的是機率，決定我人生的是那一秒的手滑。」
也能改：「志願表填到最後，我信的不是分數，是緣分。」

en.content:
When it came time to rank my schools,
the school taught us placement analysis,
my parents taught us to pray,
and cram school taught us ranking strategy.
In the end I filled it in with my eyes closed, on vibes, plus a little luck.
So-called scientific school selection is, in the end, pure superstition.
en.editorNote: The vibes-vs-data reality of ranking schools — post it and watch the family group chat go quiet.
variations: Add: "Placement analysis gives you a probability. What decides my life is one accidental click."
Try: "By the last slot on the form, I wasn't trusting scores anymore. I was trusting fate."

items.sourceNote: 暑假讀書計畫 register — summer study plan 反差 frame 在地化

zh-tw.content:
放暑假第一天，我立志：
「這個暑假我要每天讀三小時，超前部署下學期。」
第二天：睡到中午。
第三天：追劇追到天亮。
第四天：把讀書計畫改成「先好好休息，開學前再衝刺」。
這句話我從國小講到現在，效果一次都沒兌現。
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑假開始沒幾天就發現自己又中招的學生 OS，配張全新沒翻過的參考書照片剛剛好。
variations: 可以加：「我的暑假進度條，只有第一天有動。」
也能改：「暑假作業的存在，就是為了在最後一週摧毀我。」

en.content:
Day one of summer break, I vowed:
"This summer I'll study three hours a day and get ahead for next semester."
Day two: slept till noon.
Day three: binged a show until sunrise.
Day four: revised the plan to "rest properly first, sprint before school starts."
I've been saying that line since elementary school. It has never once come true.
en.editorNote: For everyone who blew the summer study plan by day four — pair with a photo of a brand-new, never-opened workbook.
variations: Add: "My summer progress bar only moved on day one."
Try: "Summer homework exists purely to destroy me in the final week."

items.sourceNote: 考完記性歸零 register — brain full please empty 比喻在地化

zh-tw.content:
考完隔天，同學問我：「那個公式怎麼推的？」
我認真想了三秒，
發現我的腦袋像考完就自動清空的資源回收桶。
昨天還背得滾瓜爛熟，今天連它姓什麼都忘了。
原來知識在我這裡是短期租借，不是永久持有。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完知識瞬間蒸發的共鳴句，傳到班群大家都會回「同款腦袋」。
variations: 可以加：「我的記憶體只夠撐到交卷那一刻，多一秒就自動格式化。」
也能改：「知識來我腦袋只是路過，從不打算定居。」

en.content:
The day after the exam, a classmate asked: "How did you derive that formula?"
I thought hard for three seconds
and realized my brain is a recycle bin that auto-empties the moment the exam ends.
Yesterday I had it down cold. Today I've forgotten its name.
Turns out knowledge, in my head, is a short-term rental, not a permanent purchase.
en.editorNote: For the instant post-exam memory wipe — post it and the group chat replies with 'same brand of brain.'
variations: Add: "My memory only holds until I hand in the paper. One second later it auto-formats."
Try: "Knowledge just passes through my head. It never intends to move in."

items.sourceNote: 分科測驗成績 7/29 等放榜 register — 等成績的煎熬 frame

zh-tw.content:
考完分科最痛苦的不是考試，
是接下來那段等成績的日子。
我每天假裝在放暑假，
其實心裡有個倒數計時器，滴答滴答地響。
這種平靜叫做「暴風雨前，我先自己下了一場」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科測驗考完等成績那段坐立難安的心情，配張日曆被畫記號的照片超有畫面。
variations: 可以加：「別人問我在幹嘛，我說放空，其實我在等一個會改變人生的簡訊。」
也能改：「放榜前的暑假不是假期，是緩刑。」

en.content:
The most painful part of the subject-specific test isn't the exam.
It's the stretch afterward, waiting for the results.
Every day I pretend I'm on summer break,
but inside there's a countdown timer, ticking away.
This kind of calm is called "there's a storm coming, so I threw one myself first."
en.editorNote: For the restless limbo of waiting for scores — pair with a photo of a calendar covered in countdown marks.
variations: Add: "People ask what I'm up to. I say 'nothing.' Really I'm waiting for one text that changes my life."
Try: "The summer before results day isn't a vacation. It's a suspended sentence."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 考試板 讀書計畫 vs 現實 落差 meme — 拖延自嘲 register

zh-tw.content:
我的讀書計畫寫得比課本還厚，
執行率大概跟我的存款一樣接近零。
計畫表上第一行永遠是「明天開始認真」，
然後那個明天，跟前男友一樣，說會回來卻再也沒出現。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前拿來自嘲最剛好，配一張畫得超精美但完全沒打勾的讀書表，笑中帶淚。
variations: 可以加：「我不是不讀書，我是在等一個對的心情，結果等到考試當天。」
也能改：「讀書計畫的功能不是拿來讀，是拿來自我感覺良好的。」

en.content:
My study plan is thicker than the textbook itself.
Completion rate? About as close to zero as my bank balance.
Line one always says "start being serious tomorrow,"
and that tomorrow, like my ex, promised to come back and never showed.
en.editorNote: Perfect for pre-exam self-roasting. Pair with a beautifully designed study schedule that has zero checkmarks on it.
variations: Add: "It's not that I don't study. I'm waiting for the right mood — turns out the right mood was exam day."
Try: "A study plan isn't for studying. It's for feeling productive without doing anything."

items.sourceNote: Threads 考試季 考古題 幻覺句式 — 明明看過卻答不出 frame

zh-tw.content:
考古題我明明寫過三遍，
結果正式上場，那題長得像我沒見過的陌生人。
記憶這種東西真的很神奇，
該記的全忘，昨天午餐吃什麼我倒是記得一清二楚。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完發現寫過的題目還是不會，那種背叛感。配個大大的問號貼圖效果最好。
variations: 可以加：「我的腦容量是有限的，而它選擇存了迷因，沒存公式。」
也能改：「複習過的地方全沒考，沒複習的全出現，出題老師你是不是有讀我的心。」

en.content:
I did that past paper three times, I swear.
Then on the real exam, the question looked like a stranger I'd never met.
Memory is a funny thing —
forgets everything it should keep, but knows exactly what I had for lunch yesterday.
en.editorNote: For the betrayal of blanking on a question you practiced. Works best with a giant question-mark sticker.
variations: Add: "My brain has limited storage, and it chose to save memes instead of formulas."
Try: "Everything I reviewed didn't show up. Everything I skipped did. Test writer, are you reading my mind?"

items.sourceNote: Dcard 考試板 咖啡因 熬夜 續命 meme — 靠飲料撐考試 register

zh-tw.content:
考試週我的血液成分：
百分之四十咖啡、百分之三十能量飲、
百分之二十悔恨，剩下百分之十是「早知道就早點讀」。
醫生說我需要休息，
我說我需要的是把考試取消。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考試週靠咖啡因續命的日常，配一排空掉的咖啡杯照片超寫實。
variations: 可以加：「我不是在喝咖啡，我是在跟瞌睡蟲談判，而且我一直輸。」
也能改：「能量飲廣告說喝了能展翅高飛，我喝完只想躺平，可能是假貨。」

en.content:
My blood composition during exam week:
40% coffee, 30% energy drink,
20% regret, and the last 10% is "should've started studying earlier."
The doctor says I need rest.
I say what I need is for the exam to be cancelled.
en.editorNote: For the caffeine-fueled reality of exam week. Pair with a photo of a lineup of empty coffee cups.
variations: Add: "I'm not drinking coffee. I'm negotiating with the sleep demon, and I keep losing."
Try: "The energy drink ad said I'd spread my wings and fly. I just want to lie down. Might be a fake."

items.sourceNote: Threads 分科測驗結束 解放感 但空虛 frame — 考完反而失落 register

zh-tw.content:
考完最後一科走出考場，
我以為會感動落淚、大喊自由，
結果只感覺到一陣空虛，還有肚子餓。
原來奮鬥了那麼久，
結束的那一刻不是煙火，是一個很長很長的「喔」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完那種預期的解放沒來、反而有點失落的心情，很多考生都懂，配夕陽照片很有 fu。
variations: 可以加：「以前每天倒數放榜，現在不知道要期待什麼，人生突然沒了進度條。」
也能改：「我準備好慶祝了，但慶祝完呢？後面那個空白才是最可怕的。」

en.content:
I walked out of the last exam,
expecting to cry tears of joy, to scream that I'm free.
Instead I just felt empty. And hungry.
Turns out after fighting for so long,
the moment it ends isn't fireworks — it's one very, very long "oh."
en.editorNote: For that anticlimactic emptiness after the relief you expected never comes. Lots of test-takers get this. Pair with a sunset photo.
variations: Add: "I used to count down to results day. Now I don't know what to look forward to. Life suddenly lost its progress bar."
Try: "I was ready to celebrate. But after the celebration? That blank space is the scary part."

items.sourceNote: 英文迷因 'I put the pro in procrastination' 拖延自嘲 register — 改寫成中文考生語感

zh-tw.content:
別人問我準備得怎樣，
我說：「我是拖延界的專家，這方面我準備得非常充分。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科前一週，臨時抱佛腳還沒開始抱的人專用，發完限動繼續滑手機也很合理。
variations: 也可以說：「我不是還沒讀，我是在戰略性地累積壓力，等壓力到臨界點自然就會爆發性複習。」
進階版：「拖延不可怕，可怕的是我連拖延都拖到現在才開始。」

en.content:
Someone asked how my studying's going.
I said: "I'm an expert in one thing — procrastination. On that front, I'm extremely well prepared."
en.editorNote: For the week before the exam when you haven't even started cramming yet. Perfectly reasonable to post this and then keep scrolling.
variations: Try: "I haven't started. I'm strategically accumulating pressure until it hits critical mass and triggers an explosive review session."
Add: "Procrastination isn't scary. What's scary is that I procrastinated on procrastinating and only started now."

items.sourceNote: 'School taught me math, life taught me panic' 對照句式 — 改寫成考場崩潰版

zh-tw.content:
學校教會我微積分、三角函數、化學平衡，
考場教會我一件更重要的事：
原來人在極度恐慌的時候，連自己的名字都會覺得拼錯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 寫在考卷前十秒手抖的心情，配張空白答案卡照片超有共鳴。
variations: 也能改：「課本教我公式，考場教我怎麼假裝冷靜同時內心尖叫。」
可以加：「十二年教育的總結：我學會了在崩潰的時候還要記得寫准考證號碼。」

en.content:
School taught me calculus, trig, and chemical equilibrium.
The exam hall taught me something more important:
when you're panicking hard enough, even your own name starts to look misspelled.
en.editorNote: For that hand-trembling moment right before the paper flips over. Pair with a photo of a blank answer sheet.
variations: Try: "Textbooks taught me the formulas. The exam taught me how to look calm while screaming inside."
Add: "Twelve years of education, summed up: I learned to remember my seat number even mid-breakdown."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 升大學板 分科衝刺讀不完感嘆 register — 進度表 vs 現實落差

zh-tw.content:
我的讀書計畫表寫得像作戰地圖，
每一格都排得滿滿滿，看起來就是要上台大的人。
實際執行率百分之三。
所以嚴格來說，我不是沒讀，我是做了一份很厲害的「規劃」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科倒數、進度嚴重落後的人自嘲用，把讀書計畫表拍起來附圖更好笑。
variations: 也可以說：「計畫趕不上變化，變化趕不上我躺在床上滑手機的速度。」
進階版：「我把讀書時間都花在做讀書計畫上了，這也算某種認真吧。」

en.content:
My study schedule looks like a battle map —
every slot packed full, clearly the plan of someone headed to the top school.
Actual completion rate: three percent.
So technically I didn't skip studying. I produced an extremely impressive "plan."
en.editorNote: For anyone way behind schedule during the final sprint. Photograph your color-coded study planner for extra comedy.
variations: Try: "Plans can't keep up with reality, and reality can't keep up with how fast I lie in bed scrolling."
Add: "I spent all my study time making the study plan. That counts as a kind of dedication, right?"

items.sourceNote: 'I'm fluent in studying the night before the exam' 臨時抱佛腳梗 — 改寫成中文短笑話

zh-tw.content:
平常翻課本像在跟陌生人尬聊，
考前一晚翻課本，突然變成失散多年的靈魂伴侶，
一頁十秒鐘就能背起來。
我的專注力不是不存在，是只認截止日期這個老闆。
zh-tw.editorNote: 熬夜臨時抱佛腳但效率突然爆表的那種瞬間，發完這篇就繼續熬夜剛好。
variations: 也能改：「原來我不是不會讀書，我只是需要一個叫『明天就要考』的教練在旁邊吼。」
可以加：「考前一晚的我，是全宇宙記憶力最強的版本，可惜只出現八個小時。」

en.content:
Normally flipping through the textbook feels like small talk with a stranger.
The night before the exam, it suddenly becomes my long-lost soulmate —
ten seconds a page and it's memorized.
My focus does exist. It just only answers to one boss: the deadline.
en.editorNote: For that all-nighter cramming moment when your efficiency inexplicably goes through the roof. Post this, then get back to the grind.
variations: Try: "Turns out I can study. I just need a coach named 'the exam is tomorrow' screaming next to me."
Add: "The night-before version of me has the strongest memory in the universe. Shame it only shows up for eight hours."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content: 你不是要一次背完整本書，你只是要比昨天的自己多會一題。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前焦慮到覺得永遠讀不完時，用來拉回當下的一句話
variations: 別想著要征服整座山，先踏穩眼前這一階。
進步不用轟轟烈烈，多對一題就是往前一步。

en.content: You don't have to memorize the whole book today. You just have to know one more thing than you did yesterday.
en.editorNote: A line to pull yourself back to the present when the syllabus feels endless
variations: Don't try to conquer the mountain. Just take the next step.
Progress doesn't have to be dramatic. One more correct answer is still forward.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content: 翻開考卷先深呼吸三秒，會的題目其實比你以為的多。
zh-tw.editorNote: 發考卷、腦袋一片空白的那一刻，給自己的定心提醒
variations: 先寫會的，不會的擺後面，時間到了再回頭。
緊張是正常的，那代表你在乎；深呼吸，然後開始。

en.content: Take three deep breaths before you flip the page. You know more than your nerves are telling you.
en.editorNote: For the blank-mind moment right after the exam paper lands on your desk
variations: Answer what you know first. Circle the rest and come back.
Nerves just mean you care. Breathe, then begin.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content: 考完就交給命運吧，你能做的都已經在筆尖上留下了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 走出考場、忍不住一直回想答案時，勸自己放手的一句話
variations: 答案卷交出去那一刻，這場戰役就結束了，去吃頓好的吧。
別再重算那一題了，該檢討的等成績出來再說。

en.content: Once it's handed in, let it go. Everything you could do is already on the page.
en.editorNote: For when you walk out of the exam and can't stop replaying your answers
variations: The moment you turn in the paper, the battle's over. Go treat yourself.
Stop re-solving that one question. Save the review for after the results come out.

items.sourceNote: procrastination black-belt gag — 拖延自嘲 register，改寫

zh-tw.content: 考試不可怕，真正可怕的是我那已經練到黑帶的拖延症。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前一週還在滑手機、想發廢文合理化自己時的最佳文案
variations: 我不是不會考，是我的拖延症太會考。
別人在複習第三遍，我還在複習「等等就開始」的第三遍。

en.content: Exams don't scare me. It's my black belt in procrastination that keeps me up at night.
en.editorNote: Perfect caption for the week before finals when you're still scrolling instead of studying
variations: I don't fear the test. I fear my talent for putting it off.
Everyone's on their third review. I'm on my third round of 'I'll start in a sec.'

items.sourceNote: 考完數學崩潰梗 — 分科測驗 2026/7/11 時效性，改寫

zh-tw.content: 走出數學考場那一刻，我終於懂了什麼叫「輕舟已過萬重山」——因為那艘船上根本沒有我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科測驗、學測考完數學走出來，想發限動抒發又想搞笑時用
variations: 數學考完，我開始認真研究哪間大專科系收我。
考卷發下來的時候我還信心滿滿，交卷的時候我信仰崩潰。

en.content: The moment I walked out of the math exam, I finally understood inner peace — because I'd clearly given up somewhere around question three.
en.editorNote: For the post-math-exam story when you want to vent but also make people laugh
variations: After that math paper, I started seriously researching which schools accept 'tried my best.'
Walked in full of confidence, walked out questioning my entire education.

items.sourceNote: brain too many tabs open 梗 — 腦當機 register，改寫

zh-tw.content: 考卷發下來的時候，我的腦袋開了太多分頁，結果一起當機了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 看到題目一片空白、腦袋一片空的當下自嘲，或考前緊張時發文
variations: 明明昨晚都記得，翻開考卷全部自動登出。
腦容量不足，請先清除快取再重新作答。

en.content: The exam started and my brain had way too many tabs open, so it just crashed.
en.editorNote: For that blank-mind moment when you flip the paper over and nothing loads
variations: Remembered everything last night. Opened the paper and got logged out.
Storage full. Please clear cache before attempting to answer.

items.sourceNote: if stress burned calories 梗 — 壓力自嘲，改寫

zh-tw.content: 如果焦慮會燃燒卡路里，那我現在的身材應該可以直接出道了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前壓力爆表、想苦中作樂發限動時的萬用金句
variations: 熬夜念書沒瘦到，倒是黑眼圈練得很成功。
我不是在減肥，我是被考試壓力自然瘦身。

en.content: If anxiety burned calories, I'd have a modeling contract by exam week.
en.editorNote: A go-to line for when pre-exam stress peaks and you want to laugh through it
variations: Pulled three all-nighters and lost zero weight — only gained eye bags.
Not on a diet, just on the exam-stress cleanse.

items.sourceNote: 考前抱佛腳 vs 考後放生 對比梗 — 台灣考生日常，改寫

zh-tw.content:
考前：一天當三天用。
考後：三天當一天睡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完想耍廢、幫自己找台階下時的懶人限動文案
variations: 考前跟時間賽跑，考後跟床鋪談戀愛。
臨時抱佛腳抱到手酸，佛還是沒理我。

en.content:
Before the exam: turning one day into three.
After the exam: turning three days into one long nap.
en.editorNote: The lazy post-exam story caption for when you've earned the right to do nothing
variations: Before: racing the clock. After: in a committed relationship with my bed.
Crammed so hard my arms hurt. The material still ignored me.

items.sourceNote: brain 90% song lyrics 10% exam content 梗 — 改寫成台灣考生版

zh-tw.content:
我的腦袋容量：百分之九十都是抖音神曲，剩下百分之十才是明天要考的東西。
可惜考卷不考副歌。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前發現重點都沒進腦、只記得洗腦歌時的自嘲限動，配一句歌詞更有梗
variations: 課本翻三遍記不住，一首歌聽一遍就會唱，人腦真的很挑食。
如果考卷考歌詞，我大概可以上台大。

en.content:
My brain's storage: ninety percent viral song lyrics, ten percent tomorrow's exam.
Shame the paper never tests the chorus.
en.editorNote: The self-roast story caption for when nothing stuck except the song stuck in your head
variations: Read the chapter three times, forgot it. Heard a song once, know every word. My brain is a picky eater.
If exams tested lyrics, I'd be valedictorian.

items.sourceNote: black belt in procrastination not exams 梗 — 改寫

zh-tw.content: 我在拖延這件事上已經是黑帶等級了，可惜考試不設這個項目。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前才開始念、明知道會後悔還是先滑手機的萬用自嘲
variations: 拖延奧運如果開賽，我國金牌穩了。
我不是不會念，我只是把念書排在世界末日後面。

en.content: I've got a black belt in procrastination. Pity they don't grade that on the exam.
en.editorNote: For when you know you'll regret scrolling instead of studying — and do it anyway
variations: If procrastination were an Olympic event, I'd be defending champion.
It's not that I can't study. I just scheduled it for after the apocalypse.

items.sourceNote: sure I studied just can't remember where 梗 — 改寫

zh-tw.content: 我百分之百確定我有念書，我只是想不起來念到哪去了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 翻開考卷一片空白、明明有讀卻全還給老師時的哭笑不得限動
variations: 知識確實有進到我腦袋，只是沒登記地址就搬走了。
書我是讀了，只是讀完就自動歸還圖書館。

en.content: I'm a hundred percent sure I studied. I just can't remember where I put it.
en.editorNote: For the blank-paper moment when you swear you learned this and it vanished
variations: The knowledge definitely moved into my brain — it just left without a forwarding address.
I read the book. It auto-returned itself to the library right after.

items.sourceNote: 考題難到全體崩潰 梗 — 台灣考生集體哀嚎版，改寫

zh-tw.content: 走出考場那刻，全場眼神空洞、腳步一致，像剛集體看完自己的成績單。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考題難到炸、走廊上大家表情如出一轍時的考後即時廢文
variations: 這科難到我們不是同學，是難民。
考完對答案的勇氣，我沒有；假裝沒事的演技，我很有。

en.content: The moment we walked out of that exam, the whole room had the same empty stare and the same slow shuffle — like we'd all just seen our own report cards.
en.editorNote: For a brutal paper when everyone in the hallway is wearing the identical thousand-yard stare
variations: That paper was so hard we stopped being classmates and became refugees.
The courage to check my answers? None. The acting skills to pretend I'm fine? Award-worthy.

items.sourceNote: tired broke laughing through the pain 學生梗 — 改寫成考季生存版

zh-tw.content:
考季生存三要素：睡不飽、錢包空、笑著撐。
少一樣都算你沒真的考過試。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考季一路熬過來、想跟同溫層取暖時的自嘲文，留言區秒集合
variations: 咖啡續命、泡麵果腹、意志力用完了就用哭的。
我不是在準備考試，我是在體驗人類極限。

en.content:
The three pillars of surviving exam season: no sleep, no money, and laughing through the pain.
Miss one and you never really took an exam.
en.editorNote: The rally-the-group-chat post for when you've clawed through exam season and need your people
variations: Coffee for a pulse, instant noodles for fuel, and crying for when willpower runs out.
I'm not studying for an exam. I'm field-testing the limits of the human body.

items.sourceNote: brain before vs during exam 對照梗 — 改寫成馬鈴薯焦慮版

zh-tw.content:
考前的我：一台精密運算的高階腦。
考試中的我：一顆插了電還會焦慮的馬鈴薯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 翻開考卷第一頁就當機時，發給讀書會群組保證有人回「這也太真實」。
variations: 考前：博覽群書。考中：博覽考卷，一片空白。
腦子昨天明明還在，怎麼一進考場就請假了。

en.content:
My brain the night before: a sleek, high-performance supercomputer.
My brain during the exam: a potato that somehow got anxiety.
en.editorNote: Post it the second you flip to page one and blank out — your study group chat will pile on with 'too accurate'.
variations: Pre-exam: a walking encyclopedia. Mid-exam: a walking blank page.
My brain was here yesterday. It called in sick the moment I sat down.

items.sourceNote: coffee because sleep is for people 咖啡續命梗 — 改寫成有機化學版

zh-tw.content:
咖啡：給那些明天早上沒有一整科要考的人去睡覺用的。
我不睡，我跟這杯拿鐵有生死之交。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前熬夜配一張桌上排滿咖啡杯的照片發限動，同屆考生秒懂。
variations: 睡眠是奢侈品，而我這學期預算超支了。
第三杯咖啡下肚，現在能聽見課本在對我說話了。

en.content:
Coffee: reserved for people who don't have an entire subject to survive at 8 a.m. tomorrow.
I'm not sleeping — this latte and I have a blood pact.
en.editorNote: Pair with a photo of the coffee-cup graveyard on your desk during an all-nighter — every classmate will feel seen.
variations: Sleep is a luxury item and I blew my budget this semester.
Third cup down and I can now hear the textbook talking back.

items.sourceNote: two-button meme 熬夜還是早起兩難 — 改寫成內心天人交戰版

zh-tw.content:
考前的兩個按鈕：「今晚熬夜讀完」和「相信自己明天早起」。
結果我的手在兩顆按鈕中間，抖到天亮。
zh-tw.editorNote: 凌晨兩點還沒決定要不要睡的時候發，留言區都是同病相憐的手。
variations: 計畫：早睡早起。現實：早睡沒睡著，早起沒起來。
我沒有選熬夜也沒有選早起，我選了滑手機到後悔。

en.content:
Two buttons before the exam: "Pull an all-nighter now" and "Trust yourself to wake up early."
My hand hovered between them, sweating, until sunrise.
en.editorNote: Post it at 2 a.m. when you still haven't decided whether to sleep — the replies will be a wall of nervously sweating hands.
variations: The plan: early to bed, early to rise. The reality: neither happened.
I didn't pick the all-nighter or the early morning — I picked scrolling until regret.

items.sourceNote: 考題像外星語 woman-yelling-at-cat 梗 — 改寫成看不懂題目版

zh-tw.content:
我讀的是中文，考卷出的是我沒學過的中文。
看到第五題我認真懷疑自己是不是走錯考場走到聯合國了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考卷難到懷疑人生時發，配一張歪頭疑惑的貓貼圖更到位。
variations: 每個字都認識，湊在一起就變成咒語。
這題我唯一看懂的是題號。

en.content:
I studied in English. The exam was written in a language I've apparently never met.
By question five I genuinely wondered if I'd walked into a UN summit by mistake.
en.editorNote: For when the paper is so brutal you question reality — pair it with a confused head-tilt cat sticker.
variations: I know every single word. Together they spell a curse.
The only thing I understood on that question was the question number.

items.sourceNote: memes.tw 考試梗圖 臨時抱佛腳 — 改寫成佛腳抱不動版

zh-tw.content:
臨時抱佛腳的下場，是佛已經下班，只留一張「已讀不回」。
我抱著空氣走進考場，全靠平常沒累積的實力。
zh-tw.editorNote: 整學期都在拖、考前一晚才翻書的人專用，罪惡感和幽默感同時拉滿。
variations: 佛腳我是抱了，但佛說祂只保佑有預習的。
臨時抱佛腳，結果抱到抽筋，題目一題都沒抱到。

en.content:
The reward for last-minute cramming: the universe has clocked out and left me on read.
I walked in clutching thin air, powered entirely by the skills I never built up.
en.editorNote: Made for the people who procrastinated all term and cracked the book the night before — guilt and comedy at max volume.
variations: I did cram at the last minute. Turns out luck only covers students who reviewed.
Crammed so hard I pulled a muscle and still didn't catch a single topic.

items.sourceNote: going-blank 迷因主題 — 改寫成腦袋當機重開機版

zh-tw.content:
昨晚背到快往生的重點，一翻開考卷全部集體離職。
我坐在位子上，腦袋藍白畫面，正在嘗試重新開機。
zh-tw.editorNote: 明明有讀卻瞬間全忘的那種絕望，考完發限動配一張當機貓貼圖最對味。
variations: 腦袋不是空白，是把讀過的東西都存到別人的硬碟了。
重點全記得，就是想不起來題目在問哪個重點。

en.content:
Everything I crammed until midnight quit on the spot the second I opened the paper.
I just sat there with a blue screen behind my eyes, trying to reboot.
en.editorNote: For that special despair of studying hard and then blanking instantly — pair the story post with a crashing-laptop cat sticker.
variations: My mind isn't blank, it saved everything I studied to somebody else's hard drive.
I remember all the key points. I just can't recall which one the question wants.

items.sourceNote: "exams don't scare me, my procrastination does" 句式 — 改寫成拖延才是大魔王版

zh-tw.content:
考試從來沒嚇過我，真正讓我半夜驚醒的是我的拖延症。
它比任何一科都認真，從開學陪我陪到考前一晚。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前罪惡感爆棚時發，拖延仔看到會默默按讚，因為就是在說自己。
variations: 我不怕考卷，我怕的是那個一直說「等等再讀」的我。
考試三小時，拖延三個月，這比例我自己都佩服。

en.content:
Exams have never scared me. The thing that jolts me awake at 3am is my own procrastination.
It's more dedicated than any subject — it's been with me since day one, right up to the night before.
en.editorNote: Post it when pre-exam guilt peaks; every fellow procrastinator will quietly like it because it's a self-portrait.
variations: I'm not afraid of the paper. I'm afraid of the me who keeps saying 'I'll study later.'
Three-hour exam, three-month procrastination — honestly the ratio impresses even me.

items.sourceNote: 選擇題用猜的 迷因 — 改寫成靠直覺選C版

zh-tw.content:
這題我不會，但我的直覺會，它叫我選C。
整張選擇題我不是在作答，我是在跟宇宙玩終極密碼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 選擇題全靠猜的考生專用，發完自己都笑出來，同溫層秒共鳴。
variations: 答案卡上排出一個漂亮的圖案，這是我今天唯一的藝術創作。
不確定的時候選C，我信的不是知識，是玄學。

en.content:
I don't know this one, but my gut does — and my gut says C.
I'm not answering this multiple choice, I'm playing a guessing game with the universe.
en.editorNote: Built for the student bubbling in answers on pure instinct — you'll laugh posting it and your friends will instantly relate.
variations: My answer sheet spells out a lovely little pattern — the only art I made all day.
When in doubt, pick C. I'm not trusting knowledge here, I'm trusting the stars.

items.sourceNote: Drake early-study vs cram 迷因 — 改寫成計畫表擺設版

zh-tw.content:
開學第一天做的精美讀書計畫表，現在是我書桌上最貴的裝飾品。
上面第一行寫「每天複習」，我連那四個字都沒複習過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 計畫做好做滿卻一頁沒翻的人專用，配一張精美手帳照更有反差笑點。
variations: 我的讀書計畫執行率，跟我的健身房會員卡使用率一樣感人。
計畫表：每天兩章。現實：每天兩集。

en.content:
That gorgeous study schedule I made on day one is now the most expensive decoration on my desk.
The first line says 'review daily' — I haven't even reviewed those two words.
en.editorNote: For anyone who built the perfect plan and never opened a page; pair it with a photo of a pristine planner for maximum contrast comedy.
variations: My study-plan completion rate is as moving as my gym membership usage.
The plan: two chapters a day. Reality: two episodes a day.

items.sourceNote: exam like a horror movie 句式 — 改寫成鬼片預告版

zh-tw.content:
考試就像恐怖片。
你明明知道它哪天要來，卻還是逃不掉，而且每次都被同一題嚇死。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考程表公布那天發最應景，底下留言區秒變大型受害者互助會。
variations: 恐怖片至少會給你配樂，考試連個心理準備都不給。
看鬼片會捂眼睛，寫考卷我也想捂，可惜捂了更看不懂。

en.content:
An exam is basically a horror movie.
You know exactly when it's coming, you still can't escape, and the same question jump-scares you every single time.
en.editorNote: Best posted the day the exam schedule drops; the comments turn into a support group instantly.
variations: At least horror movies give you a soundtrack; exams don't even give you a heads-up.
In a horror movie I cover my eyes. On the exam I want to cover them too, but then I understand even less.

items.sourceNote: in a relationship with studies, it's complicated 句式 — 改寫成感情狀態版

zh-tw.content:
我跟書本的感情狀態：一言難盡。
我每天陪它到半夜，它考試那天完全不認識我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 熬夜苦讀卻考砸的人專用，感情梗一出朋友立刻在下面接力。
variations: 付出全部的是我，翻臉不認人的是它，這段關係我先分手。
我對課本掏心掏肺，課本對我已讀不回。

en.content:
My relationship status with my textbooks: it's complicated.
I keep them company until 3 a.m. every night, and on exam day they act like we've never met.
en.editorNote: For anyone who studied their heart out and still bombed it; the relationship angle gets people quoting it in the replies.
variations: I gave everything, it ghosted me on test day — I'm calling this breakup first.
I pour my heart out to the textbook; the textbook leaves me on read.

items.sourceNote: look up for inspiration, down in desperation 句式 — 改寫成考場四方位版

zh-tw.content:
考試的時候，抬頭找靈感，低頭找絕望，左右張望找答案。
結果四個方向都只找到監考老師的眼神。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完出來發最有畫面感，尤其送給坐在教室正中央、無處可看的朋友。
variations: 上看天花板、下看橡皮擦、左右看同學，唯一沒看的是我的複習講義。
轉頭找答案的角度，跟監考老師巡視的路線永遠完美錯開。

en.content:
During an exam you look up for inspiration, down in desperation, and side to side for information.
All four directions, and the only thing I found was the proctor's eye contact.
en.editorNote: Great to post after the exam, especially for the friend stuck in the dead-center seat with nowhere to glance.
variations: Up at the ceiling, down at the eraser, left and right at classmates — the one thing I never looked at was my own notes.
My angle for finding answers and the proctor's patrol route were in perfect, permanent conflict.

items.sourceNote: coffee dependency + sleep deprivation 主題 — 改寫成咖啡因供電版

zh-tw.content:
考試週的我不是靠實力撐過去的，是靠咖啡因和恐懼交替供電。
睡眠？那是暑假才付得起的奢侈品。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考試週 IG 限動萬用款，配一張桌上三個空咖啡杯的照片最寫實。
variations: 我的血液成分：70% 咖啡、30% 明天就要考的緊張。
別人靠努力，我靠咖啡因和一點點的走投無路。

en.content:
I'm not getting through exam week on talent — I'm running on caffeine and fear, alternating.
Sleep? That's a luxury I can only afford over summer break.
en.editorNote: A go-to for exam-week stories; pair it with a photo of three empty coffee cups on your desk for peak realism.
variations: Blood composition: 70% coffee, 30% the panic of a test tomorrow.
Other people run on effort; I run on caffeine and a little bit of nowhere-left-to-go.

items.sourceNote: multiple-choice guessing superstition register — 選擇題玄學改寫

zh-tw.content:
選擇題不會寫沒關係，我信仰的是「一路B到底」的古老玄學。
畢竟三年沒讀的內容，靠一個字母來拯救，也算是一種浪漫。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科測驗、學測考完出考場的萬用限動，配一張看不懂的考卷照更有笑點。
variations: 答案卡上最誠實的一句話：不會的就交給機率，會的就交給運氣。
我的答題策略：先寫會的，再把不會的排成一個好看的圖案。

en.content:
Can't answer the multiple choice? No problem — I follow the ancient art of "just pick C all the way down."
Three years of not studying, saved by a single letter. Kind of romantic, honestly.
en.editorNote: A universal post-exam story caption; pair it with a photo of a question you clearly did not understand.
variations: The most honest line on my answer sheet: what I know goes to luck, what I don't goes to probability.
My strategy: answer what I know, then arrange the rest into a nice little pattern.

items.sourceNote: post-exam fear of checking answers register — 不敢對答案改寫

zh-tw.content:
考完最勇敢的行為，不是走出考場，是打開解答的那一秒。
所以我決定當個懦夫，答案我這輩子都不會對。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完當天發最有共鳴，尤其送給那群「說好一起不對答案」卻總有人偷對的朋友群。
variations: 同學：「要不要對答案？」我：「要不要當朋友？」
不對答案，成績單就永遠是薛丁格的，我還能多快樂幾天。

en.content:
The bravest thing you do after an exam isn't walking out — it's the second you open the answer key.
So I've decided to be a coward and never, ever check.
en.editorNote: Hits hardest posted on exam day, especially for the friend group that swore not to check answers but always has one traitor.
variations: Classmate: "Wanna compare answers?" Me: "Wanna stay friends?"
As long as I don't check, my grade stays Schrodinger's — and I get to be happy a few more days.

items.sourceNote: July heat + exam hall AC seasonal register — 分科測驗七月時節改寫

zh-tw.content:
七月考分科，考場外三十六度，考場內是我對這科的絕望零下十度。
冷氣吹得到身體，吹不到我發燙的腦袋跟空白的答案卷。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科測驗當週限動神句，配一張走出考場被太陽曬到融化的自拍最應景。
variations: 夏天最冷的地方不是冷氣房，是我看到考卷第一題的心。
外面熱到中暑，裡面凍到失憶，這溫差是專門設計來整考生的。

en.content:
Taking the July exam: it's 97 degrees outside the hall, and inside it's the sub-zero despair I feel toward this subject.
The AC reaches my body but never my overheating brain or my blank answer sheet.
en.editorNote: A perfect story line for exam week in high summer; pair it with a selfie of you melting in the sun on the way out.
variations: The coldest place in summer isn't the AC room — it's my heart seeing question one.
Heatstroke outside, memory loss inside; that temperature gap was engineered to torment students.

items.sourceNote: confidently-wrong humor register — 越錯越有自信改寫

zh-tw.content:
我對答案最有自信的時候，往往就是我錯得最離譜的時候。
真正會的題目反而在那邊猶豫半天，人生也是這樣，越沒把握的越堅持。
zh-tw.editorNote: 對完答案發現大爆炸時的自嘲文，苦中作樂又帶點哲理，朋友會又笑又心疼。
variations: 我寫得越快、越果斷、越沒有塗改的那一題，通常就是錯的。
考卷教會我一件事：自信跟正確率，有時候是反比。

en.content:
The moment I feel most confident about an answer is usually the moment I'm most spectacularly wrong.
The ones I actually know, I second-guess forever. Life's like that too — we cling hardest to what we're least sure of.
en.editorNote: Self-deprecating caption for when checking answers reveals a total meltdown; bittersweet and a little philosophical.
variations: The question I answered fastest, boldest, and without a single edit is almost always the wrong one.
Exams taught me one thing: confidence and accuracy are sometimes inversely proportional.

items.sourceNote: showing-up-is-half-the-battle register — 有到場就贏一半改寫

zh-tw.content:
有準時到考場、有把名字寫對、有撐到打鐘，這場我已經贏一半了。
剩下那一半叫做實力，很遺憾我沒有帶。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完那種「盡力就好」的自我安慰款，適合考砸了還想笑著發限動的人。
variations: 今日成就解鎖：準時、清醒、沒有睡過頭。至於分數，我們下次再聊。
能坐到最後一秒沒有交白卷離場，我對得起我的鬧鐘了。

en.content:
I showed up on time, spelled my name right, and lasted till the bell — I've already won half this exam.
The other half is called competence, and I regret to inform you I left it at home.
en.editorNote: A "did my best, sort of" self-comfort caption for anyone who bombed but still wants to post through it with a smile.
variations: Achievement unlocked today: on time, awake, didn't oversleep. The grade, we'll discuss another time.
I stayed till the last second and didn't hand in a blank sheet — I've done right by my alarm clock.

items.sourceNote: 颱風延考 register — 「第一次這麼不想放假」考生反應改寫

zh-tw.content:
颱風把考試延後，全班第一次集體祈禱「拜託如期舉行」。
多放這幾天，書不會多讀一頁，焦慮倒是續訂了一個禮拜。
zh-tw.editorNote: 延期公告跳出來、班群從一片歡呼變成沉默的那五分鐘，最適合發這段。
variations: 別人放假在歡呼，我們放假在倒數，果然考生連放假都能被剝奪快樂。
延期公告一出，我這輩子第一次希望颱風轉彎。

en.content:
The typhoon pushed the exam back, and for the first time in history the whole class prayed for it to happen on schedule.
Those extra days won't add a single page to my brain, but they auto-renewed my anxiety for another week.
en.editorNote: For the five minutes right after the postponement notice drops and the class group chat goes from cheering to dead silent.
variations: Normal people cheer for a day off. Exam kids just extend the countdown.
First time in my life I begged a typhoon to change course.

items.sourceNote: 考完各科自嘲 register — 「輕舟已過萬重山」/「該去哪上大專」對照改寫

zh-tw.content:
考完國文，輕舟已過萬重山。
考完數學，開始查哪間大專還有缺額。
考完英文，換大專問我要不要它。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完當天的心情三連拍，每一科都是一種人生階段，適合考生群組傳來傳去。
variations: 國文：我是詩人。數學：我是難民。英文：我是句號。
一天之內從『還有救』走到『我裸辭人生』，這就是分科的魅力。

en.content:
After the Chinese exam: my little boat has sailed past ten thousand mountains.
After the math exam: I start googling which colleges still have empty seats.
After the English exam: now the colleges are googling whether they even want me.
en.editorNote: A three-panel mood post for the day exams end — each subject is its own stage of grief. Great for the class group chat.
variations: Chinese: I'm a poet. Math: I'm a refugee. English: I'm a full stop.
Went from 'still salvageable' to 'unemployed for life' in a single day — that's the charm of finals.

items.sourceNote: exams-test-your-ability-to-panic-gracefully register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
考試考的從來不是我背了多少，
是我能不能在崩潰的同時，維持一個看起來還算冷靜的表情。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前一秒的自我調侃，適合坐在考場門口等打鐘時發廢文。
variations: 答案我不會，但我慌得很有氣質。
這場考的是心理素質，很可惜我這科也沒念。

en.content:
Exams have never measured how much I memorized —
they measure whether I can fall apart on the inside while keeping a mildly composed face on the outside.
en.editorNote: A pre-bell self-roast for when you're sitting outside the exam hall waiting to go in.
variations: I don't know the answer, but I'm panicking with real elegance.
This test is really about mental toughness, which I also forgot to study.

items.sourceNote: academically-challenged-emotionally-supported-by-memes-and-caffeine register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
目前狀態：課業上一團亂，情緒上靠迷因跟咖啡因勉強撐住。
學問沒長進，但求生意志滿到溢出來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考試週的自介限動款，配一杯第四杯的咖啡照最對味。
variations: 成績單慘不忍睹，但我的梗圖收藏堪稱資優。
腦袋是空的，杯子也是空的，只有黑眼圈是滿的。

en.content:
Current status: academically a disaster, emotionally held together by memes and caffeine.
My knowledge hasn't grown one bit, but my will to survive is overflowing.
en.editorNote: An exam-week bio-style story — pair it with a photo of your fourth coffee of the day.
variations: My grades are a tragedy, but my meme collection is honor-roll material.
My head is empty, my cup is empty — only the dark circles under my eyes are full.

items.sourceNote: Dcard 考試板 模考 vs 正式考 落差 register

zh-tw.content:
模考的時候我是全班的希望，
正式考的時候我是全班的教訓。
zh-tw.editorNote: 成績出來後在班群自嘲用，笑著發最不會被關心，效果最好。
variations: 模考五十五、正式四十八，我的實力果然很懂得看場合。
平常小考很會，大考很會慌，這就是所謂的臨場發揮吧。

en.content:
In mock exams I'm the pride of the class.
In the real one I'm the cautionary tale.
en.editorNote: Post it in the group chat when scores drop — laughing about it first keeps the pity replies away.
variations: Practice test: 55. Real test: 48. My talent really knows how to read the room.
Great at quizzes, great at panicking — apparently that's what 'rising to the occasion' means.

items.sourceNote: brain-has-too-many-tabs-open register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
我的腦袋現在同時開了太多分頁，
每一頁都在轉圈圈，一頁都讀不進去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 唸書唸到當機的深夜限動款，配一張攤在課本上的照片剛剛好。
variations: 腦內記憶體不足，請關閉部分煩惱後再試一次。
分頁開太多，主機發燙，知識還是零下載。

en.content:
My brain has way too many tabs open right now,
every one is buffering and none of them will load.
en.editorNote: A late-night story for when studying has crashed you — pair it with a photo of you face-down on your notes.
variations: Insufficient memory. Please close a few worries and try again.
Too many tabs open, CPU overheating, knowledge still at zero downloads.

items.sourceNote: 台灣考生自我安慰「考砸在台灣餓不死」register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
考砸就考砸，天不會塌，
這座島養得起一個暫時失常的你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給考前焦慮到睡不著的朋友，比「加油」更能讓人鬆一口氣。
variations: 一張考卷決定不了你這個人，它連你早餐吃什麼都不知道。
考差頂多難過一陣子，但你這個人值得被喜歡一輩子。

en.content:
So you bomb it — the sky won't fall.
The world can carry a version of you that's temporarily off form.
en.editorNote: Send it to a friend too anxious to sleep before the exam — it lands softer than 'you got this'.
variations: One test can't define you — it doesn't even know what you had for breakfast.
