A bad score stings for a while, but you're worth liking for a lifetime.

items.sourceNote: snacks-outnumber-knowledge register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
備考三小時，桌上的零食包裝比我背起來的重點還多。
看來我最會吸收的，是洋芋片。
zh-tw.editorNote: 唸書分心到吃光一整包餅乾時發，配零食空袋照最有畫面。
variations: 書桌上零食的種類，永遠比我記住的公式多一種。
熱量進度百分之百，讀書進度百分之三。

en.content:
Three hours of studying and the snack wrappers on my desk outnumber the facts in my head.
Turns out the thing I absorb best is potato chips.
en.editorNote: Post it when a whole bag of snacks disappears mid-study — an empty-wrapper photo sells it.
variations: There are always more snack flavors on my desk than formulas in my memory.
Calories: 100% done. Studying: 3% done.

items.sourceNote: 考前一晚「讀不完就睡」心態 register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
讀不完的那幾頁，就交給運氣吧。
與其硬撐到天亮，不如睡飽，讓努力替你發光。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前一晚糾結要不要熬夜的自我對話，也適合傳給死撐著唸書的同學。
variations: 睡飽的腦袋，比熬到天亮的腦袋多記三題。
今晚的枕頭，就是明天最好的考前重點。

en.content:
Those last few pages you can't finish? Leave them to luck.
Better to sleep well and let the effort you already made do the shining.
en.editorNote: The night-before pep talk with yourself — also good to send a classmate grinding until sunrise.
variations: A rested brain remembers three more questions than one that stayed up till dawn.
Tonight's pillow is tomorrow's best last-minute review.

items.sourceNote: brain-silent-pen-confused 考場氛圍 register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
考場現場實況：腦袋轉靜音，筆一臉困惑，時鐘倒是走得很起勁。
三個人裡面，只有時鐘知道自己在幹嘛。
zh-tw.editorNote: 剛走出考場、腦袋一片空白時發限動，配一張考場走廊照最有臨場感。
variations: 考卷發下來的那一刻，我跟我的筆一起失憶了。
全場最忙的是我的橡皮擦，最閒的是我的大腦。

en.content:
Live from the exam hall: brain on mute, pen visibly confused, clock somehow full of energy.
Out of the three of us, only the clock knows what it's doing.
en.editorNote: Post it right after walking out with a blank mind — a shot of the exam hallway sells the mood.
variations: The second the paper landed on my desk, my pen and I lost our memories together.
Busiest thing in the room: my eraser. Laziest: my brain.

items.sourceNote: recognize-question-not-answer 尷尬時刻 register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
那種尷尬：這題我看過，這幾個字我也都認得，
但它們湊在一起想表達什麼，我完全沒有頭緒。
zh-tw.editorNote: 明明複習過卻答不出來的崩潰時刻，考完在群組吐槽保證一堆人喊+1。
variations: 每個字我都會念，合起來就變成一題我不會的。
熟悉的題目，陌生的答案，久違的空白。

en.content:
That special kind of awkward: I recognize the question, I recognize every word,
but what they mean together is a total mystery to me.
en.editorNote: For the meltdown of blanking on stuff you actually reviewed — drop it in the group chat and watch the +1 replies pile up.
variations: I can read every word out loud; together they form a question I can't do.
Familiar question, unfamiliar answer, old friend called Blank.

items.sourceNote: started-studying-3-hours-after-planning 拖延 register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
計畫八點開始唸書，結果十一點才正式開機。
那三個小時我不是在耍廢，是在為讀書做心理建設。
zh-tw.editorNote: 拖到深夜才開始唸書的自嘲，配一張凌亂書桌照，同溫層秒懂。
variations: 我不是拖延，我只是把準備時間拉得比較長。
唸書進度落後三小時，滑手機進度超前三小時。

en.content:
Planned to start studying at eight; officially booted up at eleven.
Those three hours weren't wasted — I was mentally preparing to study.
en.editorNote: The self-roast of finally starting at midnight — pair it with a messy-desk photo and your feed instantly relates.
variations: I'm not procrastinating, I just have a very long warm-up routine.
Studying: three hours behind. Scrolling my phone: three hours ahead.

items.sourceNote: 考完每科走出考場心境變化 register 改寫（台灣分科測驗）

zh-tw.content:
考完第一科：還行，穩住。
考完第二科：嗯……大學再見。
考完最後一科：大學它還願意收我嗎？
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科測驗連考幾天後的心情三連拍，考完最後一科發最應景。
variations: 第一節：我可以。最後一節：我還是先想想備審資料怎麼寫。
走出考場的每一步，志願序都往後掉了一個。

en.content:
After subject one: not bad, hold it together.
After subject two: uh… goodbye, college.
After the last subject: does college even still want me?
en.editorNote: The three-stage mood after several days of exams — post it once you finish the final subject.
variations: First period: I got this. Last period: let me rethink my whole application.
With every step out of the exam hall, my dream school slid one rank down.

items.sourceNote: everything-I-studied-waved-goodbye 記憶消失 register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
昨晚背到快天亮的重點，一坐進考場就集體跟我揮手道別。
看來它們只是來借住一晚，沒打算長期定居。
zh-tw.editorNote: 臨時抱佛腳卻在考場全忘光的崩潰，考完發限動朋友秒懂秒笑。
variations: 熬夜背的東西保鮮期只有一個晚上，隔天早上就過期了。
重點：我記得你昨晚還在，怎麼開考就人間蒸發。

en.content:
Everything I crammed until dawn waved me a cheerful goodbye the moment I sat down.
Turns out it was just crashing for one night, never planning to move in.
en.editorNote: For the meltdown of forgetting everything you crammed — post it after the exam and friends will instantly get it.
variations: Stuff you cram overnight has a shelf life of one night; it expires by morning.
Notes: you were here last night — how did you vanish the second the exam started?

items.sourceNote: brain-not-responding / please-try-again-later register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
看到第一題，腦袋顯示：「系統忙碌中，請稍後再試。」
我試了三十分鐘，它還在轉圈圈。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考到一半整個放空、腦袋當機時發限動最應景，配一張盯著考卷發呆的照片。
variations: 腦袋不是沒開機，是開機畫面卡了兩個小時。
系統回應：找不到這個檔案，你確定有讀過嗎？

en.content:
Read question one, and my brain flashed: "System busy, please try again later."
I've been trying for thirty minutes and it's still buffering.
en.editorNote: Perfect story caption for when your mind goes totally blank mid-exam — pair it with a photo of you staring blankly at the paper.
variations: My brain didn't fail to boot — it's just been stuck on the loading screen for two hours.
System response: file not found. Are you sure you ever studied this?

items.sourceNote: living-off-coffee-and-questionable-life-choices register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
這陣子的我，靠三分咖啡因、七分後悔在運轉。
睡眠？那是給有規劃的人準備的奢侈品。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考試週熬夜狀態的自嘲，配一杯第四杯咖啡的照片超有共鳴。
variations: 我的血液檢查大概驗得出濃縮咖啡和「早知道」三個字。
續命方式：咖啡加緊張，兩種都不健康但都有效。

en.content:
These days I'm running on three parts caffeine and seven parts regret.
Sleep? That's a luxury reserved for people who planned ahead.
en.editorNote: Self-deprecating exam-week caption — post it with a photo of your fourth coffee of the day.
variations: A blood test would probably come back as espresso and the words "should've started earlier."
Fuel of choice: coffee and anxiety — neither is healthy, both work.

items.sourceNote: started-studying-3-hours-after-planning-to-study 拖延 register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
計畫八點開始念書，我準時在十一點坐下。
中間那三小時，我完成了整理書桌、洗手機殼、還有反省人生。
zh-tw.editorNote: 拖延症考生的日常自白，考前一晚發限動朋友都會回「這就是我」。
variations: 讀書前的儀式：先滑手機兩小時，讓自己充分準備好焦慮。
我不是不念書，我只是在為念書做很長很長的暖身。

en.content:
Planned to start studying at eight; I sat down promptly at eleven.
In those three hours I reorganized my desk, cleaned my phone case, and reevaluated my entire life.
en.editorNote: A confession for fellow procrastinators — post it the night before and everyone replies "literally me."
variations: Pre-study ritual: two hours of scrolling to properly warm up my anxiety.
I'm not avoiding studying — I'm just doing a very, very long warm-up for it.

items.sourceNote: study-guide-feels-like-a-panic-manual register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
翻開考前重點整理，本來想複習，結果變成一頁一頁的恐慌指南。
每一行都在提醒我：這個你也不會，那個你也沒念。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前臨陣翻筆記越翻越慌的心情，發文配崩潰表情貼超到位。
variations: 所謂重點整理，就是把你不會的地方整理得整整齊齊給你看。
複習講義的功能，目前看來是幫我盤點還有多少沒救。

en.content:
Opened my study guide to review, and it slowly turned into a page-by-page panic manual.
Every line just reminds me: you don't know this one either, or that one.
en.editorNote: For the rising dread of last-minute cramming — post it with a meltdown sticker for maximum relatability.
variations: A 'study guide' is just a neat, organized list of everything you don't know.
So far the only function of my review notes is tallying how much is beyond saving.

items.sourceNote: post-exam Netflix-snacks-zero-responsibilities 考後解放 register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
考完最後一科，我正式進入零責任模式。
接下來的行程只有：追劇、耍廢、把睡眠一次補回來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完最後一科走出考場的解放宣言，發限動配一張躺平的照片最爽。
variations: 考後待辦清單第一項：什麼都不做，而且做得心安理得。
從今天起我的身分是無業遊民，任期到成績單寄到為止。

en.content:
Finished my last subject, and I'm officially in zero-responsibility mode.
Upcoming schedule: binge shows, do nothing, and reclaim every hour of sleep I lost.
en.editorNote: A liberation post for walking out after your final exam — best paired with a photo of you sprawled on the couch.
variations: First item on my post-exam to-do list: absolutely nothing, and with a clear conscience.
As of today my job title is 'professionally unemployed,' term ending when the results arrive.

items.sourceNote: brain 95% song lyrics 5% exam knowledge 句型改寫

zh-tw.content:
我的腦袋容量：歌詞佔九成五，考試範圍佔五趴。
而且那五趴，考前一晚還會自動清空。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前發限動最有共鳴的自嘲，配一張抱著課本放空的照片剛好。
variations: 副歌我能一字不差跟到底，公式我連第一個符號都想不起來。
腦內硬碟壞軌的部分，剛好全都是考試會考的。

en.content:
My brain's storage: 95% song lyrics, 5% actual exam material.
And that 5% auto-deletes itself the night before the test.
en.editorNote: The most relatable pre-exam self-drag — post it over a photo of you spacing out with a textbook.
variations: I can nail every chorus word for word, but I can't recall the first symbol of the formula.
The corrupted sectors on my brain's hard drive are, conveniently, everything that's on the exam.

items.sourceNote: exams are like exes show up at the worst time 改寫

zh-tw.content:
考試就像前任，總在你日子過得最爽的時候突然出現。
而且每次出現，都要證明你當初真的沒準備好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑假被分科或補考打斷時最應景的吐槽，發文保證一堆人回「太真實」。
variations: 放假第三天，考試就傳訊息說「我們談談」。
你以為擺脫它了，成績單一寄到，它又回來了。

en.content:
Exams are like exes: they always show up right when life is finally going well.
And every time, they exist just to prove you were never really ready.
en.editorNote: Perfect for when a resit or summer test crashes your break — the comments will fill with 'too accurate.'
variations: Three days into vacation, the exam texts 'we need to talk.'
Just when you think you're free, the results slip arrives and drags it all back.

items.sourceNote: cramming like it's an Olympic sport 熬夜臨時抱佛腳 改寫

zh-tw.content:
臨時抱佛腳如果是奧運項目，我一定站上頒獎台。
可惜真正的考試不看你熬夜的速度，只看你到底有沒有讀進去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前熬夜的自嘲，配一張凌晨三點的桌面照，戲劇效果拉滿。
variations: 我把一學期的進度，壓縮成一個晚上的恐慌。
抱佛腳金牌選手，正式項目零分退場。

en.content:
If last-minute cramming were an Olympic event, I'd be on the podium.
Too bad the real exam doesn't score how fast you panic overnight — only whether any of it stuck.
en.editorNote: A self-deprecating all-nighter post — pair it with a 3 a.m. desk shot for full drama.
variations: I compressed an entire semester into one night of pure panic.
Gold medalist in cramming, disqualified in the actual event.

items.sourceNote: living off coffee and questionable life choices 咖啡續命 改寫

zh-tw.content:
考季的我，靠咖啡續命，靠一連串糟糕的決定活著。
睡眠？那是成績單寄到之後才有資格談的奢侈品。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考季手拿第四杯咖啡的限動必備，發完朋友都會回「保重」。
variations: 血液裡的咖啡因濃度，已經高過我對考試的信心。
我不是在讀書，我是在跟睡意打一場注定會輸的仗。

en.content:
Exam season me: running on coffee and a long list of questionable decisions.
Sleep? That's a luxury I'm only allowed once the results are in the mail.
en.editorNote: A must for that fourth-cup-of-coffee story during exam week — expect a wave of 'take care' replies.
variations: The caffeine level in my blood is now higher than my confidence in this exam.
I'm not studying, I'm just fighting a losing battle against my own eyelids.

items.sourceNote: 分科測驗 7/11-7/12 考後等放榜的空窗期 register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
分科考完了，但人生沒有比較輕鬆。
因為現在換成榜單還沒出，我卻已經在腦內模擬了三十種結局。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科測驗剛落幕、等放榜的空窗期最貼切，考生看到都會苦笑點頭。
variations: 考完那一刻很爽，第二天開始就進入無限重播錯題的地獄。
現在的我，一半在耍廢，一半在偷偷估自己的落點。

en.content:
The subject exams are over, but life isn't any lighter.
Now the scores just aren't out yet, and I've already simulated thirty different endings in my head.
en.editorNote: Nails that limbo right after the exams end and before results drop — every test-taker will nod with a bitter smile.
variations: The moment you hand it in feels great; by day two you're stuck replaying every wrong answer on loop.
Half of me is doing absolutely nothing, the other half is secretly recalculating my odds.

items.sourceNote: 登記分發最多可填 100 個志願、夢幻／目標／保守三分法的選填建議改寫

zh-tw.content:
志願可以填一百個，聽起來很自由。
實際上是把「夢想」「現實」「認命」三個階段，一次排進同一張表格裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 登記分發填志願時最有共鳴，適合貼在班群或限動配一張志願表截圖。
variations: 前十個志願是我對自己的期待，後九十個是我對自己的了解。
填到第六十個的時候，我已經開始查那間學校附近有沒有好吃的。

en.content:
You get to list a hundred choices, which sounds like freedom.
It's really just cramming "dream," "reality," and "acceptance" into one spreadsheet.
en.editorNote: Perfect for the college-choice ranking week; pairs well with a screenshot of your list.
variations: My top ten are what I hope I am. The other ninety are what I know I am.
By choice number sixty I'd stopped reading rankings and started reading the campus food reviews.

items.sourceNote: 115 分科測驗 8/3 上午開放成績查詢，改寫查分那一刻的心理狀態

zh-tw.content:
成績單早就決定好了，是我還沒準備好。
所以我把查分頁面開著，然後去洗了一個史上最乾淨的碗。
zh-tw.editorNote: 成績公告當天最貼切，適合在查分前的拖延時段發，朋友一定跳出來說「我也是」。
variations: 手指放在查詢鍵上三分鐘，這是我今年最專注的三分鐘。
查分之前先深呼吸，查分之後直接閉氣。

en.content:
The score was decided weeks ago. I'm the one who isn't ready.
So I left the results page open and went to wash the cleanest dish of my life.
en.editorNote: Made for results-day morning, right in that stalling window before you actually click.
variations: Three minutes with my finger hovering over the button — most focused I've been all year.
Deep breath before checking. Hold that breath indefinitely after.

items.sourceNote: 考後暑假規劃（打工、駕訓班、營隊）相關內容改寫成計畫落空的自嘲

zh-tw.content:
考完那天我列了暑假計畫：打工、學開車、讀三本書、練身體。
目前完成度是「成功把清單存進手機」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考後放暑假兩週左右發最準，正好是所有人計畫開始崩盤的時間點。
variations: 我的暑假計畫表現在是一份很有企圖心的許願清單。
本來要充實地過，結果我把「休息」這一項做得特別徹底。

en.content:
The day exams ended I made a summer plan: get a job, learn to drive, read three books, get in shape.
Current progress: successfully saved the list to my phone.
en.editorNote: Lands hardest about two weeks into break, right when everyone's plans quietly collapse.
variations: My summer to-do list has quietly become a very ambitious wish list.
I was going to make this summer count. So far I've only overachieved at resting.

items.sourceNote: 落點分析工具與跨考競爭墊高門檻的報導，改寫成反覆刷落點的行為

zh-tw.content:
落點分析我今天跑了十七次，數字都一樣。
但我還是相信第十八次它會突然良心發現。
zh-tw.editorNote: 等成績、排志願的期間最好用，戳中每個一直重刷落點網站的人。
variations: 同一個系統換三個網站問，得到三個一樣讓我沉默的答案。
我不是在做落點分析，我是在跟電腦討價還價。

en.content:
Ran the admissions predictor seventeen times today. Same number every time.
Still convinced round eighteen is when it finally develops a conscience.
en.editorNote: For the waiting-on-results stretch — instantly recognizable to serial score-predictor refreshers.
variations: Asked three different sites the same question and got three equally quiet answers.
This isn't analysis anymore. I'm just negotiating with a computer.

items.sourceNote: 分科測驗後至放榜期間的親友關心情境改寫

zh-tw.content:
親戚問我考得怎麼樣，我說「還可以啦」。
這三個字是我今年寫過最有技巧的申論題。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考後家庭聚餐、長輩群組關心時最好用，配一張桌上一堆菜的照片更到位。
variations: 「還在等成績」是我最近的萬用護身符，可惜只能撐到八月。
我不是不想回答，我是還沒想好要怎麼包裝這個答案。

en.content:
A relative asked how the exams went and I said, "Not bad."
Those two words are the most skillfully argued essay I've written all year.
en.editorNote: Built for post-exam family dinners and the relentless group-chat check-ins.
variations: "Still waiting on scores" is my favorite shield right now. Shame it expires in August.
It's not that I won't answer. I just haven't finished packaging the answer yet.

items.sourceNote: 考試梗圖 — 答案卡劃錯一格連環爆的經典災難 register

zh-tw.content:
打鐘前五分鐘，我才發現答案卡從第二題開始整排都往下錯了一格。
那一刻我沒有慌，我只是安靜地跟這半年的努力揮手道別。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完在群組哀嚎專用，尤其是選擇題全對但卡劃錯的類型，朋友會一邊笑一邊幫你默哀。
variations: 更痛版：「橡皮擦來不及擦，只好把整條命運交給閱卷機器。」
也能寫：「我不是不會，我是輸給了一整排錯位的黑點。」

en.content:
Five minutes before the bell, I realized every bubble from question two onward was shifted down one row.
I didn't panic. I just quietly waved goodbye to six months of effort.
en.editorNote: For the group chat meltdown when you knew every answer but filled the sheet off by one. Friends will laugh and hold a moment of silence.
variations: Darker cut: "No time to erase, so I handed my entire fate over to the scanning machine."
Also works: "It's not that I didn't know it — I lost to one column of misaligned dots."

items.sourceNote: 考試迷因 — 睡過頭鬧鐘沒響衝考場的都市傳說 register

zh-tw.content:
我人生最快的一次百米，是聽到「考試已經開始十分鐘」那個早上跑出來的。
書沒讀好沒關係，至少我證明了自己在關鍵時刻真的跑得動。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考完後回味那個差點遲到的驚魂早晨，配一張氣喘吁吁的自拍更有畫面。
variations: 加碼版：「那天我發現，恐懼比任何教練都更會逼出我的極限。」
也能換：「鬧鐘背叛我，但我的腎上腺素沒有。」

en.content:
The fastest hundred-meter dash of my life happened the morning I heard "the exam started ten minutes ago."
I may not have studied, but I proved I can genuinely move when it counts.
en.editorNote: For reliving that near-miss morning after exams are over. Pair it with a breathless selfie for full effect.
variations: Bonus: "That day I learned fear is a better coach than any human."
Swap in: "My alarm betrayed me, but my adrenaline never did."

items.sourceNote: exam memes — the neighbor who flips pages way too fast register

zh-tw.content:
我還在跟第一頁的第一題培養感情，隔壁的已經翻到最後一面。
那個翻頁的聲音，是我這輩子聽過最有殺傷力的心理攻擊。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考場焦慮共鳴款，貼在 Threads 一堆人回「這就是我」，特別是慢慢寫派的考生。
variations: 進階版：「他寫完趴著睡，我連題目都還沒看懂，我們讀的是同一份考卷嗎？」
也能寫：「隔壁翻頁的速度，讓我懷疑我拿到的是進階版考卷。」

en.content:
I was still bonding with question one on page one when the guy beside me flipped to the last page.
That page-turning sound is the most devastating psychological attack I've ever heard.
en.editorNote: Peak exam-hall anxiety relatability. Post it on Threads and every slow, careful test-taker will reply "literally me."
variations: Escalated: "He finished and put his head down to nap while I still hadn't understood the question. Same paper?"
Also: "The speed he flipped pages made me wonder if I got handed the advanced version."

items.sourceNote: 段考迷因 — 帶滿整袋文具最後只用一支筆的儀式感 register

zh-tw.content:
我帶了三支筆、兩塊橡皮擦、一把尺跟一台計算機進考場。
最後全程只用到一支筆，還有那雙一直望向窗外發呆的眼睛。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前準備儀式感滿滿、實際上都是心理安慰，貼出來一堆人默默點頭。
variations: 加碼：「準備得越齊全，越證明我把力氣都花在裝備上，沒花在腦袋裡。」
也能換：「文具是我唯一準備充分的部分。」

en.content:
I brought three pens, two erasers, a ruler, and a calculator into the exam.
In the end I only used one pen — and the pair of eyes that kept drifting toward the window.
en.editorNote: That pre-exam prep ritual that's pure emotional support. Post it and watch everyone quietly nod.
variations: Bonus: "The more thoroughly I packed, the more it proves I spent all my energy on gear, none on my brain."
Swap in: "Stationery was the only part of me that came fully prepared."

items.sourceNote: exam memes — erasing so hard you tear a hole in the answer sheet register

zh-tw.content:
改了一次又一次，最後橡皮擦在答案卷上擦出一個洞。
那個洞很誠實，它剛好標示出我對這題有多沒把握。
zh-tw.editorNote: 反覆改答案派的專屬崩潰，配一張擦到起毛球的考卷照最有感。
variations: 進階：「答案卷破了，但我對這題的信心從頭到尾都沒補起來。」
也能寫：「我不是在擦錯字，我是在擦掉一個又一個猶豫。」

en.content:
I changed my answer over and over until the eraser wore a hole clean through the sheet.
That hole is honest — it marks exactly how unsure I was about this question.
en.editorNote: The signature meltdown of chronic answer-changers. Pair with a photo of a paper rubbed fuzzy.
variations: Escalated: "The sheet tore through, and my confidence in that question never got patched either."
Also: "I wasn't erasing mistakes — I was erasing one hesitation after another."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 考試板 劃卡整排位移崩潰 register — 答案對但格子錯

zh-tw.content:
交卷前十秒，我發現答案卡從第三題就整排往下位移了一格。
所以我每一題其實都會，只是它們全部塗在錯的位置。
我不是不懂，我只是把對的答案，很認真地填到了隔壁的人生。
zh-tw.editorNote: 選擇題劃卡族的最高等級惡夢，考完 po 出來全班都會抽一口氣。配一張塗滿的答案卡照更痛。
variations: 進階版：「我會的不是題目，是怎麼把整排答案漂亮地錯開一格。」
也能寫：「答案沒錯，位置錯了，我的人生好像也是這樣。」

en.content:
Ten seconds before I hand it in, I notice my bubble sheet shifted down one row starting from question three.
So I actually knew every answer — I just filled them all one slot off.
I didn't get them wrong. I just carefully bubbled the right answers into someone else's life.
en.editorNote: The final boss of multiple-choice nightmares. Post it after the exam and the whole group chat will inhale sharply. Pairs well with a photo of a fully filled answer sheet.
variations: Escalated: "The thing I mastered wasn't the questions — it was shifting a whole column exactly one row off."
Also: "Right answers, wrong slots. Honestly, sounds like my life."

items.sourceNote: PTT 高中板 計算機考到一半沒電 register — 裝備背叛

zh-tw.content:
計算機在第七大題那一刻，安靜地熄了螢幕。
它陪我算了三年模擬考，卻選在真正要算的那天罷工。
原來最會臨陣脫逃的，不是我的記憶，是我信任的裝備。
zh-tw.editorNote: 帶計算機的考科專用崩潰，數甲、物理考生秒懂。配一張黑掉的計算機螢幕最有戲。
variations: 進階版：「它不是沒電，它是覺得這題連它都不想算。」
也能寫：「三年的感情，敗在一顆沒換的電池。」

en.content:
Right as I hit the seventh long-answer question, my calculator's screen quietly went dark.
It crunched numbers with me through three years of mocks, then picked the one day it actually mattered to quit.
Turns out the thing most likely to desert me mid-battle wasn't my memory — it was the gear I trusted.
en.editorNote: The signature meltdown for calc-permitted subjects. Physics and calc kids will feel it instantly. Pair with a photo of a dead calculator screen.
variations: Escalated: "It's not out of battery — it just decided even it didn't want to solve this one."
Also: "Three years together, undone by one battery I never changed."

items.sourceNote: Threads 考試焦慮 register — 隔壁同學翻頁比我快

zh-tw.content:
我還在第一題，隔壁同學已經翻到第三頁。
那個翻頁的聲音，比監考老師的腳步聲還讓我心慌。
原來考場裡最傷人的不是難題，是別人前進的節奏。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考場比較心理專用，考完 po 出來一堆人會說「就是我」。配一張只寫了一半的考卷更有共鳴。
variations: 進階版：「他翻頁的速度，剛好是我懷疑人生的速度。」
也能寫：「我不是寫得慢，是被隔壁的翻頁聲追著跑。」

en.content:
I'm still on question one, and the guy next to me is already flipping to page three.
That sound of turning pages rattles me more than the proctor's footsteps.
Turns out the most brutal thing in an exam room isn't the hard question — it's the sound of everyone else moving on.
en.editorNote: For the comparison-spiral in every exam room. Post it after and half the group chat will reply 'literally me.' Pairs well with a half-filled answer sheet.
variations: Escalated: "His page-turning speed is exactly the speed at which I start questioning my life."
Also: "I'm not slow — I'm just being chased by the sound of the pages next to me."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 考試板 惡夢 register — 漏寫一整面沒看到

zh-tw.content:
打鐘前一分鐘，我翻到最後才發現——
這張考卷背面還有一整面，我從頭到尾沒看到。
不是我不會寫，是我根本不知道它存在。
那一面題目，就這樣安安靜靜地，陪我坐完了整場考試。
zh-tw.editorNote: 漏寫一整面的經典惡夢，考完 po 出來留言區會擠滿「我上次也是」。配一張翻到背面的空白考卷更有戲。
variations: 進階版：「原來考卷跟人生一樣，最重要的常常寫在你沒翻到的那一面。」
也能寫：「我不是沒寫完，是那一面從頭到尾都在跟我玩躲貓貓。」

en.content:
One minute before the bell, I flipped it over and realized—
there was a whole other side to this exam I never even saw.
It's not that I couldn't do it; I didn't know it existed.
That entire page of questions just sat there quietly, keeping me company for the whole exam.
en.editorNote: The classic missed-a-whole-page nightmare. Post it after and the replies fill up with 'this was me last time.' Pairs with a photo of an exam flipped to its blank back side.
variations: Escalated: "Turns out an exam is like life — the important part is usually on the side you never flipped to."
Also: "I didn't leave it blank; that page was playing hide-and-seek with me the whole time."

items.sourceNote: 陪考家長 場外等候 register — 溫馨向感謝父母

zh-tw.content:
考場裡冷氣開很強，我卻一直想到門外的媽媽。
三十六度的太陽底下，她撐著傘站了兩小時，只為了考完能第一個遞水給我。
我這科不一定考得好，
但門外那個人，早就給了我滿分。
zh-tw.editorNote: 溫馨向的陪考家長題材，是這系列少見有溫度的一則，適合考完感謝爸媽的貼文。配一張考場外家長等候的照片。
variations: 進階版：「我在跟考卷奮鬥，她在跟太陽奮鬥，其實我們是同一隊的。」
也能寫：「考卷會發回來，但她站的那兩小時不會，我想好好記得。」

en.content:
The AC in the exam room was freezing, but I kept thinking about my mom outside.
Under a 97-degree sun she stood for two hours with an umbrella, just to be the first to hand me a bottle of water when I walked out.
I might not ace this subject —
but the person waiting at the door already gave me full marks.
en.editorNote: A warmer, gratitude-toward-parents piece — rare tenderness for this series. Great for a post thanking your family after the exam. Pairs with a photo of parents waiting outside the exam hall.
variations: Escalated: "I was fighting the exam, she was fighting the sun — turns out we were on the same team."
Also: "The exam gets handed back to me; those two hours she stood there don't. I want to remember them."

items.sourceNote: 考前諧音供品/禁忌 register — 包中、別帶蛋和烏龍茶

zh-tw.content:
考前我媽往我書包塞了包子跟粽子，說這樣才會「包中」。
又警告我：「別帶蛋，也別喝烏龍茶。」
免得考出「滿江紅」加「一顆蛋」還「鬧烏龍」。
我發現，我這科的複習時間，全被拿去研究供品的諧音了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 台灣考試民俗諧音梗專用，長輩塞供品的畫面全國考生都經歷過。適合考前發文娛樂親友。配一張包子粽子擺書桌的照片。
variations: 進階版：「知識我沒背起來，但這套諧音吉祥話我倒是滾瓜爛熟。」
也能寫：「靠實力不行，只好靠包子——反正它們比我可靠。」

en.content:
Before the exam my mom stuffed a steamed bun and a rice dumpling into my bag — in Mandarin their names sound like "guaranteed to pass."
Then she warned me: no eggs, no oolong tea.
God forbid I score a zero (an "egg") and bungle the whole thing (an "oolong").
I realized I'd spent all my review time studying the puns on lucky snacks instead.
en.editorNote: For Taiwan's exam-superstition pun humor — every student has had a relative cram lucky food into their bag. Great for a lighthearted pre-exam post to amuse family. Pairs with a photo of lucky snacks piled on a desk.
variations: Escalated: "I didn't memorize the material, but I've got the lucky-food puns down cold."
Also: "Skill wasn't an option, so I'm betting on the buns — they're more reliable than me anyway."

items.sourceNote: 考場 提前交卷離場 register — 全場抬頭看他的背影

zh-tw.content:
考試才過二十分鐘，前面那位就舉手交卷、瀟灑走人。
全場的筆都停了半秒，一起抬頭看他的背影。
我不知道他是天才還是放棄了，
但那個背影，成了整場考試最讓我分心的一題。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考場裡「第一個交卷離場」的經典場景，猜他是學神還是躺平引發全場遐想。考完發文一堆人有同款回憶。配一張空座位的照片。
variations: 進階版：「他走的是考場的門，帶走的是我剩下的專注力。」
也能寫：「我到現在都想不通：他是全會，還是全不會？這題比考卷還難。」

en.content:
Twenty minutes in, the guy up front raised his hand, turned in his paper, and strolled out.
Every pen in the room froze for half a second as we all looked up at his back.
I couldn't tell if he was a genius or had given up —
but that departing figure became the most distracting question of the whole exam.
en.editorNote: The classic 'first person to hand it in and leave' scene — everyone silently debates whether they're a prodigy or just quit. Post it after and plenty will share the same memory. Pairs with a photo of an empty seat.
variations: Escalated: "He walked out the exam-room door and took the last of my focus with him."
Also: "I still can't figure it out: did he know everything, or nothing? That's harder than anything on the paper."

items.sourceNote: 考後 準考證捨不得丟 register — 皮夾裡的過期門票 frame

zh-tw.content:
考完十天了，準考證還躺在我皮夾裡。
上面那張照片是三月拍的，那時候的我以為自己會準備得更好。
我不是忘了拿出來，
我只是還沒想好，要用什麼心情把它丟掉。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完到成績公布中間那段日子的心情，配一張皮夾裡準考證的照片發限動，同屆的都會安靜按讚。
variations: 可以加：「它已經沒有用了，但我還沒準備好承認這件事。」
也能改：「一張過期的門票，我卻還留著，好像這樣那半年就不算白過。」

en.content:
Ten days after the exam, my admission ticket is still sitting in my wallet.
The photo on it was taken in March, back when I still thought I'd be more prepared than this.
It's not that I forgot to take it out.
I just haven't decided what mood I'm supposed to be in when I throw it away.
en.editorNote: For the limbo between finishing the exam and getting your score. Pair it with a photo of the ticket in your wallet and everyone from your year will quietly like it.
variations: Add: "It's useless now, but I'm not ready to admit that yet."
Try: "An expired ticket I keep anyway, like holding it proves those six months counted."

items.sourceNote: 成年人仍會夢到考試 register — 畢業多年的低頻惡夢在地化

zh-tw.content:
我叔叔今年三十八歲，他說他到現在還會夢到明天要考試，而他一頁都沒念。
每次醒來都要花三秒，才確認自己已經畢業十六年了。
所以考試不會真的結束，
它只是換成一種比較低頻的形式，繼續住在你腦子裡繳房租。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考生看了會冒冷汗、大人看了會轉發的雙棲梗，適合發在混齡的社群或家族群組。
variations: 可以加：「畢業證書只保證你離開學校，不保證考試離開你。」
也能改：「夢裡我永遠是那個沒念書的自己，而且永遠只剩一個晚上。」

en.content:
My uncle is thirty-eight and he says he still dreams that there's an exam tomorrow and he hasn't opened a single page.
Every time, it takes him three seconds after waking to confirm he graduated sixteen years ago.
So exams never really end.
They just switch to a lower frequency and keep paying rent inside your head.
en.editorNote: A two-audience joke: students get chills, adults hit share. Great for mixed-age feeds or the family group chat.
variations: Add: "A diploma proves you left school. It doesn't prove school left you."
Try: "In the dream I'm always the version who didn't study, and it's always the night before."

items.sourceNote: 考後 參考書傳給學弟妹 register — 滿頁螢光筆是重來的證據 frame

zh-tw.content:
我把整箱參考書送給學弟，他很客氣地說謝謝。
翻開第一頁看到滿滿的螢光筆，他愣了一下：「學長你畫這麼多喔？」
我笑一笑，沒解釋。
那些線不是重點，
是我每一次「這次一定要開始認真」留下的證據。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完清書桌那天的後座力，前三頁特別花的人都懂。配一張堆成山的參考書照片。
variations: 可以加：「每本書的前三章都很漂亮，後面乾淨得像新的一樣。」
也能改：「我送出去的不是書，是十七個沒撐過三天的讀書計畫。」

en.content:
I gave my whole box of study guides to a junior, and he politely said thanks.
He opened the first page, saw the highlighter everywhere, and paused. "Wow, you marked up a lot."
I just smiled and didn't explain.
Those lines weren't key points.
They were evidence of every single time I told myself this was the week I'd finally get serious.
en.editorNote: The quiet gut-punch of cleaning out your desk after the exam. Anyone whose first three chapters are neon and the rest untouched will feel it. Pairs with a photo of the book stack.
variations: Add: "The first three chapters of every book are gorgeous. The rest look brand new."
Try: "I didn't hand down books. I handed down seventeen study plans that didn't survive the week."

items.sourceNote: 115 分科測驗 8/3 公告成績、8/5-8/8 登記志願 register — 保底科系翻身 frame

zh-tw.content:
排志願的時候，我把那個原本看不上的科系放在最後一格。
結果查著查著，我發現它的課還蠻有趣的，出路也沒有大人說的那麼慘。
原來所謂的保底，
不是退而求其次，
是我從頭到尾都沒有認真看過它。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分科成績八月三號才公告、八月五到八號登記志願，這段研究校系的空窗期最適合發。給正在排序的同屆一點正向的提醒。
variations: 可以加：「排在最後一格的，不代表它不好，只代表我認識它最晚。」
也能改：「志願表的順序是我排的，但喜歡哪一個，要等我真的了解才知道。」

en.content:
When I built my preference list, I stuck the major I'd always looked down on in the very last slot.
Then I actually read about it — the courses sounded interesting, and the career paths weren't the disaster adults kept describing.
Turns out a safety school isn't settling for less.
It's just the one I never bothered to look at properly.
en.editorNote: Subject-exam scores drop August 3 and preference registration runs August 5-8, so this lands right in the researching window. A genuinely encouraging note for classmates ranking their list.
variations: Add: "Last on the list doesn't mean worst. It means I met it last."
Try: "I decided the order, but which one I actually like is something I can only learn by looking closer."

items.sourceNote: 考完走出校門 蟬鳴回來 register — 這半年腦袋裡沒位置放夏天 frame

zh-tw.content:
考完走出校門那天，我才發現樹上的蟬已經叫了一整個夏天。
那個聲音一直都在，只是這半年我腦袋裡塞滿題目，沒有位置放它。
我站在門口聽了兩分鐘，
這是我今年第一次，覺得七月真的是七月。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完那種世界突然恢復音量的感覺，適合走出考場那天發文，配一張抬頭拍樹的照片。
variations: 可以加：「夏天沒有等我，它只是很有耐心地一直在外面響著。」
也能改：「我不是重新聽見蟬叫，是終於有空聽了。」

en.content:
The day I walked out the school gate for the last time, I noticed the cicadas had been going all summer.
The sound was always there. I just had no room for it — my head was full of practice questions for six months straight.
I stood at the gate and listened for two minutes.
It was the first time all year that July actually felt like July.
en.editorNote: That moment when the world turns its volume back up after your last exam. Post it the day you walk out, with a photo shot straight up into the trees.
variations: Add: "Summer wasn't waiting for me. It was just patiently going on outside without me."
Try: "I didn't start hearing the cicadas again. I finally had time to."

items.sourceNote: 大學面試 自我介紹背稿 register — 練一百遍進場前一秒忘光 frame

zh-tw.content:
自我介紹我在鏡子前練了一百遍，語氣、停頓、微笑都排練好了。
門一開，教授說：「請開始。」
我：「呃⋯⋯大家好，我叫⋯⋯」
然後我連自己名字都要想一下。
zh-tw.editorNote: 跑完面試那天回家路上發文最有共鳴，配一張皺掉的自介小抄照片更慘更好笑。
variations: 可以加：「我準備了三分鐘的稿，只用了三秒鐘證明它全部還給鏡子了。」
也能改：「排練時我是 TED 講者，進場後我是剛學會講話的人。」

en.content:
I rehearsed my intro a hundred times in the mirror — tone, pauses, the smile, all blocked out.
The door opens. The professor says, "Whenever you're ready."
Me: "Uh... hi everyone, my name is..."
And then I had to think about my own name.
en.editorNote: Post it on the walk home after your interview. Bonus points for a photo of your crumpled cue card.
variations: Add: "I prepared a three-minute speech and used three seconds to prove I left all of it in the mirror."
Try: "In rehearsal I was a TED speaker. In the room I was a toddler learning to talk."

items.sourceNote: 大學面試 神題「為什麼選我們系」register — 誠實答案 vs 得體答案 對照 frame

zh-tw.content:
教授：「為什麼選我們系？」
心裡的答案：因為落點分析只有你們願意收我。
嘴巴的答案：「因為我從小就對這個領域充滿熱情。」
教授點頭微笑，我們都知道彼此在演什麼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 面試前一晚在讀書計畫寫不出動機時發，同屆全都心照不宣地按愛心。
variations: 可以加：「熱情是真的，只是它昨天才在落點分析裡誕生。」
也能改：「教授問動機，我把『能上』翻譯成『嚮往』，這就是文組的實力。」

en.content:
Professor: "Why did you choose our department?"
The honest answer: because you were the only one my admission-odds calculator said would take me.
The out-loud answer: "I've been passionate about this field since I was a kid."
The professor nods and smiles. We both know exactly what's happening here.
en.editorNote: Post it the night before your interview, mid-way through failing to write your statement of purpose. Classmates will silently smash the like button.
variations: Add: "The passion is real. It was just born yesterday, inside a percentile chart."
Try: "He asked for my motivation. I translated 'I can get in' into 'I've always dreamed of this.'"

items.sourceNote: 115 分科測驗 首度金屬探測防作弊新制 register — 全身被掃唯獨實力沒被偵測到 frame

zh-tw.content:
今年進考場多了一關金屬探測，試務人員從頭到腳掃過我一遍。
嗶嗶聲沒響，一切正常。
只是掃了半天，唯一沒被偵測到的，
是我這一整年到底有沒有把書讀進去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 今年首度上路的金屬探測新制超好發揮，走進考場那天發限動，同屆秒懂。
variations: 可以加：「機器說我身上沒有違禁品，也順便確認了我身上沒有實力。」
也能改：「探測器嗶都不嗶，因為它掃不到不存在的東西。」

en.content:
This year they added a metal-detector check at the exam hall — staff scanned me head to toe.
No beep. All clear.
The one thing the scan couldn't detect, after all that,
was whether any of this year's studying actually made it into my head.
en.editorNote: The brand-new metal-detector rule is easy comedy gold. Post it as a story the day you walk in — classmates get it instantly.
variations: Add: "The machine confirmed I had no contraband. It also confirmed I had no knowledge."
Try: "The detector didn't beep once. You can't detect something that isn't there."

items.sourceNote: 大學面試 場外等候區 register — 隔壁陌生人既是對手也是戰友 溫馨 frame

zh-tw.content:
面試等候區裡，我旁邊坐了一個一樣緊張的陌生人。
我們沒講幾句話，但他遞了一顆喉糖給我，說：「等下加油。」
進場前我才想通，
我們填了同一個志願，是對手沒錯，
但在這條路上願意先對你好的人，往往也走得最遠。
zh-tw.editorNote: 面試那天在等候區真的會遇到這種人，適合考後回顧時發，帶點溫度不煽情。
variations: 可以加：「我們搶同一個名額，卻先分了一顆糖，這件事我大概會記很久。」
也能改：「對手不一定是敵人，有時候只是跟你一樣怕的人。」

en.content:
In the interview waiting room, a stranger just as nervous as me sat down next to me.
We barely spoke, but he handed me a throat lozenge and said, "Good luck in there."
Right before my name was called, it clicked:
we'd applied for the same spot, so yeah, we were rivals —
but the people willing to be kind to you first usually go the furthest on this road.
en.editorNote: You really do meet someone like this in the waiting room. Great for a reflective post after interviews — warm without being sappy.
variations: Add: "We were fighting for the same seat and still split a lozenge. I'll probably remember that for a long time."
Try: "A rival isn't always an enemy. Sometimes they're just as scared as you are."

items.sourceNote: TikTok exam-stress meme — 'brain leaving during exam' 迷因 register，改成腦袋請假的擬人版

zh-tw.content:
打開考卷的那一刻，我清楚看見我的腦袋站起來、跟我揮了揮手，然後走出考場。
它說它去外面透透氣，結果打完鐘才回來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完發廢文的萬用款，配一張放空的自拍剛好，朋友秒懂秒按。
variations: 換句話說：「考卷發下來的瞬間，我大腦自動登出，還順便清了快取。」
也能改：「我的知識都在，只是它們集體請了那兩小時的假。」

en.content:
The second I opened the paper, I watched my brain stand up, wave goodbye, and walk out of the exam room.
It said it needed some air. It came back right after the bell.
en.editorNote: The universal post-exam caption. Pair it with a blank-stare selfie and the group chat gets it instantly.
variations: Or: "Test lands on my desk, brain logs out, clears its cache, takes a two-hour break."
Try: "All my knowledge showed up. It just requested those two hours off."

items.sourceNote: 分科測驗考後檢討 register — 唯一跳過的冷門章節反而大考的墨菲定律 frame

zh-tw.content:
我複習時只跳過了一個小章節，想說「這麼冷門，怎麼可能考」。
結果那一章不只考了，還是整份考卷分數最高的大題。
我開始懷疑，出題老師是不是偷看了我的讀書計畫。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完檢討最有共鳴的一款，貼在讀書社團底下取暖兼引戰都合適。
variations: 換句話說：「我沒讀的地方，出題老師都特別捧場。」
也能改：「越是心想『這不會考』，它越要出來跟你打招呼。」

en.content:
During review I skipped exactly one tiny chapter — figured it was too obscure to ever show up.
Not only did it show up, it was the highest-scoring question on the whole paper.
I'm starting to think the exam writer read my study plan.
en.editorNote: The most relatable post-mortem line. Great dropped under a study-group post.
variations: Or: "Whatever I skipped, the exam writer personally endorsed."
Try: "The louder I think 'this won't be on the test,' the harder it waves hello."

items.sourceNote: 考後看名師解題影片 register — 'suddenly I got it, one exam too late' 的失憶 frame

zh-tw.content:
考完當晚我點開名師的解題影片，老師三兩下就把那題講完。
我看得頻頻點頭，心裡只有一個念頭：
這麼簡單，你早八個小時來我腦袋裡講一次會怎樣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考後對答案系列必備，貼給同樣熬夜看解題的戰友最有感。
variations: 換句話說：「老師一講我全懂了，可惜懂的時機晚了一整場考試。」
也能改：「原來我不是不會，我只是在考場當下暫時失憶。」

en.content:
The night after the exam I opened a tutor's solution video. He cracked that question in about ten seconds.
I kept nodding along, one thought looping in my head:
if it's that easy, could you have popped into my brain eight hours earlier?
en.editorNote: A must for the post-exam answer-checking spiral. Send it to the friend who's also up watching solution videos.
variations: Or: "He explained it and suddenly I got it — one whole exam too late."
Try: "Turns out I did know it. I just had temporary amnesia in the exam room."

items.sourceNote: 考後療癒 register — 'celebrate small victories' 慶祝考完，改寫成第一餐犒賞自己的溫暖 frame

zh-tw.content:
考完最後一科，我做的第一件事不是查答案，是去吃一碗惦記了整個學期的滷肉飯。
那一口下去，我忽然懂了——
書可以之後再讀，但這半年被我欠下的每一頓好好吃飯，今天要開始還了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考後療癒款，帶點溫度不煽情，適合考完那天發限動配一張食物照。
variations: 可以加：「分數還沒出來，但這碗飯我先給自己滿分。」
也能改：「熬過來的獎勵不必等成績，先從一頓熱飯開始。」

en.content:
After the last subject, the first thing I did wasn't check answers — it was go eat the bowl of braised pork rice I'd been craving all semester.
One bite in, it hit me:
books can wait, but every proper meal I skipped these six months? I start paying that back today.
en.editorNote: A warm post-exam pick, genuine without being sappy. Perfect for a story with a food photo the day you finish.
variations: Add: "Scores aren't out yet, but this bowl gets a perfect grade from me."
Try: "The reward for making it through doesn't wait for results — it starts with one hot meal."

items.sourceNote: 'exams are the adult version of hide and seek' 迷因 — 答案躲起來 frame 在地化改寫

zh-tw.content:
考試根本是成年版的躲貓貓。
差別在於：躲起來的不是人，是答案。
而且它們躲得超專業，我找了一整節課，一個都沒抓到。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考選擇題卡關時的最佳 OS，考完發限動配張抓頭的照片，同學秒懂秒笑。
variations: 可以加：「更慘的是，交卷鈴一響，它們全部從椅子底下探頭出來對我笑。」
也能改：「答案：你找不到我。我：我知道，我連題目在問什麼都還沒找到。」

en.content:
Exams are just the adult version of hide and seek.
The twist: it's not people hiding — it's the answers.
And they're pros. I searched the whole period and didn't catch a single one.
en.editorNote: Peak inner monologue when a multiple-choice question stumps you. Post it with a head-scratching selfie after the exam.
variations: Add: "Worst part: the second the bell rings, they all pop out from under the desk and grin at me."
Try: "Answer: you'll never find me. Me: I know, I haven't even found what the question is asking yet."

items.sourceNote: 考後對答案兩派人 register — 立刻對 vs 封鎖話題 對照句型

zh-tw.content:
考完的人分成兩種：
一種走出考場就開始對答案，痛得很即時。
另一種把整個科目靜音一個月，痛得很延後。
我屬於第三種：邊說「絕對不要對」邊點開解答，然後當場後悔。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考後群組必引發共鳴的分類文，留言區會自動排隊認領自己是第幾種。
variations: 可以加：「第四種：對到一半發現錯太多，果斷關機，假裝剛剛什麼都沒看到。」
也能縮成：「勇敢的人立刻對答案，聰明的人一個月後才對，而我兩種痛都要。」

en.content:
People after an exam come in two types:
one checks answers the second they walk out — pain, real-time.
The other mutes the entire subject for a month — pain, deferred.
I'm the third type: I say "absolutely not checking" while opening the answer key, and regret it on the spot.
en.editorNote: The post-exam personality-test caption. Group chat will line up to claim which type they are.
variations: Add: "Type four: checks halfway, sees too many wrong, powers off, pretends none of that happened."
Shorter: "Brave people check right away, smart people check a month later, and I signed up for both kinds of pain."

items.sourceNote: 國寫作文抽象題目梗 — 題目比未來還抽象 frame，避免指名特定年度題目

zh-tw.content:
國寫作文的題目，永遠比我的未來還抽象。
我盯著它，它盯著我，一場沒有贏家的對看。
最後我在稿紙上寫下的，不是我的想法，
是我這輩子最會的技能——硬掰。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完國寫的通用崩潰句，不綁特定題目，年年都能拿出來用，配張空白稿紙照更有戲。
variations: 可以加：「閱卷老師：這篇在寫什麼？我：老師，我當初也很想知道。」
也能改：「題目要我談人生，我連早餐吃什麼都還沒想好。」

en.content:
The essay prompt is always more abstract than my actual future.
I stared at it, it stared at me — a contest with no winner.
What I finally put on the page wasn't my thoughts,
it was the one skill I've truly mastered: winging it beautifully.
en.editorNote: Universal post-essay meltdown line — not tied to any one prompt, so it works every exam season. Pairs great with a photo of blank ruled paper.
variations: Add: "Grader: what is this essay about? Me: honestly, I'd love to know too."
Try: "The prompt asked about the meaning of life. I haven't even decided on breakfast."

items.sourceNote: 檢查考卷改掉正確答案 register — 第一直覺才是對的 在地化 frame

zh-tw.content:
檢查考卷是一種自我傷害。
第一次寫，直覺選了對的。
檢查時越看越心虛，把它改成了錯的。
人生最遠的距離，就是我橡皮擦跟正確答案之間的那三公分。
zh-tw.editorNote: 對完答案發現被自己害死的考生專用，發文保證一堆人跳出來說「這就是我」。
variations: 可以加：「原本要 A，檢查改 C，公布答案是 A。原來我第一次就贏了，是我不信自己。」
也能縮成：「相信直覺會後悔，不信直覺後悔更大，總之就是要後悔。」

en.content:
Double-checking your exam is a form of self-harm.
First pass, my gut picked the right answer.
During the check I got nervous, second-guessed it, and erased it into the wrong one.
The longest distance in life is the three centimeters between my eraser and the correct answer.
en.editorNote: For the student who realizes they sabotaged themselves after checking answers. Post it and watch everyone reply "this is literally me."
variations: Add: "Had A, changed it to C on review, answer was A. I won the first time — I just didn't trust myself."
Shorter: "Trust your gut and regret it, ignore your gut and regret it more. Either way, regret is on the menu."

items.sourceNote: 115分科測驗成績公布與複查期程（8/3 公布、8/3-8/6 複查）— 申請複查的心理 frame

zh-tw.content:
我認真考慮要不要申請成績複查。
不是覺得他們算錯，是想找個人再幫我看一次，
順便看看有沒有奇蹟藏在某一格裡。
後來我才想通：
我想複查的不是分數，是那個以為自己會考更好的我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 成績公布後那幾天的複查猶豫期專用，發在班群或限動，一堆人會默默按讚不留言。
variations: 可以加：「複查費我出得起，重考一次的勇氣我暫時付不起。」
也能縮成：「我不是懷疑他們算錯，我只是很想再確認一次，我真的只有這樣。」

en.content:
I'm seriously considering requesting a score recheck.
Not because I think they added it wrong — I just want someone to look at it one more time,
in case a miracle is hiding in one of those boxes.
Then it hit me:
the thing I want rechecked isn't my score. It's the version of me who thought he'd do better.
en.editorNote: For the few days after scores drop when you're hovering over the recheck form. Post it and watch the silent likes roll in.
variations: Add: "I can afford the recheck fee. The courage to sit the whole thing again? Not in this budget."
Shorter: "I don't think they miscounted. I just really want to confirm that this is genuinely all I had."

items.sourceNote: 考完到放榜之間的空窗期 register — 八月行事曆只剩幾個關鍵日期、無法排任何行程的懸空感

zh-tw.content:
媽問我八月要不要跟家人出去玩。
我說我八月有事。
她問什麼事，我愣了三秒才發現，
我的「有事」是：等一個數字、填一張表、再等一次榜單。
整個月的行事曆只有三個日期，中間全是空白跟心跳。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完但還沒放榜那段懸空期的最佳寫照，配一張空白月曆截圖特別有畫面。
variations: 可以加：「別人的八月有行程，我的八月有期程。」
也能改：「我不是沒空，我是被三個日期綁架，還不敢跟它們談條件。」

en.content:
Mom asked if I want to travel with the family in August.
I said I'm busy in August.
She asked with what, and it took me three seconds to realize
my "busy" is: wait for a number, fill out one form, wait for one list.
My whole month has three dates on it. Everything between them is blank space and heart rate.
en.editorNote: Nails the limbo between finishing the exam and getting results. Pair it with a screenshot of an empty calendar.
variations: Add: "Other people's August has plans. Mine has deadlines."
Try: "I'm not unavailable. I'm being held hostage by three dates and I'm scared to negotiate."

items.sourceNote: 登記分發志願送出前的猶豫 register — 「確認送出」按鈕沒有標準答案的對照 frame

zh-tw.content:
志願排好了，游標停在「確認送出」上面。
我看著它看了三分鐘。
考試再難，至少後面有標準答案。
這張表沒有。
按下去的那一秒，我手心的汗比考數學那天還多——
原來最難的一題，不是選出對的，是承認沒有人知道哪個才是對的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 登記分發截止前的共鳴款，貼在班群保證一排人回「我也還沒敢按」。
variations: 可以加：「存檔十七次，送出一次，然後失眠一整晚。」
也能縮成：「這是我人生第一張沒有解答本的考卷。」

en.content:
My list is ranked. The cursor is sitting on "confirm and submit."
I stared at it for three minutes.
No matter how brutal an exam is, there's an answer key waiting somewhere.
This form doesn't have one.
The second I clicked, my palms were sweatier than they were on math day —
turns out the hardest question isn't picking the right answer. It's admitting nobody knows which one is right.
en.editorNote: The universal caption before the placement deadline. Drop it in the group chat and watch people confess they haven't clicked either.
variations: Add: "Saved seventeen drafts, submitted once, then lay awake all night."
Shorter: "First test of my life that doesn't come with an answer key in the back."

items.sourceNote: 2026 考生用 AI 做落點分析與選填諮詢的新習慣 — AI 給出分析卻附上一句鼓勵的溫暖反轉

zh-tw.content:
凌晨兩點，我把分數跟想讀的科系丟給 AI，問它我到底上得了哪裡。
它很認真地列了一長串校系，最後多打了一句：
「不管結果如何，你已經走完很難的一段路了。」
我盯著那行字看了很久。
我要的明明是分析，那天真正接住我的，卻是一句不用計算的話。
zh-tw.editorNote: 落點分析焦慮期的療癒款，有溫度但不說教，適合深夜發文或傳給也在熬夜排志願的朋友。
variations: 可以加：「我問了三個 AI 同一個問題，只有那句鼓勵我截圖留下來。」
也能改：「數字算得出我能去哪裡，算不出我這半年撐得多辛苦。」

en.content:
Two in the morning, I fed my scores and dream majors to an AI and asked where I could actually get in.
It produced a very thorough list, then added one more line:
"Whatever the outcome, you've already finished a genuinely hard stretch."
I sat with that sentence for a long time.
I came for the analysis. What actually caught me that night was the one part that required no math.
en.editorNote: A warm pick for the placement-anxiety spiral. Send it to the friend who's also up at 2am reordering their list.
variations: Add: "Asked three different AIs the same question. The only thing I screenshotted was the encouragement."
Try: "The numbers can calculate where I get to go. They can't calculate how hard these six months were."

items.sourceNote: 考完等放榜期間的身分空窗 register — 「還沒被決定的夏天」正向重新框架

zh-tw.content:
這個夏天，我沒有學校、沒有作業、也沒有一個能寫在自我介紹裡的身分。
聽起來很不安，但我後來想通了：
這大概是我人生最後一個，什麼都還沒被決定的夏天。
既然還沒被決定，那這幾個禮拜，我就先照自己想要的樣子過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 等放榜期間的正向款，適合心情低落時發文，也很適合當畢業季的收尾語錄。
variations: 可以加：「以後每個夏天都會有身分，只有這個夏天是我自己的。」
也能縮成：「還沒被決定，不等於沒有方向，只是還沒有人幫我寫好。」

en.content:
This summer I have no school, no assignments, and no title I could put in an introduction.
It sounds unsettling, but here's what I landed on:
this is probably the last summer of my life where nothing has been decided yet.
And since nothing's decided, I'm spending these few weeks being exactly who I want to be.
en.editorNote: The hopeful one for the waiting-on-results stretch. Works as a low-day post and as a graduation-season closer.
variations: Add: "Every summer after this comes with a label. This one is just mine."
Shorter: "Undecided isn't the same as directionless. It just means nobody's written it for me yet."

items.sourceNote: 115 分科測驗 7/13、7/14 考完，成績單 8/3 才寄發；針對七月底這段「考完了但還沒拿到分數」的空窗期原創撰寫，主題是把一年的努力量化成看得見的東西

zh-tw.content:
今天整理書桌，把那個玻璃罐倒出來——
裡面全是這一年寫完的筆芯，數了一下，四十七支。
成績單還要好幾天才寄到，
但這四十七支不需要等任何人公布。
它們早就躺在罐子裡，安安靜靜地，替我簽好了名。
zh-tw.editorNote: 等成績那幾天最適合發的正向款，也很適合送給正在懷疑「我這一年到底有沒有進步」的人。有實體物件可以拍照，限動配圖很好用。
variations: 可以縮成：「我不確定考幾分，但我確定這一年用完了四十七支筆芯。」
也可以換成：「筆芯不會說謊，它記得每一個我真的坐下來的晚上。」

en.content:
Cleaned my desk today and dumped out the jar —
every pen refill I burned through this year. Forty-seven of them.
Scores don't get mailed out for a few more days.
But those forty-seven aren't waiting on anyone to announce them.
They've been sitting in that jar the whole time, quietly signing off on my year.
en.editorNote: The good one for the waiting-on-results stretch, and for anyone wondering whether the year counted. Bonus: it comes with a photo you can actually take.
variations: Shorter: "No idea what I scored. I do know I went through forty-seven pen refills."
Or: "Pen refills don't lie. They remember every night I actually sat down."

items.sourceNote: 參考 Dcard 升大學考試板學長姐寫給下一屆學弟妹的心得文氛圍，重寫成原創情境：考完回自習室，發現固定座位已經換人坐

zh-tw.content:
考完兩個星期，我回自習室拿忘記帶走的水壺。
靠窗第三個位子，已經坐了一個穿別校制服的學弟，
桌上攤著跟我一樣的講義，還剛好翻在我當年卡最久的那一章。
我沒吵他，拿了水壺就走。
那個位子從來就不是我的，
它只是輪流借給每一個還在努力的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考完回頭看那段日子時發長文，也很適合學長姐寫給下一屆的學弟妹當開場。溫度夠但不說教。
variations: 可以縮成：「靠窗第三個位子換了新主人，那一章他一定也會卡很久。」
也可以換成：「原來我不是離開自習室，我是把位子交出去。」

en.content:
Two weeks after my last exam I went back to the study room for a water bottle I'd left behind.
Third seat by the window — some kid in a different school's uniform now,
same workbook I used, open to the exact chapter that used to wreck me.
I didn't say anything. Grabbed the bottle and left.
That seat was never mine.
It just gets lent out, one year at a time, to whoever's still trying.
en.editorNote: For the reflective post a couple weeks out, or as an opener when you're writing advice for the next batch of test-takers. Warm without lecturing.
variations: Shorter: "Third seat by the window has a new owner. That chapter's gonna wreck him too."
Or: "I didn't leave the study room. I handed the seat over."

items.sourceNote: 115 分科測驗落幕相關報導提供時序背景（7/14 考完、8/3 成績），情境為原創：考完之後經過自己的考場，發現它只是一所普通學校

zh-tw.content:
昨天騎車經過我的考場。
考試那兩天，我覺得它是一座競技場，連門口那排樹都長得很嚴肅。
昨天下午四點，有人在操場打排球，有人在校門口買飲料，
警衛坐在椅子上打瞌睡。
原來它一直只是一所普通的學校，
是我自己在那兩天，把它想得那麼可怕。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完心情終於落地時發的自嘲款，也可以拿來安慰下一屆：那個地方沒有你想像的那麼巨大。
variations: 可以縮成：「考完再看那所學校，連圍牆都變矮了。」
也可以換成：「那兩天它是競技場，其他三百六十三天，它只是別人上課的地方。」

en.content:
Rode past my exam site yesterday.
On test days I was convinced it was a coliseum — even the trees out front looked serious.
Yesterday at 4pm: kids playing volleyball on the field, someone buying a slushie at the gate,
the security guard dozing in his chair.
Turns out it was always just a school.
I'm the one who spent two days making it terrifying.
en.editorNote: The self-aware one for when your nerves finally come back down, and a decent thing to tell next year's test-takers: that place is smaller than it looks.
variations: Shorter: "Went back to look at the school. Even the walls got shorter."
Or: "Two days a year it's a coliseum. The other 363, it's just where people go to class."

items.sourceNote: 115分科測驗時程：8/3寄發成績通知單、8/5-8/8登記分發志願、8/17放榜；改寫為等成績期間的自嘲

zh-tw.content:
我把手機鬧鐘設在八月三號早上八點。
那天不用考試、不用上課、不用去任何地方，
成績也不會因為我早起就變好看一點。
但我還是設了。
考完到現在，我唯一還維持著的紀律，
就是準時去接住一個我很怕的數字。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合成績公布前那幾天發限動，或跟同屆互相取暖時貼給對方看。等待比考試本身更磨人，這句把那種說不出口的緊張講白。
variations: 短版：「那天不用早起，我還是設了鬧鐘。怕的東西，我想自己親手開門讓它進來。」
另一種說法：「考完最忙的不是身體，是每天早上醒來想起還有幾天要等。」

en.content:
I set my phone alarm for 8 a.m. on results day.
No exam that morning, no class, nowhere I have to be,
and my score isn't going to look any better because I got up early.
I set it anyway.
Since the last test, the only discipline I've kept
is showing up on time to catch a number I'm scared of.
en.editorNote: Post this in the last few days before scores drop, or send it to a friend in the same waiting room. The wait grinds harder than the exam did.
variations: Short: "Didn't need to be up early. Set the alarm anyway. If it's coming, I want to open the door myself."
Or: "The exhausting part isn't the exam. It's waking up every morning and counting the days left."

items.sourceNote: 115分科測驗因颱風巴威首度延期兩天，考生原訂考後出國行程被打亂、機票住宿全亂；改寫為自嘲

zh-tw.content:
考前我排了一份「考完立刻出發」的行程表。
幾點的車、哪一攤先吃、哪個景點待多久，全部標得清清楚楚。
後來考試往後推了兩天，機票整組作廢。
最好笑的是——
那份行程表，是我這一年做過最完整、也最捨得執行的計畫。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合行程被打亂的考生自嘲，也適合任何「玩的計畫做得比讀書計畫細」的人。用輕鬆的方式承認自己把熱情放在哪裡。
variations: 短版：「讀書計畫寫三行，旅遊行程寫三頁。我的執行力一直都在，只是挑對象。」
另一種說法：「行程表全部作廢那天我才發現，我為那趟旅行做的準備，比為考試多。」

en.content:
Before the exam I built a leave-the-second-it-ends itinerary.
Which train, which food stall first, how long at each stop — all of it, down to the minute.
Then the test got pushed back two days and the whole booking went in the bin.
The funny part:
that itinerary was the most complete plan I made all year, and the only one I actually wanted to follow.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose post-exam trip got wrecked by a reschedule, and for everyone whose vacation planning is ten times more detailed than their study planning.
variations: Short: "Study plan: three lines. Trip plan: three pages. My follow-through works fine, it's just picky."
Or: "When the tickets got voided I realized I'd prepared harder for that trip than for the exam."

items.sourceNote: 分科成績8/3公布前的空窗期，考生反覆研究校系資料；改寫為口是心非的自嘲

zh-tw.content:
我沒有在查落點。
我只是滑手機滑到一半，手指不小心點進某個系的課程地圖，
然後不小心把四年的必修看完，
再不小心點開宿舍照片跟學校後門那條宵夜街。
真的沒有在查，
我只是在替一個還不確定屬不屬於我的未來，先偷偷看房。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分數還沒出來、志願還沒登記的那幾天最適合。寫給嘴上說「不敢想」、瀏覽紀錄卻誠實得可怕的人。
variations: 短版：「我不是在查校系，我只是連續三天不小心點進同一個頁面。」
另一種說法：「我的瀏覽紀錄比我的嘴巴誠實太多了。」

en.content:
I'm not looking up my odds.
I was just scrolling and my thumb accidentally landed on one department's course map,
and then I accidentally read all four years of required classes,
and then accidentally opened the dorm photos and the late-night food street behind campus.
I'm really not looking.
I'm just quietly touring an apartment in a future that isn't mine yet.
en.editorNote: Best in the stretch after the exam and before you commit to a preference list — for anyone who says "I don't want to jinx it" while their browser history says otherwise.
variations: Short: "I'm not researching schools. I've just accidentally opened the same page three days running."
Or: "My search history is a lot more honest about my hopes than my mouth is."

items.sourceNote: 115分科測驗8月3日寄發成績通知單，等待期間考生焦慮；改寫為等成績期間的自創迷信

zh-tw.content:
分數還沒出來，我先發明了一整套規矩：
不能說「應該有上」、不能提前跟朋友聊校慶要不要一起去、
提到想讀的那個系之前要先敲三下桌子。
沒有一條有科學根據。
但在數字被決定之前，這些沒有用的小動作，
是我唯一還能替自己做的事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 等成績、等放榜都適用。把焦慮寫成一種好笑又有點心酸的儀式感，比單純喊「好緊張」更有共鳴。
variations: 短版：「我不迷信，我只是這禮拜暫時不剪指甲、不說大話、不走同一條路回家。」
另一種說法：「能做的都做完了，剩下的日子只好靠一堆自己發明的規矩撐著。」

en.content:
Scores aren't out yet, so I've invented a whole rulebook:
no saying "I think I got in," no making plans with friends about a campus I haven't been admitted to,
and I knock the table three times before naming the department out loud.
None of it has any basis in anything.
But until the number gets decided for me, these useless little rituals
are the only thing I can still do on my own behalf.
en.editorNote: Works for waiting on scores or on an admissions list. Turning anxiety into a comic ritual lands better than just posting "so nervous."
variations: Short: "I'm not superstitious. I'm just not cutting my nails, tempting fate, or walking the usual way home this week."
Or: "I've done everything I can do. The rest of the wait runs on rules I made up myself."

items.sourceNote: 考後至8/3成績公布前考生多找短期打工填空窗；改寫為溫暖向的考後小故事

zh-tw.content:
打工第一天，店長看了我一眼，問：「你剛考完喔？」
我說對，成績還沒出來。
他沒再多問，只是交接的時候多丟了一顆茶葉蛋到我碗裡，說：「先吃，撐得住比較重要。」
我低頭吃了三口才發現，
這半年好像沒有人問過我餓不餓，
包括我自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考後空窗期打工、或想寫一點溫度的人。重點不在店長多好，而在「終於有人關心的是你，不是你的分數」。
variations: 短版：「他沒問我考幾分，只問我吃飽了沒。那顆茶葉蛋比任何鼓勵都準。」
另一種說法：「這半年所有人都在關心我的成績，只有他關心我有沒有吃飯。」

en.content:
First day at the summer job, the manager looked at me and asked, "You just finished your exams?"
I said yeah, scores aren't out yet.
He didn't ask anything else. At shift change he just dropped an extra tea egg into my bowl and said, "Eat first. Holding up matters more."
Three bites in it hit me:
in six months, nobody had asked whether I was hungry.
Myself included.
en.editorNote: For anyone filling the gap between the exam and results day with a job — and for the moment someone finally asks about you instead of your score.
variations: Short: "He didn't ask what I scored. He asked if I'd eaten. That egg landed harder than any pep talk."
Or: "Everyone spent six months asking about my grades. He was the first to ask if I'd had dinner."

items.sourceNote: 115分科測驗成績 8/3 上午9時開放網路查詢，8:30-13:00 期間為簡易版快速查詢頁面；改寫為查分當下的原創自嘲

zh-tw.content:
早上九點整，那個頁面終於打得開。
沒有動畫、沒有音樂，白底黑字，載入不到一秒。
一整年的補習費、失眠、寫到沒水的筆，
最後被壓縮成四行純文字，連多一個標點符號都不肯給我。
我盯著它看了很久才想通——
它只負責通知我，不負責替我感覺。
zh-tw.editorNote: 成績公布當天九點過後最有共鳴，適合查完還沒消化完的人發限動。重點是「這麼大的事，被系統處理得這麼輕」的落差。
variations: 短版：「一年的努力，載入時間不到一秒。」
另一種說法：「那個頁面對我的分數沒有任何情緒，情緒的部分全部外包給我自己。」

en.content:
9 a.m. sharp, the page finally loads.
No animation, no music, black text on white, under a second.
A year of tuition fees, bad sleep, and pens I wrote dry,
compressed into four lines of plain text that wouldn't spare me one extra punctuation mark.
Took me a while to get it —
the page is only there to tell me. Feeling it is my job.
en.editorNote: Lands hardest in the hour after scores drop, for anyone who's looked but hasn't processed it yet. The gag is the gap: a huge thing handled very lightly by a system.
variations: Short: "A year of work. Load time: under one second."
Or: "The page had no feelings about my score. It outsourced all of that to me."

items.sourceNote: 115分科測驗 8/3 同步公布頂標、前標、均標、後標、底標五項成績標準；改寫為對「被歸類成一個標」的自嘲與自我肯定

zh-tw.content:
五標公布了：頂標、前標、均標、後標、底標。
我在裡面找到自己，是一個很中間的位置。
那一刻我有點想笑——
熬過的夜、掉在排水孔的頭髮、推掉的每一場邀約，
最後被歸納成兩個字的形容詞。
沒關係，那兩個字形容的是我的分數，不是我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 五標公布後最適合，特別是寫給落在中間、覺得自己不上不下的人。前半自嘲、後半收得住，發限動或安慰朋友都好用。
variations: 短版：「我今年最大的成就，是成為統計表上的一格。」
另一種說法：「標準只有五個，人有很多種。這件事我花了一整年才想通。」

en.content:
The score bands came out: top, high, mid, low, bottom.
I found myself in there. Somewhere comfortably in the middle.
Made me want to laugh —
every late night, every clump of hair in the drain, every invite I turned down,
filed under one small word.
Fine. That word describes my score. It doesn't describe me.
en.editorNote: For the day the percentile bands land, especially for anyone stuck in the middle feeling like neither. Self-deprecating up front, but it sticks the landing — good for a story post or for talking a friend down.
variations: Short: "Biggest achievement this year: becoming one cell on a statistics table."
Or: "There are five bands. There are a lot more than five kinds of people. Took me a year to figure that out."

items.sourceNote: 115分科測驗 8/3 上午9時開放查詢、同日寄發紙本成績通知單，紙本會晚幾天才送達；改寫為家人視角的原創溫暖情境

zh-tw.content:
九點零五分我就知道分數了，
但紙本成績單還躺在郵局的某個袋子裡，要過幾天才會寄到家。
中午我媽問我：「那張紙什麼時候會來？」
我說你不是早就知道我幾分了。
她說：「知道啊，我只是想把它收起來。」
同一個數字，
我拿來給自己打分數，她拿來當紀念品。
zh-tw.editorNote: 家人向的溫暖款，適合成績出來當天發，也很適合傳給覺得「我的成績只會讓爸媽失望」的人。重點在同一個數字的兩種讀法。
variations: 短版：「我想把那張紙藏起來，我媽想把它收起來。」
另一種說法：「成績單對某些人不是判決書，是一張捨不得丟的紙。」

en.content:
I knew my score by 9:05.
The paper notice is still in a mail sack somewhere and won't reach the house for days.
Over lunch my mom asked when that paper was coming.
I said you already know the number.
She said, "I know. I just want to put it away somewhere."
Same number, two different uses:
I'm grading myself with it. She's keeping it.
en.editorNote: The warm one for results day, and for anyone convinced their score can only disappoint their parents. The whole thing turns on two ways of reading the same number.
variations: Short: "I wanted to hide that paper. My mom wanted to file it."
Or: "A score report isn't a verdict to everyone. To some people it's a keepsake."

items.sourceNote: 115分科測驗 8/3 上午9時開放查成績；改寫為查分當下班級群組氣氛的原創情境

zh-tw.content:
八點五十九分，班群還在洗版：手好抖、想吐、有人陪我一起數三聲嗎。
九點零一分，整個群組安靜了。
不是沒人在，是四十個人同時低頭看自己的螢幕，
沒有人知道現在該先說哪一句。
最後是平常最吵的那個人打破沉默：
「不管幾分，等一下有人要吃早餐嗎。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 查完分數那個微妙的空白時刻，寫給不知道怎麼開口問朋友的人。也很適合當「先約吃飯再說」的開場白。
variations: 短版：「九點零一分，班群比考場還安靜。」
另一種說法：「最難的不是面對那個數字，是決定要不要在群組裡先講話。」

en.content:
At 8:59 the class chat was a wall of messages: my hands are shaking, I'm gonna be sick, someone count me down.
At 9:01 it went completely silent.
Not empty — forty people all staring at their own screen at the same second,
nobody sure which sentence is safe to go first.
The loudest guy in the group finally broke it:
"Whatever anyone got. Anyone want breakfast?"
en.editorNote: For that strange blank minute right after everyone checks, and for anyone who can't figure out how to ask a friend how it went. Also a decent opener for "let's just get food first."
variations: Short: "9:01 a.m. and the class chat was quieter than the exam hall."
Or: "The hard part isn't facing the number. It's deciding whether to type anything in the group chat."

items.sourceNote: 115大學考試分發 8/5 上午9時開放網路登記志願，系統可直接輸入系組代碼（4碼）；改寫為考生視角的原創情境

zh-tw.content:
這一年我背過的公式，考完不到一個禮拜就全部還回去了。
現在我腦袋裡背得最熟的，是一組四位數字。
它不會出現在任何一張考卷上，也沒有人會為它打分數，
但我閉著眼睛都打得出來——
因為那是我明天早上要親手輸進去的，那個校系的代碼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 登記志願前一天發最有感，也適合送給「讀完就忘，但一直很清楚自己想去哪」的人。
variations: 短版：「公式全忘光了，那四個數字倒是背得比誰都熟。」
另一種說法：「我這一年記得最牢的，不是任何一個答案，是我想去的地方。」

en.content:
Every formula I memorized this year was gone within a week of the last exam.
The only thing still stuck in my head is a four-digit number.
It won't appear on any test. Nobody is grading me on it.
But I could type it with my eyes closed —
because tomorrow morning I'm entering it myself, in the box for the program I want.
en.editorNote: Best posted the day before you submit your choices, and good for anyone who forgets everything they studied but has never once forgotten where they want to end up.
variations: Short: "Forgot every formula. Somehow know those four digits by heart."
Or: "The thing I remember best from this whole year isn't an answer. It's a destination."

items.sourceNote: 115登記分發志願系統操作說明，考生可先試填再送出；改寫為家庭餐桌討論志願的原創情境

zh-tw.content:
試填表印了三份：我一份、我爸一份、我媽一份。
三個人排出三種順序，在餐桌上吵了快一小時。
我爸最堅持的那一格，我連學校在哪個縣市都要查。
最後他把紙推回我這邊，說：
「反正按送出的人是你，我們只是想有參與感。」
那句話，比他排的順序還讓我記得久。
zh-tw.editorNote: 寫給這幾天在家裡為志願吵架的人。重點不是誰排得對，而是家人想幫忙的方式常常很笨拙。
variations: 短版：「他們排的順序我沒有採用，但那兩張紙我留下來了。」
另一種說法：「爸媽爭的其實不是校系，是還想幫上一點忙。」

en.content:
We printed three copies of the draft list: one for me, one for my dad, one for my mom.
Three people, three completely different rankings, almost an hour of arguing at the kitchen table.
The school my dad kept pushing for, I had to look up what state it was even in.
Then he slid his page back across to me and said,
"You're the one hitting submit anyway. We just wanted to feel involved."
I remember that line better than I remember his ranking.
en.editorNote: For anyone fighting with their family about college lists right now. The point isn't who ranked it correctly — it's that parents help in clumsy ways.
variations: Short: "I didn't use their rankings. I did keep their pages."
Or: "They weren't really arguing about schools. They were arguing for one last chance to help."

items.sourceNote: 115大學分發入學採「先檢定、後採計、同分再參酌」，同分時逐科比較實得分數；改寫為考生自嘲的原創情境

zh-tw.content:
簡章上有一行很小的字：萬一同分，就照順序逐科比成績。
也就是說，如果真的跟人撞在同一格，
決定我接下來四年住哪座城市的，
可能是那一題我用刪去法猜對的選擇題。
三年的早自習、晚自習、補習班，
最後由一個我自己都不確定的答案，替我簽了名。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合覺得努力和結果不成正比的人。分發放榜前的自嘲款，笑完通常會想嘆一口氣。
variations: 短版：「決定我未來四年的，可能是一題我瞎猜的選擇題。」
另一種說法：「努力負責前面九成，最後那一格交給運氣去簽名。」

en.content:
There's a tiny line in the handbook: if two people tie, they compare subject scores one at a time, in a set order.
Which means if I ever land on the exact same total as someone else,
the thing deciding which city I live in for the next four years
could be one multiple-choice question I got right by elimination.
Three years of early mornings, late nights and cram school —
signed off, in the end, by an answer I wasn't even sure about.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose effort and results refuse to line up. A self-deprecating one for the waiting period before placements come out — funny first, then a little bleak.
variations: Short: "My next four years may hinge on one question I flat-out guessed."
Or: "Effort covers ninety percent. Luck signs the last line."

items.sourceNote: 115聯合登記分發選填志願說明，考生最多可填100個志願；改寫為「第一志願放夢想校系」的原創情境

zh-tw.content:
我把那個絕對上不了的科系，放在第一志願。
理性上這一格等於浪費，落點分析看了都想勸我。
但我還是填了。
因為過了明天，我的人生就要開始學會「先看看自己夠不夠格」，
而這是最後一次，我可以不用付任何代價，
把最想要的東西，寫在第一行。
zh-tw.editorNote: 給所有把夢想校系放第一格的人。登記志願那幾天發最準，也適合傳給覺得自己「不配想太多」的朋友。
variations: 短版：「明知填不上也要填，因為那一格是寫給自己看的。」
另一種說法：「第一志願不一定是會上的那個，是你不想騙自己的那個。」

en.content:
I put the program I have zero chance of getting into at the very top of my list.
Rationally that slot is wasted. Every score calculator would talk me out of it.
I filled it in anyway.
Because after tomorrow, life starts training you to check whether you qualify before you let yourself want something,
and this is the last time I get to write down what I actually want, on the first line,
and pay nothing for it.
en.editorNote: For everyone who put the dream school in slot one. Lands hardest during submission week, and works as a message to a friend who thinks they're not allowed to want much.
variations: Short: "I'll never get in, and I ranked it first anyway. That line was for me."
Or: "Your first choice isn't the one you'll get. It's the one you refuse to lie about."

items.sourceNote: 115考試分發登記志願系統支援「貼上志願碼」快速匯入整組志願；改寫為班級群組氣氛的原創情境

zh-tw.content:
考試的時候，班群裡傳的是解答。
現在班群裡傳的是志願碼——一串複製貼上就能整組匯入的數字。
有人開玩笑說：「借抄一下。」
群組安靜了兩秒，然後有人回：
「這次抄了也沒用，這題沒有標準答案。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 登記志願那幾天的班群氣氛。笑點在「抄了也沒用」，但那其實是這幾天最誠實的一句話。
variations: 短版：「志願碼可以複製貼上，人生不行。」
另一種說法：「這是我們這輩子第一份，不能互相抄的作業。」

en.content:
During exam season the class chat was full of answer keys.
Now it's full of preference codes — strings of digits you can paste straight into the system.
Someone joked, "Can I just copy yours?"
Two seconds of silence, then somebody typed:
"Copying won't help this time. This one doesn't have a right answer."
en.editorNote: The class group chat during submission week. The joke is that copying is useless — which is also the most honest thing anyone says all week.
variations: Short: "You can paste the code. You can't paste the life."
Or: "First assignment we've ever had that nobody can copy off anyone."

items.sourceNote: 115學年度大學分發入學登記志願系統於8/5開放、8/8截止，簡章明載登記時間早晚不影響分發結果；改寫為原創的第一天心情

zh-tw.content:
系統上午九點開放，我八點五十就把頁面打開了。
簡章白紙黑字寫著：登記時間的早晚，不影響分發結果。
我知道，我甚至背得出來。
但我還是第一時間按了送出——
因為這一整年我唯一能控制的，從來都不是分數，
是我願意多早一點，把心裡那塊石頭放下。
zh-tw.editorNote: 登記志願第一天的心情。明知道早送晚送結果都一樣，還是要搶第一個，因為那是這一年少數自己說了算的事。
variations: 短版：「早送晚送分數都一樣，但心裡那塊石頭的重量不一樣。」
另一種說法：「我不是怕來不及，我是怕再讓自己多想一個小時。」

en.content:
The system opened at nine. My browser was sitting on the page by 8:50.
The handbook says it in plain print: submitting early does not improve your odds.
I know. I could recite the sentence.
I hit submit anyway —
because the one thing I could control this whole year was never the score.
It was how soon I got to put the rock down.
en.editorNote: Day one of submitting your college preference list. Rushing changes nothing, and you do it anyway, because it is one of the few calls that is actually yours.
variations: Short: "Early or late, same result. Different weight on your chest."
Or: "I wasn't afraid of missing the deadline. I was afraid of thinking about it one more hour."

items.sourceNote: 115分發登記期間（8/5-8/8）志願順序可於截止前反覆修改，與考卷交出即定案形成對比；情境為原創

zh-tw.content:
考卷交出去就不能改，這條規矩我認了三年。
這張志願表不一樣，截止之前你想改幾次都可以。
我本來以為那是慈悲，後來發現那是一種很慢的刑罰：
每一次「好，這樣就定案了」，都只能撐一個小時。
最後我沒有排出最完美的順序，
我只是改到自己願意停手為止。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合送出之後又偷偷進系統改第五次的那個晚上。重點是那句「不是排到最好，是排到願意停手」。
variations: 短版：「可以改不代表會變好，只代表你要一直重新決定一次。」
另一種說法：「這是我人生第一次拿到還原鍵，然後被它折磨了三天。」

en.content:
Once you hand in an exam paper, it's sealed. Three years and I'd made my peace with that.
This form is different — you can reshuffle the order as many times as you want before the deadline.
I thought that was mercy. It's closer to a slow punishment:
every "okay, that's final" stays final for about an hour.
In the end I didn't build the perfect list.
I just kept editing until I was willing to stop.
en.editorNote: For the night you go back into the system to reorder your list for the fifth time. The payoff line: you don't finish, you just stop.
variations: Short: "Being able to change it doesn't make it better. It just makes you decide again."
Or: "First undo button life ever handed me, and it wrecked me for three days."

items.sourceNote: 115年高普考7月初考畢、預定9月16日放榜，等待期長達兩個月；改寫為在職考生的原創情境

zh-tw.content:
考完那三天，我是拿特休請的假。
星期一回辦公室，沒有人問我去了哪裡，我也沒有說。
成績要等到九月中才會出來。
這兩個月，我照常開會、照常回信、照常說「還好啊」。
只有抽屜最下層那一疊翻爛的講義知道，
我這半年下班之後，到底都去了哪裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 寫給邊上班邊準備國考的人。等待期比學生長得多，而且身邊沒有一個人知道你在等。
variations: 短版：「別人放的是暑假，我放的是特休；別人等十幾天，我等兩個月。」
另一種說法：「沒有人知道我去考了，所以也沒有人需要替我緊張——這樣其實比較好。」

en.content:
I burned three vacation days on the exam.
Back at my desk on Monday, nobody asked where I'd been, and I didn't bring it up.
Results don't post until the middle of September.
For two months I'll take the same meetings, answer the same emails, say "all good" the same way.
Only the stack of dog-eared study books at the bottom of my drawer knows
where I actually went every night for the past six months.
en.editorNote: For working adults sitting civil service exams. The wait is far longer than a student's, and nobody around you even knows it's happening.
variations: Short: "Everyone else took a summer break. I took PTO — and I'm waiting two months, not two weeks."
Or: "Nobody knows I sat it, so nobody has to be nervous for me. Honestly, that's easier."

items.sourceNote: 115分科成績8/3公布、8/17才放榜，成績公布後補習班隨即展開重考班招生；招生電話情境為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
成績出來的第三天，第一通電話就進來了。
「同學你好，我們秋天有開一個小班制的重考課程——」
我還沒回答要不要，只是很想先問他：
你們是怎麼知道我考幾分的？
掛掉之後我坐在客廳，覺得有點好笑：
榜單都還沒出來，就已經有人替我規劃好明年了。
但那一年要不要開始，這次換我自己說了算。
zh-tw.editorNote: 成績公布後接到招生電話的微妙感。前半自嘲，最後一句是留給還在等放榜的人的一點底氣。
variations: 短版：「榜單還沒出，就有人先幫我把明年排好了。」
另一種說法：「我不排斥重來，我只是想自己決定什麼時候重來。」

en.content:
Three days after scores dropped, the first call came in.
"Hi there, we're opening a small-group retake class this fall—"
Before I could say yes or no, I wanted to ask him one thing:
how do you know what I scored?
I hung up, sat down in the living room, and found it almost funny:
placements aren't even out and somebody has already booked my next year.
Whether that year happens is still mine to decide.
en.editorNote: That strange first cram-school sales call after results day. Self-deprecating up front, with a line at the end for anyone still waiting on placements.
variations: Short: "Results aren't out yet and someone's already scheduled my next year."
Or: "I'm not against starting over. I just want to be the one who picks when."

items.sourceNote: 115分發入學登記志願期間為8/5至8/8，須先完成登記費繳費（臨櫃8/7、ATM 8/8截止）才能登記；ATM前的情境為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
簡章寫得很清楚：登記費沒繳，志願表就送不出去。
我媽陪我走到轉角那台提款機，金額其實沒有多大，
但我按下確認之前，手在鍵盤上停了很久。
不是捨不得那筆錢，
是那台機器嗶一聲之後，這一年就真的沒有回頭的餘地了。
後面排隊的阿姨探頭問：「妹妹是不是不會用？」
我說沒有，我在確認一下。
其實我在確認的不是金額，是我自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 登記志願前繳費那一刻的猶豫。適合分發登記期間、手指停在確認鍵上不敢按的人。
variations: 短版：「錢不多，但那是我按過最重的一次確認。」
另一種說法：「我不是不會操作，我是在跟自己確認要不要往前一步。」

en.content:
The handbook is blunt about it: no fee, no placement form.
Mom walked with me to the ATM on the corner. The amount wasn't large,
but my hand hovered over the keypad for a long time before I hit confirm.
It wasn't the money I couldn't part with.
It was knowing that once the machine beeped, this year had no undo button.
A woman waiting behind me leaned in: "Do you need help working it?"
I said no, I'm just double-checking.
I wasn't checking the amount. I was checking myself.
en.editorNote: That pause before paying the placement-registration fee. For anyone whose finger is frozen over the confirm button.
variations: Short: "Small amount. Heaviest confirm button I've ever pressed."
Or: "I knew how to use the machine. I just wasn't sure I was ready to move forward."

items.sourceNote: 115分發入學8/17才公告分發結果，登記期間考生仍處於未定狀態；回收講義的情境為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
我媽問我，牆角那疊講義要不要拿去回收，秤一秤說不定還有一百塊。
我說再等等。
不是捨不得，也不是想留著當紀念，
是榜單還沒公布，
那疊紙現在同時是「已經結束的一年」跟「可能要重來一次的一年」。
要等到那天早上，我才知道自己是要把它抱去磅秤上，
還是抱回書桌前。
所以它就繼續躺在那裡，替我保留兩種人生。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完到放榜之間那段誰都不敢收拾的空白期。適合東西還沒丟、心也還沒放下的人。
variations: 短版：「還沒放榜，所以那疊講義我一張都還不敢丟。」
另一種說法：「它不是垃圾也不是紀念品，它是我還沒選好的兩條路。」

en.content:
Mom asked if she should take the stack of workbooks in the corner to recycling. By weight it might be worth a couple of bucks.
I said give it a while.
It's not sentiment, and I'm not keeping them as souvenirs.
Placements aren't out yet,
so that stack is still both "the year that ended" and "the year I might have to do again."
Not until results morning will I know whether I'm hauling it to a scale
or hauling it back to my desk.
So it just sits there, holding two versions of my life open for me.
en.editorNote: The limbo between finishing exams and getting results, when nobody dares clean anything up. For anyone whose stuff, and heart, are both still unpacked.
variations: Short: "Results aren't out, so I haven't thrown away a single page."
Or: "That stack isn't trash and isn't a keepsake. It's two futures I haven't picked between."

items.sourceNote: 機車與汽車駕照筆試題庫公開於監理服務網、40題滿分100分85分及格；考生暑假去考駕照的情境為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
考完大考的第三個星期，我人在監理站。
四十題，八十五分及格，而且整本題庫早就公開在網路上。
我坐在那台觸控螢幕前面，突然有點想笑：
原來考試也可以長這樣——
答案本來就給你，交卷當下就知道結果，
沒有人問你幾分，也沒有人拿你的分數去跟別人排順序。
過了就是過了。
我這輩子考過最輕鬆的一場，
是在我以為自己已經跟考試無關了之後才遇到的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 用駕照筆試對照大考的壓力感。適合考完之後想被提醒「不是每一場考試都在評價你」的人。
variations: 短版：「題庫公開、當場知道結果、沒人問我幾分——原來考試可以這樣。」
另一種說法：「有些考試只是確認你會不會，不是拿來排你第幾名。」

en.content:
Three weeks after the big exam, I was at the DMV.
Forty questions, 85 to pass, and the entire question bank is posted online for free.
Sitting at that touchscreen, I almost laughed:
so a test can look like this—
the answers were always available, you get your result the second you submit,
nobody asks your score, and nobody ranks you against anyone else.
Pass is just pass.
The easiest exam of my life showed up
right after I assumed I was done with exams for good.
en.editorNote: The driving-test written exam as a contrast to high-stakes testing. For anyone who needs reminding that not every test is a verdict on them.
variations: Short: "Open question bank, instant result, nobody asks your score. Turns out tests can be like that."
Or: "Some exams just check whether you can do it. They're not there to rank you."

items.sourceNote: 115分科考生於8月等待分發結果期間，家中下一屆考生同時進入備考年；對話情境為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
我還沒放榜，我妹已經升上要考的那一年。
昨天她站在我房門口問：「真的有那麼難嗎？」
我想了很久。
說很難，她今天晚上大概會睡不著；
說還好，那是騙她。
最後我說：會累，但不是每一天都那麼累，
而且你不會像我當年那樣，以為全世界只有自己一個人在撐。
她「喔」了一聲就走回房間了。
我不知道她聽進去多少，
只知道那句話，是我當年最想有人跟我說的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完的人對家裡下一個考生說話的時刻。適合當學長姐、也適合送給正要開始的那個人。
variations: 短版：「會累，但不是每一天都那麼累。」
另一種說法：「我沒辦法讓你少讀一頁，但我可以讓你少一個人扛。」

en.content:
My placement isn't out yet, and my little sister has already started her exam year.
Last night she stood in my doorway and asked, "Is it really that hard?"
I thought about it for a long time.
Say yes, and she doesn't sleep tonight.
Say it's fine, and I'm lying to her.
So I said: it's tiring, but not every day is that tiring,
and you won't have to do what I did, which was assume I was the only one holding on.
She said "okay" and went back to her room.
I have no idea how much of it landed.
I just know it's the sentence I wanted someone to say to me.
en.editorNote: The moment you hand something down to the next person starting their exam year. Works as advice from an older sibling and as reassurance for the one beginning.
variations: Short: "It's tiring, but not every single day is that tiring."
Or: "I can't make the reading shorter. I can make sure you're not carrying it alone."

items.sourceNote: 115分發入學8/5至8/8登記志願、8/17公告分發結果，考生處於已考完未分發的狀態；比喻為原創

zh-tw.content:
我現在的身分是「已經考完、但還沒被分發」。
像倉庫裡的那種箱子：標籤貼好了，重量也量完了，
就是還沒有人告訴它要送去哪一座城市。
zh-tw.editorNote: 短句型，適合放榜前那幾天的限動或社群貼文。
variations: 短版：「標籤貼好了，就差一個地址。」
另一種說法：「我不是在放暑假，我是在待出貨。」

en.content:
Current status: finished the exam, not yet assigned anywhere.
Like a box in a warehouse — labeled, weighed, sealed,
still waiting for somebody to tell it which city it's going to.
en.editorNote: Short-form line for a story or post during the wait before placement results.
variations: Short: "Labeled and weighed. Just missing an address."
Or: "I'm not on summer break. I'm awaiting shipment."

items.sourceNote: 115學年度四技二專日間部聯合登記分發於8月6日10時放榜，比大學分發（8/17）早十天以上；技職生的情境為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
昨天早上十點，我的榜單就出來了。
朋友問我幾級分，我說我沒有級分，我考的是統測，看的是加權過的總分。
他「喔」了一聲，話題就停在那裡。
這三年我在實習工廠磨壞過幾片砂紙，沒有人問過；
但只要講出一個學校名字，大家馬上就知道要用什麼表情。
其實我已經知道九月要去哪裡了，
只是這個世界還在等別人的榜單，所以我像是提早交了卷，卻沒有人來收。
zh-tw.editorNote: 寫給技職體系的考生。分發結果比大學那邊早很多，卻常常沒有人在看那一張榜單。
variations: 短版：「我沒有級分，我有的是加權後的總分，還有三年磨掉的砂紙。」
另一種說法：「我的榜單昨天就出來了，只是大家的目光還在別條路上。」

en.content:
My placement list posted yesterday at ten in the morning.
A friend asked what I scored on the general track exam. I didn't take it — I took the vocational one, and what counts is a weighted total, not a scale score.
He said "oh," and the conversation ended there.
Three years of wearing through sandpaper in the shop, and nobody has ever asked about that;
say one school name, though, and everyone instantly knows which face to make.
I already know where I'm going in September.
The rest of the world is still waiting on a different list, so it feels like I turned in my paper early and nobody came to collect it.
en.editorNote: For students on the vocational track, whose results land well ahead of the general-track placements and get far less attention.
variations: Short: "No scale score here. Just a weighted total and three years of worn-out sandpaper."
Or: "My results came out yesterday. Everyone's eyes were just pointed down a different road."

items.sourceNote: 115暑假轉學考多校於7月下旬放榜、正取生8月初報到，備取生第一次遞補報到約在8月12日；等電話的情境為原創

zh-tw.content:
正取名單上沒有我，我是備取第七。
學校公告說第一次遞補是八月十二號。
所以這幾天我做的事情是：把手機音量開到最大，帶進浴室，帶去晾衣服，充電的時候人也坐在插座旁邊。
昨天有個陌生號碼打進來，我心跳到接不起來，結果是問我要不要辦信用卡。
最好笑的是，我連真的接到了要不要去都還沒想清楚，
就已經先花十天，練習等一通不一定會響的電話。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合暑假轉學考備取、在等遞補通知的人。八月中是各校備取遞補報到的時間，這種等法比放榜還磨人。
variations: 短版：「備取第七。這十天我最熟練的功課，是把手機拿好。」
另一種說法：「有些等待沒有放榜那一刻，只是等到某一天，電話就不會再響了。」

en.content:
I'm not on the accepted list. I'm number seven on the waitlist.
The school says the first round of call-ups happens on the twelfth.
So here's what I've been doing: ringer cranked to max, phone in the bathroom with me, phone out on the balcony while I hang laundry, sitting next to the outlet whenever it charges.
An unknown number called yesterday and my heart went so fast I couldn't pick up. It was a credit card offer.
The funny part is I still haven't decided whether I'd even say yes,
and I've already spent ten days practicing how to wait for a call that may never come.
en.editorNote: For anyone on a transfer-admission waitlist watching their phone. Mid-August is when call-ups happen, and the waiting is worse than results day.
variations: Short: "Seventh on the waitlist. My most practiced skill this week is holding a phone."
Or: "Some waiting has no results day. One morning the phone just stops being a possibility."

items.sourceNote: 115年教師甄試分初試筆試與複試試教口試，8月各校陸續分階段辦理代理教師甄選、梯次密集；情境為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
八月開始，我一個禮拜跑三場代理教師甄選。
每一場都是十五分鐘試教，台下坐五個老師，沒有一個學生。
我對著空教室說「同學，我們看這一頁」，還要記得把語氣放亮。
第三場結束，我坐在停車場吃便當，一時間分不出剛剛那節課是哪一所學校。
十八歲考完那年，我以為考試是一件會結束的事。
今年我三十歲，還在準備下一場。
差別是這次我知道，準備沒有白費，它只是需要比較久。
zh-tw.editorNote: 寫給暑假一場接一場跑教甄的人。八月各校代理缺陸續公告，梯次密集、通知很急。
variations: 短版：「十五分鐘試教，台下五個老師，沒有一個學生。」
另一種說法：「我以為考試會結束，其實只是考場一直在換。」

en.content:
Since August started I've been sitting three substitute-teaching interviews a week.
Every one is a fifteen-minute demo lesson, five teachers in the seats, zero students.
I say "okay everyone, look at this page" to an empty room, and remember to keep my voice bright.
After the third one I ate lunch in the parking lot and honestly couldn't tell you which school that last lesson was at.
When I finished my own exams at eighteen, I thought testing was something that ended.
I'm thirty, and I'm prepping for the next one.
The difference is that this time I know the prep isn't wasted. It just takes longer than I wanted.
en.editorNote: For anyone running the summer circuit of teaching-job interviews. Postings come fast in August and the notice is always short.
variations: Short: "Fifteen-minute demo lesson. Five teachers watching. Not one student."
Or: "I thought exams ended. Turns out the room just keeps changing."

items.sourceNote: 升大學板考後討論的普遍氛圍；翻手機搜尋紀錄的情境與句子為原創

zh-tw.content:
我把手機的搜尋紀錄往下滑，時間軸大概長這樣：
七月是「電位差怎麼算」、「有機化學命名口訣」；
這幾天變成「宿舍要帶什麼」、「這個系畢業之後在做什麼」。
同一支手機，兩種人生，中間只隔了一場考試。
zh-tw.editorNote: 短句型，適合考完之後翻搜尋紀錄那一秒的恍神，貼限動剛好。
variations: 短版：「同一支手機，兩種人生，中間只隔一場考試。」
另一種說法：「我的搜尋紀錄比我還早發現，我已經畢業了。」

en.content:
I scrolled back through my phone's search history and the timeline goes roughly like this:
July was "how to calculate potential difference" and "organic chemistry naming tricks."
This week it's "what to pack for a dorm" and "what do people in this major actually do after graduation."
Same phone, two different lives, one exam in between.
en.editorNote: Short-form line for that small jolt when you scroll your own search history after exams end. Good for a story post.
variations: Short: "Same phone, two different lives, one exam in between."
Or: "My search history figured out I'd graduated before I did."

items.sourceNote: 考試板長年常見的「單字本永遠從第一頁重來」自嘲；句子與細節為原創

zh-tw.content:
我的單字本前十頁被翻到起毛邊，紙都軟了。
第十一頁之後，還是原廠出貨的狀態。
每次下定決心重新開始，我都很有誠意地從第一頁再來一次。
所以這本我讀過十幾遍，讀的都是同樣那十頁。
不是我沒毅力，是我對開頭有一種說不出的忠誠。
zh-tw.editorNote: 把單字本側面立起來、發現只有前面那一小截有手指髒污的那一秒，拍下來配這段剛好。
variations: 短版：「這本我讀過十幾遍，每一遍都是同樣那十頁。」
延伸：「我的書架上有五本前十頁都很熟的書，湊起來大概是一本很厚的第一章。」

en.content:
Vocabulary notebook, pages one through ten: soft, dog-eared, gray at the corners from my thumb.
Page eleven onward: factory fresh.
Every time I decide to get serious, I sincerely start again from the beginning.
So I've been through this book maybe fifteen times. Same ten pages, fifteen times.
It's not that I give up easily. I'm just extremely loyal to openings.
en.editorNote: For the moment you stand the notebook on its side and notice only the first quarter-inch is grubby.
variations: Short: "Been through this book fifteen times. Same ten pages every time."
