Extended: "Five books on my shelf, first ten pages of each worn out. Together that's one very thick Chapter One."

items.sourceNote: 「記得答案在課本的哪個位置卻想不起內容」的普遍記憶經驗；奶茶漬與箭頭等細節為原創

zh-tw.content:
那題我記得。
它在課本右邊那一頁的下面三分之一，靠近我打翻過奶茶的那圈淺褐色。
旁邊有我上課隨手畫的箭頭，箭頭很用力地指著一行字。
至於那行字寫什麼，一片空白。
我的腦袋已經很努力了，它只是把版面記成了風景，忘記把內容記成知識。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完走出教室，同學問「那題你寫什麼」，你卻只講得出它印在課本哪個角落的時候。
variations: 短版：「我記得它在右頁下方，靠近奶茶漬。內容我不記得。」
延伸：「我的記憶是張地圖，標得出每個寶藏的位置，就是沒寫裡面裝什麼。」

en.content:
Page position is the part my brain actually saved.
Right-hand page, lower third, next to the pale brown ring where I knocked over my milk tea.
There's an arrow I doodled in class, pointing very insistently at one line.
What that line said: total blank.
My memory tried its best. It just filed the layout as scenery and forgot to file the content as knowledge.
en.editorNote: For walking out of the room when a friend asks what you put for question 12 and all you can describe is where it lived in the textbook.
variations: Short: "I know it was lower right, near the tea stain. That's all I've got."
Extended: "My memory is a treasure map that marks every spot and never says what's buried there."

items.sourceNote: 整理舊課本翻到頁角塗鴉的懷舊情境；火柴人翻頁動畫的細節為原創

zh-tw.content:
整理舊課本的時候，發現我在頁角畫了一隻火柴人。
從第五十八頁一路跑到第九十一頁，拇指一彈，他真的會跑。
同一段時間，那三十幾頁的內容我一個字都沒吸收。
所以我不是不專心，我只是把專注力全部投資在一個沒有考科的項目上。
而且說真的，他跑得很順。
zh-tw.editorNote: 多年後翻到舊課本、忍不住用拇指彈一次頁角讓那隻小人跑起來的那一刻。
variations: 短版：「那三十幾頁我什麼都沒讀進去，但我養出了一隻會跑步的火柴人。」
延伸：「課本頁角是我人生第一個沒有截止日、也沒人打分數的作品。」

en.content:
Flipbook animation, pages 58 to 91 of my old textbook: one stick figure, running.
Thumb the corner and he still runs, years later.
Those same thirty-odd pages of actual material? Absorbed precisely none of it.
So it wasn't a focus problem. I just put all of it into a subject nobody grades.
And honestly, his stride holds up.
en.editorNote: For finding an old textbook in a box and flipping the corner once, just to check he still runs.
variations: Short: "Learned nothing from those thirty pages. Did produce a stick figure who can run."
Extended: "That page corner was the first thing I ever made with no deadline and no grade attached."

items.sourceNote: 深夜終於解出一題、隔天只記得當時很開心的經驗；時間與情節為原創

zh-tw.content:
凌晨兩點四十，那一題我終於自己推出來了。
那個瞬間爽到像突然多長了一顆腦袋，我還在心裡跟自己擊掌。
早上七點醒來，我記得的只剩下一件事：我昨晚很開心。
過程、算式、那個關鍵的一步，全部連夜退房。
留下來的不是答案，是一段沒有內容的快樂。
不過那一晚我是真的懂過，這件事誰也拿不走。
zh-tw.editorNote: 隔天早上打開筆記本，看著昨晚那行只寫到一半的算式發呆的時候。
variations: 短版：「我記得我懂過。細節退房了，快樂還留著。」
延伸：「凌晨的我很聰明，可惜他不留紀錄，也不接受早上的我打電話過去問。」

en.content:
2:40 a.m. is when I finally cracked that problem on my own.
Felt like growing a second brain. I high-fived myself, internally.
Woke up at seven remembering exactly one thing: that I had been happy.
The steps, the working, the one move that made it click — all checked out overnight.
What stayed wasn't the answer. It was a happiness with nothing attached to it.
Still counts, though. For one night I genuinely understood it, and nobody gets to take that back.
en.editorNote: For the next morning, staring at the half-finished line of working you left in the notebook.
variations: Short: "I remember understanding it. The details checked out; the happiness stayed."
Extended: "The 2 a.m. version of me is brilliant and keeps no records, and won't take calls from the 7 a.m. version."

items.sourceNote: 115分發入學8/17公告結果，補教業者放榜後於門口懸掛上榜紅布條為台灣長年常見景象；鐵架、字大到公車看得見等細節為原創

zh-tw.content:
我家巷口那間補習班，這禮拜就把紅布條的鐵架搭好了。
名字還沒印，位置倒是先卡好。
我在那裡上過一整年，考完之後一次都沒回去過。
所以接下來會發生什麼，我很清楚：
上榜的名字會被印在那塊布上，字大到公車經過都看得見；
沒上的那些，會很安靜地從那家補習班的歷史裡被刪掉。
招生海報從來不放我們這種人的側臉。
不過昨天路過，我看著那個空空的鐵架，只覺得好笑——
它認得的是分數，不是我熬過的那一年。
zh-tw.editorNote: 分發放榜前經過補習班門口，看到紅布條的架子已經搭好、名字還沒印上去的時候。
variations: 短版：「紅布條認得的是分數，不是我熬過的那一年。」
延伸：「補習班的榜單只寫上榜的人。沒上的那一欄，這幾十年都是空白的。」

en.content:
The cram school on my corner already put up the frame for the banner this week.
No names printed yet. Just the spot, claimed early.
I studied there for a year. Haven't been back once since the exam.
So I know exactly how this goes:
the names that got in go on that banner, big enough to read from a passing bus.
The ones that didn't get quietly deleted from that school's history.
The recruiting posters never use our profiles.
Still, I walked past yesterday, looked at that empty frame, and had to laugh —
it only knows my score. It doesn't know the year I spent getting one.
en.editorNote: For walking past a cram school before results day and seeing the banner frame already up, names not printed yet.
variations: Short: "That banner knows my score. It doesn't know the year behind it."
Extended: "Cram school banners only list who got in. The other column has been blank for decades."

items.sourceNote: 考後身體仍維持備考作息、鬧鐘關了還是自動早醒的普遍經驗；時間與句子為原創

zh-tw.content:
鬧鐘我兩個星期前就關掉了。
但每天早上六點二十，我還是自動睜眼，眼睛一開就在想第一節要考什麼。
躺著想了三秒才反應過來：沒有第一節了，也沒有要考的東西了。
然後我繼續躺著，躺到十點，一件事都沒做。
我的身體大概還沒收到通知，
它以為我們還在打仗，只是敵人今天剛好沒來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完之後身體還停在備考模式、早上莫名其妙自己醒來的那幾天。
variations: 短版：「鬧鐘關了，身體還沒收到通知。」
延伸：「我花一整年訓練自己六點二十起床，現在花整個暑假訓練自己不要。」

en.content:
I turned off the alarm two weeks ago.
My eyes still open at 6:20 every morning, already wondering what first period is testing.
Takes about three seconds to remember there is no first period, and nothing left to be tested on.
So I just lie there until ten and do absolutely nothing.
My body clearly hasn't gotten the memo.
It thinks we're still at war, and the enemy just didn't show up today.
en.editorNote: For the days after the exam when your body is still in study mode and wakes you up for no reason.
variations: Short: "Alarm's off. Nobody told my body."
Extended: "Spent a year training myself to wake at 6:20. Now I get a whole summer to untrain it."

items.sourceNote: 考後回校辦離校手續、清空置物櫃的普遍情境；外套、過期報名表與「之後再說」的細節為原創

zh-tw.content:
回學校辦離校手續，順便把置物櫃清空。
最上層是三本沒翻過的參考書，中間是一件冬天的外套，
最底下壓著一張社團成果發表的報名表，截止日期是去年十一月。
我那時候跟自己說：等考完再說。
現在考完了，那句「再說」已經沒有地方可以兌現。
外套我帶走了，報名表折起來丟進回收桶，
然後把櫃門關上，鑰匙還回教官室。
三年下來，我在這個櫃子裡放最多的，其實不是書，是「之後再說」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 回學校辦離校手續、清空置物櫃，翻出那些當初說「等考完再說」的東西時。
variations: 短版：「三年來我在置物櫃裡放最多的，是『之後再說』。」
延伸：「有些事情不是被拒絕，是被延到一個永遠不會到的日期。」

en.content:
Went back to school to finish the checkout paperwork and empty my locker.
Top shelf: three prep books I never opened. Middle: a winter jacket.
At the very bottom, a sign-up sheet for the club showcase. Deadline: last November.
I told myself back then, after the exam.
Well, the exam is over, and there's nowhere left to cash that in.
I took the jacket, folded the sign-up sheet into the recycling bin,
shut the door, and returned the key to the office.
Three years in, the thing I stored most in that locker wasn't books. It was later.
en.editorNote: For clearing out your locker on checkout day and finding everything you postponed until after the exam.
variations: Short: "Three years, and what I stored most in that locker was 'later.'"
Extended: "Some things never got turned down. They just got moved to a date that never arrived."

items.sourceNote: 115分發入學志願登記於8/8下午截止、8/17公告結果，落點分析服務於登記截止後陸續關閉；頁面文案與腦內演算法的比喻為原創

zh-tw.content:
志願登記截止的隔天，我又習慣性點開那個落點分析網站。
首頁只剩一行字：本年度服務已結束，感謝使用。
它比我還早放下。
現在還在幫我跑落點的，只剩我自己的腦袋，
而且它演算法爛得可以：早上算出來會上，晚上算出來會掉，
凌晨三點還會給我一個我根本沒填的科系。
這台機器沒有關機鍵，
看樣子要等到分發那天，才有人來幫我拔插頭。
zh-tw.editorNote: 志願送出後、分發結果還沒公布的那幾天，手指自己點開落點分析網站的時候。
variations: 短版：「落點分析網站關了，我腦袋裡那台還在跑，而且每次結果都不一樣。」
延伸：「連網站都知道今年結束了，只有我還開著一個沒人維護的伺服器。」

en.content:
The day after registration closed, my thumb opened the placement calculator again out of habit.
One line on the homepage: This year's service has ended. Thanks for using it.
It let go before I did.
The only thing still running my odds is my own head,
and the algorithm is terrible: in the morning I'm in, by night I'm out,
and at 3 a.m. it hands me a program I never even listed.
There's no power button on this machine.
Looks like I wait until results day for someone to come pull the plug.
en.editorNote: For the days between submitting your choices and results day, when your thumb opens the calculator on its own.
variations: Short: "The placement site shut down. The one in my head is still running, and it never gives the same answer twice."
Extended: "Even the website knows the year is over. I'm the only one still hosting a server nobody maintains."

items.sourceNote: 115學年度暑假至8/30結束、8/31開學，高中暑期輔導課依規定為自由參加；早班公車與便服的場景為原創

zh-tw.content:
早上七點半，我在巷口等公車，要去打工。
車來了，一整車都是制服，背包外面掛著水壺，有人低頭在補昨天的作業。
我穿便服站在後門旁邊，突然發現自己是全車唯一不用趕第一節的人。
去年這個時候，我坐在靠窗那排，一路睡到終點站前一站才驚醒。
車開到我要下的地方，我按了鈴，門開了，整車制服沒有人抬頭。
這條路線我搭了三年，今天第一次覺得它跟我沒有關係了。
不是被丟下，是真的走完了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑假尾聲，在早班車或早餐店遇到還在上暑期輔導課的學弟妹時。
variations: 短版：「一整車制服裡只有我穿便服，那一刻才真的畢業。」
延伸：「這條路線還在跑，只是它已經不需要載我了。」

en.content:
Seven thirty in the morning, waiting at the corner for the bus to my summer job.
It pulls up packed with uniforms, water bottles clipped to backpacks, somebody speed-finishing yesterday's homework.
I'm in regular clothes by the rear door, and it hits me: I'm the only one on this bus with no first period to make.
This time last year I had the window seat, out cold until one stop before the end of the line.
My stop comes, I hit the bell, the doors open, and not one uniform looks up.
I rode this route for three years. Today is the first time it felt like it wasn't mine.
Not left behind. Just finished.
en.editorNote: For the end of summer, when you run into underclassmen still heading to morning study sessions.
variations: Short: "A whole bus of uniforms and one kid in street clothes. That's when you've actually graduated."
Extended: "The route still runs. It just doesn't need to carry me anymore."

items.sourceNote: 115學年度大學分發入學8月17日上午放榜，考生於此期間等待結果；廚房與媽媽教做菜的場景為原創

zh-tw.content:
這禮拜我媽煮晚餐，突然在廚房喊我的名字。
我以為是要我端菜，走過去她卻把鍋鏟塞到我手上，說：你來翻。
然後開始講油要熱到什麼程度、蒜下去幾秒要撈、火什麼時候該轉小。
講得很仔細，仔細到不像臨時起意。
我沒問她為什麼突然要教我，她也沒說。
名單要十七號才出來，她其實不知道我還會不會待在這個廚房，
但她決定先把該教的教完，這樣不管答案是哪一個，她都不會來不及。
那天的菜有點鹹。我全部吃完了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 等放榜的這幾天，家人用他們自己的方式在替你打包時。
variations: 短版：「她不知道我會不會離開這個廚房，所以先把該教的教完。」
延伸：「有些人不會問你考得怎麼樣，他們只是提早開始準備送你走。」

en.content:
My mom was making dinner this week when she called my name from the kitchen.
I figured she wanted help carrying plates. Instead she handed me the spatula and said, you flip it.
Then came the whole lesson: how hot the oil should be, how many seconds the garlic gets, when to drop the heat.
Very thorough. Too thorough to be spur of the moment.
I didn't ask why she was suddenly teaching me. She didn't explain.
Results don't post until the seventeenth. She has no idea whether I'll still be in this kitchen,
so she decided to teach me everything now, so that whichever answer comes, she isn't late.
Dinner was a little salty. I finished all of it.
en.editorNote: For the waiting week, when family starts packing you up in their own quiet way.
variations: Short: "She doesn't know if I'm leaving this kitchen, so she's teaching me everything now."
Extended: "Some people never ask how the exam went. They just start getting you ready to go."

items.sourceNote: 115學年度大學分發入學登記於8/8截止、8/17上午放榜，每名考生至多錄取1個校系；分班公布欄的對照為原創

zh-tw.content:
從小學一年級開始，每年八月都有人會告訴我：你在幾班、坐幾號、找哪位導師。
名單貼在川堂那面公布欄上，我拿手指從上面一路劃下來找自己的名字，
找到之後再回頭找朋友的，看看有沒有擠進同一格。
今年八月，公布欄上沒有我。
我的那張名單只有一行字，而且要等到十七號早上九點才會被印出來。
更妙的是，那一行不是決定我坐第幾排，
是決定我明年八月會在哪一個校門口迷路。
我從來沒有這麼想念過，那種被人推來推去、擠在公布欄前面的八月。
zh-tw.editorNote: 放榜前幾天，看到學弟妹在討論開學分班、自己卻還沒有歸屬的時候。
variations: 短版：「以前八月看的是分班表，今年八月要看的那張只有一行。」
延伸：「以前公布欄決定我坐哪一排，這次決定我在哪座校門口迷路。」

en.content:
Since first grade, every August someone has told me: your class, your seat number, your homeroom teacher.
The list went up on the corridor board and I'd run a finger down it hunting for my name,
then go back through looking for my friends, checking who landed in the same column.
This August, I'm not on the board.
My list is one line long, and it doesn't print until nine in the morning on the seventeenth.
And the funny part is, that line doesn't decide which row I sit in.
It decides which campus gate I'll be lost at next August.
I have never missed anything the way I miss getting elbowed in a crowd in front of a bulletin board.
en.editorNote: For the days before results, when everyone else is comparing class assignments and you don't have one yet.
variations: Short: "August used to mean a class list. This year mine is one line long."
Extended: "The board used to decide which row I sat in. This one decides which gate I get lost at."

items.sourceNote: 115分科測驗成績於8/3公布、含五標與各科分數，考生成績長期被放在全國尺度比較；暑期打工首次入帳的場景為原創

zh-tw.content:
打工的薪水昨天入帳了。
數字不大，扣完該扣的更小，但我盯著那則通知看了很久。
過去三年，我拿到的每一個數字都要先被拿去跟全國比一次，
比完才知道它算高還是算低、算安全還是算危險。
昨天這個數字沒有人幫它排名，也沒有人問它比去年高還是低。
它就只是我站了幾個小時，換回來的東西。
原來一個數字可以什麼都不代表，
只代表我真的去做了那件事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完後打工領到第一筆薪水、發現有些數字不需要被拿去比較的時候。
variations: 短版：「這是我人生第一個，沒有人拿去跟全國比的數字。」
延伸：「不是每個數字都要有排名，有些只是證明你去了、你做了。」

en.content:
My paycheck from the summer job landed yesterday.
Small number. Smaller after deductions. I still stared at the notification for a while.
For three years, every number I got was measured against the whole country first,
and only then did I learn whether it counted as high or low, safe or dangerous.
Nobody ranked this one. Nobody asked whether it beat last year's.
It's just what I got back for standing somewhere for a certain number of hours.
Turns out a number can mean nothing at all,
except that I actually showed up and did the thing.
en.editorNote: For your first paycheck after the exam, when you realize some numbers don't get compared to anyone.
variations: Short: "First number in my life that nobody stacked against the whole country."
Extended: "Not every number needs a ranking. Some just prove you showed up."

items.sourceNote: 教育媒體討論「抄了很詳盡的筆記卻對學習沒幫助」的動手不動腦盲點；「字最漂亮的那幾頁剛好是最不懂的章節」之對照為原創

zh-tw.content:
我抄筆記的速度，是我理解速度的三倍。
老師寫一行，我抄一行，字還特別工整，同學借去影印都說做得很好看。
後來我發現一件事：我字寫最漂亮的那幾頁，剛好是我最不懂的那幾章。
因為聽得懂的時候我會分心，聽不懂的時候我只剩下抄。
那不是筆記，
那是我把黑板搬回家的搬運紀錄。
zh-tw.editorNote: 整理書桌翻到自己以前的筆記，發現漂亮歸漂亮、內容一句都想不起來的時候。
variations: 短版：「我字最漂亮的那幾頁，就是我最不懂的那幾章。」
延伸：「聽得懂的時候我會分心，聽不懂的時候我只剩下抄。」

en.content:
Three times faster. That's my copying speed versus my understanding speed.
The teacher writes a line, I write a line, and my handwriting is genuinely good — people borrow the pages.
Then I noticed something: my neatest pages are the chapters I understand least.
When I follow the lesson, my mind wanders. When I don't, copying is all I have left.
Those aren't notes.
That's a delivery log for moving a whiteboard into my house.
en.editorNote: For clearing your desk and finding old notes that look beautiful and tell you nothing.
variations: Short: "My neatest pages are the chapters I understood least."
Extended: "Follow the lesson and I drift. Lose the lesson and all I can do is copy."

items.sourceNote: udn 科技玩家報導網友分享「手機鬧鐘設一長串照樣賴床」的討論；鬧鐘命名與「睡著也能執行的流程」之對照為原創

zh-tw.content:
我手機裡有七個鬧鐘，每個間隔五分鐘，
名字分別是「起來」「真的起來」「這次是認真的」。
早上它們一個一個響，我一個一個關，全程閉著眼睛，命中率百分之百。
真正睜開眼睛的時候，我對前面那三十五分鐘完全沒有印象。
這輩子我執行得最徹底的一套流程，
是我睡著也做得到的那一套。
zh-tw.editorNote: 早上醒來發現鬧鐘全被自己關光、卻一點記憶都沒有的時候，發到群組自首。
variations: 短版：「七個鬧鐘全被我關掉，而我對這件事毫無印象。」
延伸：「我執行力最強的計畫，是那個我睡著也做得完的。」

en.content:
Seven alarms. Five minutes apart. Named "up", "really up", and "this time I mean it".
They go off one at a time and I kill them one at a time, eyes shut throughout, accuracy one hundred percent.
By the time I actually open my eyes, the previous thirty-five minutes are simply missing.
The most reliably executed routine of my entire life
is the one I can complete while unconscious.
en.editorNote: For the morning you wake up to seven dismissed alarms and zero memory of dismissing them.
variations: Short: "Seven alarms dismissed. No memory of dismissing any of them."
Extended: "My best follow-through belongs to the routine I can finish asleep."

items.sourceNote: 方格子文章討論考古題的正確使用方式與「淪為背答案」的常見誤區；「答案印在右下角、那行印得有點歪」的認臉比喻為原創

zh-tw.content:
同一份卷子我寫到第三遍，分數確實變高了。
但我心裡很清楚那是怎麼來的。
我不是想起這題怎麼解，
我是想起答案印在右下角，而且那個選項那行印得有點歪。
這份卷子我已經熟到可以認臉，
換一份新的，我在裡面一個人都不認識。
zh-tw.editorNote: 第 N 次重寫同一份題目、發現進步的是記憶不是理解的時候。
variations: 短版：「我不是記得解法，我是記得答案印在右下角。」
延伸：「這份卷子我熟到能認臉，換一份我一個人都不認識。」

en.content:
Third pass through the same paper. The score went up. It genuinely did.
I know exactly where that came from, though.
I'm not recalling how to solve the question.
I'm recalling that the answer sits in the bottom right corner, on the line that's printed slightly crooked.
I know this paper well enough to recognize it by face.
Hand me a new one and I don't know a single person in the room.
en.editorNote: For the nth run through the same practice set, when what improved was your memory, not your grasp.
variations: Short: "Not recalling the method. Recalling that the answer lives in the bottom right."
Extended: "I can recognize this paper by face. A new one is a room full of strangers."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 考試板討論付費自習空間的實際使用經驗（找位子、環境、預約流程）；「前置作業吃掉一小時」的流程清單為原創

zh-tw.content:
我到自習室之後的流程是這樣的：
先繞一圈找有插座的位子，坐下，調椅子高度，把講義攤成一個很像在讀書的角度，
手機轉靜音塞到背包最裡層，起身去裝水，回來覺得有點熱，再去把外套掛好，
最後想到等一下一定會想上廁所，那不如現在先去。
一切就緒，抬頭看時鐘，一個小時不見了。
而且我有點累。
今天的力氣，全部花在把自己擺成一個在讀書的姿勢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 坐定之後才發現整個下午都花在準備要開始，適合貼給一起讀書的朋友互相指認。
variations: 短版：「一切就緒，抬頭一看，一個小時不見了，而且我有點累。」
延伸：「今天的力氣，全部花在把自己擺成一個在讀書的姿勢。」

en.content:
Outlet first. Lap the whole floor until I find a seat next to one.
Sit. Adjust the chair. Fan the handouts open at an angle that looks like studying.
Phone on silent, buried at the bottom of the bag. Get up for water. Come back too warm, go hang the jacket.
Then realize I'll want the bathroom later, so I may as well go now.
All set. Look up at the clock. One hour is gone.
Also I'm a little tired.
Today's energy went entirely into arranging myself into the shape of a person who studies.
en.editorNote: For the afternoon that disappeared into getting ready to start — send it to whoever you study with.
variations: Short: "All set. Looked up. One hour gone, and I'm a little tired."
Extended: "Spent the whole day arranging myself into the shape of someone who studies."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 閒聊板討論二手書出售管道與收購行情，提到書店對有畫記、寫字的書收購意願低；「畫太滿所以只有你看得懂」的對白為原創

zh-tw.content:
我抱著兩箱參考書去二手書店。
老闆一本一本翻，翻到一半停下來說：「這幾本畫線畫太滿了，不收。」
我說那幾本是我寫最多的。
他說：「對啊，所以只有你看得懂。」
最後被收走的，全是我幾乎沒翻過的那幾本，乾淨、漂亮、可以再賣一次。
我抱著剩下的走出來，箱子輕了一點，
而留在裡面的重量，全部都是我自己的字。
zh-tw.editorNote: 清書櫃、把用過的書處理掉的時候，發現最捨不得的那幾本剛好最沒行情。
variations: 短版：「被收走的是我沒翻過的，帶回家的都是我寫滿的。」
延伸：「老闆說畫太滿不收，因為那些字只有我自己看得懂。」

en.content:
I hauled two boxes of prep books down to the used bookstore.
The owner flipped through them, stopped halfway, and said, "These are marked up too heavily. Can't take them."
I told him those were the ones I wrote in most.
"Right," he said. "Which means you're the only one who can read them."
What he bought were the ones I'd barely opened — clean, unbent, good enough to sell again.
I carried the rest back out. The box was lighter,
and everything still in it was my own handwriting.
en.editorNote: For clearing the shelf and realizing the books you can't part with are the ones nobody wants.
variations: Short: "He bought the ones I never opened. I took home the ones I filled."
Extended: "Too marked up to resell, he said — because those notes only make sense to me."

items.sourceNote: 自由時報報導 115 學年度大學分發入學共 3 萬 3071 人完成登記、招生名額創新低、8/17 放榜；等待期間的技能清單為原創

zh-tw.content:
放榜前的這幾天，我意外練出了幾項新技能：
一、那則「三萬多人登記、名額創新低」的新聞，我可以背出裡面每一個數字。
二、光聽我媽問「今天想吃什麼」的語氣，就能判斷她剛剛有沒有偷查資料。
三、飯桌上被問到的瞬間，把話題轉到表哥當兵的梯次，成功率非常高。
四、一邊說「我看開了」，一邊按重新整理。
這些技能都很實用，
而且會在那份名單出來的同一秒，全部一起失效。
zh-tw.editorNote: 放榜前坐立難安的那幾天，傳給一樣在等的同學，一起承認自己有多沒出息。
variations: 短版：「我這幾天最熟練的技能，是一邊說看開了、一邊按重新整理。」
延伸：「這些技能非常實用，可惜名單一出來就全部一起失效。」

en.content:
Skills I have accidentally picked up while waiting for results:
1. I can recite every figure in that news story about record-low places and thirty-odd thousand applicants.
2. I can tell from how my mum asks what I want for dinner whether she's been looking things up again.
3. I can redirect any dinner-table question onto when my cousin reports for military service, near-perfect success rate.
4. I can say "I've made my peace with it" while hitting refresh.
All genuinely useful skills —
and all of them expire the second that list goes up.
en.editorNote: For the restless days before results, to send to whoever is waiting on the same list.
variations: Short: "My sharpest new skill: saying I've made my peace with it while hitting refresh."
Extended: "Useful skills, every one of them, and they all expire the second the list goes up."

items.sourceNote: 自由時報報導分科測驗考生 8/5 起填寫分發志願、考分會建議盡量填滿志願、8/17 放榜；把志願表擬人化為夜訪訪客的寫法為原創

zh-tw.content:
志願表送出去的那天，我以為這件事就結束了。
結果它每天晚上都回來，坐在我床邊，問我第三個志願為什麼要放在那裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 志願送出後卻整晚反覆重排順序的時候，貼一句給同樣睡不著的人。
variations: 短版：「表格送出去了，它卻每天晚上回來問我問題。」
延伸：「送出去的是那張表，留下來的是一個一直問我為什麼的人。」

en.content:
I thought submitting my preference list was the end of it.
Instead it comes back every night, sits on the edge of my bed, and asks why I put my third choice where I did.
en.editorNote: For the nights after you've submitted, when your brain keeps re-ranking the list anyway.
variations: Short: "The form went in. It still comes back at night with questions."
Extended: "I submitted the list. What stayed behind was the person who keeps asking why."

items.sourceNote: 大學考試入學分發委員會公告 115 學年度重要時程，分發結果於 8/17 上午放榜、8/17 至 8/20 受理複查；家中電話對話的場景與台詞為原創

zh-tw.content:
我媽今天講電話，另一頭是三姑還是誰。
她說：「還沒啦，還沒放榜，下禮拜一才知道。」
講完那句，她又補了一句我沒料到的：「不過他有努力啦，我看得出來。」
我在房間裡沒出聲，手機停在同一個畫面上很久。
我一直以為這件事只有我一個人在等。
原來她也在等，只是她等的東西跟我不一樣——
她早就先準備好一句話，不管結果是哪一種都用得上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 放榜前家裡氣氛很微妙的那幾天，可以傳給爸媽，也可以自己留著。
variations: 短版：「『他有努力啦，我看得出來』——那句其實不是講給電話那頭聽的。」
延伸：「我以為只有我在等，其實我媽也在等，只是她準備的是另一種答案。」

en.content:
My mum was on the phone today with an aunt of some description.
She said, "Not yet, results aren't out, we'll know on Monday."
Then she added something I wasn't braced for: "He worked hard, though. I could see it."
I stayed quiet in my room, phone frozen on the same screen for a long while.
I'd assumed I was the only one waiting on this.
Turns out she's waiting too, just for something different —
she already has a sentence ready that works no matter which way it lands.
en.editorNote: For the odd, careful days at home before results, whether you send it to your parents or just keep it.
variations: Short: "'He worked hard, though' — that line wasn't for the person on the other end of the call."
Extended: "I thought I was the only one waiting. She was too, with a different answer prepared."

items.sourceNote: 學習科學整理指出重讀會製造「熟悉感錯覺」、主動提取才留得住；本則把它寫成兩句自嘲，文字為原創

zh-tw.content:
講義看到第三遍，每一行都很眼熟。
眼熟和記得中間，隔著一整張考卷。
zh-tw.editorNote: 讀完一輪覺得自己都會了的時候，先傳給自己看。
variations: 短版：「每一行都很眼熟，可惜眼熟不算分。」
延伸：「看得懂和寫得出來，是兩種完全不同的技能。」

en.content:
Third pass through the notes and every line looks familiar.
Familiar and remembered are a whole exam paper apart.
en.editorNote: For the moment a revision round ends and you feel suspiciously confident.
variations: Short: "Every line looks familiar. Familiar earns zero marks."
Extended: "Recognizing it and producing it are two different skills entirely."

items.sourceNote: 取材自模擬考檢討時「看解答就都懂了」的普遍經驗，句子為原創

zh-tw.content:
模擬考檢討的時候，我每一題都會。
可惜考卷只收我第一次寫的那個版本。
zh-tw.editorNote: 檢討完考卷、覺得自己被自己耽誤時使用。
variations: 短版：「檢討時我是神，作答時我是路人。」
延伸：「我最厲害的那個我，永遠晚了一節課才出現。」

en.content:
During the review session I get every question right.
Shame the paper only accepts the first draft of me.
en.editorNote: For right after a mock test post-mortem, when hindsight feels wasted.
variations: Short: "Genius in review, stranger during the actual test."
Extended: "My best self always shows up exactly one class period late."

items.sourceNote: 發回考卷時同學互相遮分數的教室日常；場景與句子為原創，未引用任何討論串內容

zh-tw.content:
考卷發回來，老師從第一排開始傳。
我們這排有個沒人講過的默契：
拿到的人先把有分數那一面往內折，再遞給後面。
沒有人約好，也沒有人問。
那幾秒鐘裡，我們用一個很小的動作互相保護。
zh-tw.editorNote: 發考卷那天想謝謝同學的時候，貼給他們看。
variations: 短版：「沒人約好，但每個人都會把分數那面折起來再傳。」
延伸：「那個小動作沒有名字，卻是我們那排最溫柔的規矩。」

en.content:
The teacher hands the papers back, front row first.
Our row has a rule nobody ever agreed on out loud:
you fold the graded side inward before passing it along.
Nobody asks. Nobody checks.
For those two seconds, one small gesture keeps everyone covered.
en.editorNote: For the day papers come back and your row quietly has your back.
variations: Short: "Nobody agreed on it, but everyone folds the score inward before passing it back."
Extended: "That gesture has no name, and it was the kindest rule our row had."

items.sourceNote: 參考文昌帝君供品與文昌筆的民俗介紹，作為背景；家人送筆的情節與句子為原創，不涉任何結果承諾

zh-tw.content:
那年考前，姑姑塞給我一支毛筆，說是去廟裡求的。
我沒拆封，就這樣放在筆筒裡。
後來考完了，換了學校，那支筆還在。
它沒有讓我多寫對一題，
但每次整理桌面看到它，我都會想起：
那陣子有人一直在替我掛心。
zh-tw.editorNote: 整理書桌翻到長輩送的東西時，適合配這一段。
variations: 短版：「那支筆沒讓我多對一題，但它記得有人替我擔心過。」
延伸：「長輩給的不是考運，是一句不好意思說出口的加油。」

en.content:
Before that exam, my aunt pressed a calligraphy brush into my hand — blessed at a temple, she said.
I never unwrapped it. It just lived in my pen cup.
The exam passed. I changed schools. The brush is still there.
It never won me a single extra mark,
but every time I tidy the desk and see it, I remember:
back then, someone was quietly worrying on my behalf.
en.editorNote: For clearing your desk and finding something an older relative gave you.
variations: Short: "The brush won me nothing. It remembers that someone worried about me."
Extended: "What relatives hand you isn't luck — it's encouragement they're too shy to say."

items.sourceNote: 考生分享走出考場後彼此寒暄的情境為背景，句子與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content: 「你考得怎樣」在考場門口不是問句，是「陪我難過一下」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考完在門口跟同學對上眼、誰都不想先講分數的那幾秒。
variations: 短版：「那句『考得怎樣』，從來就不是要答案。」
延伸版：「我們互相問了三次，誰也沒真的回答，但心情確實有比較好。」

en.content: Out front, 'how'd it go' isn't a question. It's 'sit here and feel bad with me for a minute.'
en.editorNote: For that pause outside the exam hall when nobody wants to name a number first.
variations: Short: "'How'd it go' was never after an answer."
Extended: "We asked each other three times, nobody actually answered, and somehow it helped."

items.sourceNote: 考後裝沒事的常見反應為背景，句子為原創

zh-tw.content: 「還好啦沒差」這五個字，我在校門口講了七遍，越講越沒說服力。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考完硬要裝不在意、結果被自己拆穿的時候。
variations: 短版：「沒差」講到第七次，連我自己都不信了。
延伸版：「真的沒差的人，不會需要一直說沒差。」

en.content: I said 'honestly, it's fine' seven times at the gate. Each one landed with less conviction than the last.
en.editorNote: For pretending you don't care about a paper you very much care about.
variations: Short: "By the seventh 'it's fine,' even I stopped buying it."
Extended: "People who are actually fine don't need to keep announcing it."

items.sourceNote: 考生描述考後在路上被同學拉著核對題目的經驗為背景，句子為原創

zh-tw.content: 有人問了一句「第三題你選什麼」，回家的路就從那裡開始變長。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考完不小心被拉進對答案、整條路瞬間安靜下來的時候。
variations: 短版：「一句『你選什麼』，可以讓十分鐘的路走成半小時。」
延伸版：「那條路本來很短，是我們自己把它走成檢討會。」

en.content: Someone asks what you put for question three, and the walk home starts getting longer right there.
en.editorNote: For getting pulled into comparing answers before you've even left the block.
variations: Short: "One 'what did you put' turns a ten-minute walk into thirty."
Extended: "The walk home was short. We're the ones who turned it into a post-mortem."

items.sourceNote: 同學之間考後互相安慰的情境為背景，句子與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content: 同學說「我也錯了」，八成是騙我的，但我那天很需要那句謊。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合想起考完那天，有人願意陪你一起說「我也一樣」的時刻。
variations: 短版：「他說他也錯了，我知道那不是真的。」
延伸版：「有些謊不是要騙你，是不想讓你一個人站在那裡。」

en.content: My friend said she got it wrong too. Probably a lie. That day I really needed that lie.
en.editorNote: For remembering whoever stood next to you and said 'same here' when it wasn't true.
variations: Short: "She said she missed it too. I knew better. I let it stand."
Extended: "Some lies aren't meant to fool you. They're meant to keep you from standing there alone."

items.sourceNote: 檢討考卷時老師的口頭禪引發的集體反應為背景，句子與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
「這題我上課有講過喔。」
老師講完這句，教室會有兩秒鐘特別安靜。
那不是心虛，是全班同時在腦袋裡翻找那一天。
我甚至找得到那堂課的筆記，字很工整，日期也對，內容完全陌生。
所以我確定我人有到、手也有動，
只是那段話進來的時候，家裡剛好沒人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合檢討考卷時被一句「有講過」擊中，明明有抄筆記卻毫無印象的那兩秒。
variations: 短版：「筆記是我的字，內容是別人的記憶。」
延伸版：「我上課從來沒缺席，缺席的是那個負責記住的人。」

en.content:
"I went over this in class."
After that line there's always about two seconds of total silence.
It isn't guilt. It's thirty people searching their memory for that exact day.
I can even find the notes. Neat handwriting, correct date, completely unfamiliar content.
So I was there, and my hand was moving.
The words just arrived at a house with nobody home.
en.editorNote: For the two seconds after a teacher says they covered it, when your own notes prove you were present and nothing else does.
variations: Short: "The handwriting is mine. The memory belongs to someone else."
Extended: "I never skipped that class. The part of me in charge of remembering did."

items.sourceNote: 以考生到借用考場看座位、桌面留有他人痕跡的實務情境為背景，內容與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
那間學校我這輩子只進去過一次。
教室在三樓最角落，桌子是別人的，椅子也是。
桌面右上角有人用立可白寫了一個名字，旁邊畫了一顆歪掉的星星。
抽屜裡留著半包餅乾，還有一張皺掉的段考成績單。
我在那張桌子前面坐了八十分鐘，
中途有一瞬間很想跟它的主人道歉，因為我把他的位子弄得很緊張。
鈴響之後，我順手把桌面擦乾淨才走。
我們大概一輩子不會認識，
但那個早上，全台灣有好幾萬張桌子被這樣借走一天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫考場借用的那間陌生教室，或想起自己曾坐在誰的位子上考完一場試。
variations: 短版：「我在一張不認識的桌子上，決定了自己的下一年。」
延伸版：「那張桌子的主人也在別的地方考試，我們互相借了一天的位子。」

en.content:
I've been inside that school exactly once in my life.
Third floor, corner classroom. The desk wasn't mine. Neither was the chair.
Someone had written a name in correction fluid on the top right corner, with a lopsided star beside it.
Half a pack of cookies in the drawer, plus a crumpled midterm report.
I sat at that desk for eighty minutes,
and at one point genuinely wanted to apologize to its owner for making his seat so nervous.
When the bell rang I wiped the surface clean before leaving.
We'll almost certainly never meet,
but that morning, tens of thousands of desks got borrowed exactly the same way.
en.editorNote: For test day in a borrowed classroom, sitting at a stranger's desk to decide your own next year.
variations: Short: "I decided my next year at a desk I'd never seen before."
Extended: "Whoever owns that desk was sitting an exam somewhere else. We traded seats for a day without ever meeting."

items.sourceNote: 考生反覆更換文具、以買新東西當作重新開始的普遍心理為背景，句子為原創

zh-tw.content:
這三年我換過三支筆。
第一支是全班都在用的那款，因為大家說寫起來比較快。
第二支是網路上推薦的，握起來很專業，我用它抄完兩本筆記。
第三支是我媽在文具店隨手拿的，最便宜，也最不像一回事。
真正陪我寫完最後一張考卷的，是第三支。
會不會寫跟拿什麼筆沒有關係，
但每次買新的那天，我是真心想重新開始。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合換筆、換筆記本、換讀書 app 卻始終沒換掉自己的那種心情。
variations: 短版：「我買過最貴的那支，只寫完了一張計畫表。」
延伸版：「裝備一直在升級，真正上場的還是同一個人。」

en.content:
Three years, three pens.
The first was the one everyone in class had, because word was it wrote faster.
The second came off a recommendation thread, felt very professional in the hand, and got me through two full notebooks.
The third my mom grabbed off a shelf at the stationery store. Cheapest one. Looked like nothing.
The pen that was actually with me for my last exam paper was the third one.
What you can answer has nothing to do with what you're holding,
but every time I bought a new one, I really did mean to start over.
en.editorNote: For anyone who has swapped pens, notebooks and study apps without ever swapping out the actual problem.
variations: Short: "The most expensive pen I ever bought finished exactly one study plan."
Extended: "The gear kept getting upgraded. The person using it stayed the same."

items.sourceNote: 以考場當眾拆封試題袋的固定流程與氣味記憶為背景，內容與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
每一科開始之前，監考老師會當著全班的面拆開那袋試題。
塑膠封膜被撕開的聲音很短，短到整間教室會跟著安靜下來，
接著飄出一股剛印好的紙味，混著油墨，涼涼的。
那個味道一年只會出現幾次，
卻比任何鬧鐘都有效，鼻子一收到，整個人自動繃起來。
畢業很久以後，我在影印店等東西，同樣的味道又飄過來，
胃先縮了一下，我才想起來為什麼。
身體記東西的方法跟背書不一樣，它不需要複習。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合形容拆考卷那一瞬間的氣味與緊繃，或多年後被同樣味道突襲的時刻。
variations: 短版：「那股油墨味一飄過來，我的身體就先坐直了。」
延伸版：「我背過的都忘了，只有那個味道還完整地留著。」

en.content:
Before every subject, the proctor tears open the sealed packet of question booklets in front of everyone.
The plastic film rips for maybe half a second, and the whole room goes quiet along with it.
Then comes the smell of fresh print — paper and ink, faintly cool.
That smell shows up a few times a year at most,
and it beats any alarm clock. My nose registers it and my whole body braces.
Years after graduating, waiting on an order at a copy shop, the same smell drifted past.
My stomach reacted first. My head caught up a second later.
The body files things differently than studying does. It never needs review.
en.editorNote: For the smell of a freshly opened exam packet, and the way it can ambush you years later.
variations: Short: "One whiff of that ink and my spine straightened before I did."
Extended: "Everything I memorized is gone. Only the smell survived intact."

items.sourceNote: 以錄取後被拉進新生群組、自我介紹打了又刪的焦慮為背景，內容與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
昨天下午我被拉進一個叫「115級新生」的群組，五分鐘內跳出兩百多則訊息。
有人在問要不要一起找室友，有人已經在揪九月見面。
我打了「大家好」，刪掉，改成「大家好，我是分發進來的」，又刪掉。
最後送出去的只有一個貼圖，然後我盯著螢幕上那個校名，練習把它當成自己的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合剛被拉進新學校群組、新身分還沒穿上身的那幾天，配一張打字框截圖很有戲。
variations: 短版：「群組裡兩百則訊息，我的貢獻是一個貼圖。」
延伸版：「新的身分要先在打字框裡練幾次，才敢按送出。」

en.content:
Yesterday I got added to a group chat called "Class of 2030," and two hundred messages showed up in five minutes.
People were asking about roommates; a few were already planning a meetup in September.
I typed "hey everyone," deleted it, typed "hey everyone, I came in through the placement round," deleted that too.
What I actually sent was a sticker, and then I sat there staring at the school's name, practicing thinking of it as mine.
en.editorNote: For those first days in a new school's group chat, when the new identity still doesn't quite fit.
variations: Short: "Two hundred messages in the chat. My contribution: one sticker."
Extended: "You rehearse a new identity in the type box before you dare hit send."

items.sourceNote: 以放榜後等學校寄實體資料袋、家人不說出口的在意為背景，內容與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
中午郵差按電鈴，我媽從廚房衝出去簽收，速度快得像在搶什麼。
我以為是學校寄來的資料袋，結果拆開是她上個月訂的一組保鮮盒。
她把箱子放在鞋櫃上，愣了兩秒才問我的什麼時候會到。
我說要下禮拜，她「喔」了一聲，就蹲在那裡把保鮮盒一個一個擦過，擦得特別久。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合放榜後等實體通知的那幾天，也適合形容家人嘴上不提、身體卻很誠實的在意。
variations: 短版：「我媽衝去簽收的速度，比我還像在等那封信。」
延伸版：「她沒有問我幾分，只問我的信什麼時候會到。」

en.content:
The mail carrier rang at noon and my mom sprinted out of the kitchen to sign for it.
I figured it was the packet from the school; it turned out to be the food containers she ordered last month.
She set the box on the shoe cabinet, went quiet for two seconds, then asked when mine was supposed to arrive.
I said next week, she said "oh," and then stayed crouched there wiping every container one at a time, for much longer than they needed.
en.editorNote: For the stretch after results when you're waiting on the physical letter, and for parents who worry without ever saying so.
variations: Short: "My mom ran for that door faster than I would have."
Extended: "She never asked what I scored. She asked when my letter was coming."

items.sourceNote: 以考分會線上查榜系統開放至 8/20 下午五點的時程為背景，內容與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
查榜頁面下面有一行小字：系統開放到八月二十號下午五點。
也就是說，我還有兩天可以一直重新輸入自己的號碼，確認那一行不會突然不見。
它當然不會不見，這件事我很清楚，但我今天已經查了六次。
看樣子要等到那個網站自己關掉，我才會真的相信這件事結束了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合上榜之後還一直手癢重查的人，也很適合形容「好消息也需要時間才敢相信」的狀態。
variations: 短版：「那個網站關掉的那天，我才會真的收工。」
延伸版：「同一行字我讀了六遍，每一遍都還是覺得不太真實。」

en.content:
There's a line of fine print under the results page: the system stays open until 5 p.m. on August 20th.
Which means I have two more days to keep typing in my number and confirming that line hasn't quietly vanished.
It won't vanish, I know that perfectly well, and I've still checked six times today.
Apparently I won't believe this is over until the website shuts itself down.
en.editorNote: For anyone who got in and still keeps reloading the page, and for how long good news takes to sink in.
variations: Short: "The day that site goes offline is the day I finally clock out."
Extended: "Six reads of the same line and it still didn't feel real."

items.sourceNote: 以分發放榜後未錄取、決定再考一年的心情為背景，內容與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
名單上沒有我。
同學一個一個在限動貼上校徽，我一則一則按了愛心，每一則都是真心的。
今天下午我走進書局，買了一本明年的行事曆。
櫃檯問我要不要包起來，我說不用，我等一下就要開始寫。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合沒有等到那一行字、但已經決定再走一次的人；也適合拿來陪身邊那個安靜下來的朋友。
variations: 短版：「幫每個上榜的朋友按完愛心，然後去買了明年的行事曆。」
延伸版：「店員問要不要包裝，我說不用，這種東西越早弄髒越好。」

en.content:
My name wasn't on the list.
One by one my classmates posted their school crests to their stories, and one by one I hit like, and I meant every single one.
This afternoon I walked into a bookstore and bought a planner for next year.
The cashier asked if I wanted it wrapped, and I said no thanks, because I'm starting on it on the way home.
en.editorNote: For the ones whose line never showed up and who have already decided to go again, and for anyone trying to find the right thing to say to them.
variations: Short: "Liked every one of their posts, then went and bought next year's planner."
Extended: "Didn't need it wrapped. The sooner it gets scuffed up, the better."

items.sourceNote: 以錄取外縣市校系後第一次查通勤時間的感受為背景，內容與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
我在地圖上輸入家裡到學校，跳出來的數字是三小時四十分。
過去一年我算過的數字，全部都是拿來比較的：級分、加權、錄取率、還差幾分。
這一個不用跟誰比高低，也不會被排進任何一張名單裡。
它只是很老實地告訴我，以後想回家吃一頓晚餐，要先出門這麼久。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合錄取外縣市學校、第一次意識到自己真的要離家的那個下午。
variations: 短版：「查完通勤時間，離家這件事才真的有了重量。」
延伸版：「三小時四十分，是我這一年第一個不用拿去跟人比的數字。」

en.content:
I typed my house and my new school into the map app and it gave me three hours forty.
Every number I handled this past year existed to be compared: scores, weightings, admission rates, how many points short I was.
This one doesn't get ranked against anyone, and it won't show up on any list.
It just tells me, very plainly, how long I'll be on the road if I want to come home for dinner.
en.editorNote: For the afternoon you look up the commute to a school in another city and realize you're actually leaving.
variations: Short: "Checked the commute time. That's when leaving got real."
Extended: "Three hours forty — the first number all year that wasn't a competition."

items.sourceNote: 以放榜後第一次剪頭髮、不再受高中髮長規定限制的情境為背景，內容與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
「一樣剪到眉毛上面」，設計師舉著我的瀏海這樣問。
我說這次不用了，想留長看看。
「所以是畢業了喔」，她把剪刀放回檯面，笑著看我。
我點頭，忽然發現這三年，我的頭髮該留多長，從來沒有一次由我決定。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合放榜後第一次走進髮廊、發現自己終於可以自己決定的那一刻。
variations: 短版：「設計師問要不要一樣，我第一次回答不用。」
延伸版：「剪刀放下的那一秒我才想起，這三年頭髮多長從來不歸我管。」

en.content:
"Same as always, up above the eyebrows?" the stylist asked, holding up my bangs.
I told her not this time, that I wanted to grow it out.
"So you graduated, huh?" she said, setting the scissors down on the counter.
I nodded, and it hit me that for three years the length of my hair was never actually my call.
en.editorNote: For the first haircut after results come out, when the rules finally stop applying to you.
variations: Short: "She asked if I wanted the usual, and for once I said no."
Extended: "Three years of haircuts, and not one of them was my decision."

items.sourceNote: 以錄取後列印新生學雜費繳費單、家長在餐桌上處理的場景為背景，內容與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
我是今天早上被印出來的那張紙，右下角有一串很長的號碼。
我被放在餐桌中間，兩個大人輪流看我，其中一個把眼鏡推到額頭上。
他們沒有討論金額，全部的話題都在確認繳費期限是禮拜幾。
後來我被壓在鑰匙盤下面，聽見有人說明天一早就去繳，別放到過期。
zh-tw.editorNote: 獻給那張沒有人多說一句、卻被壓在鑰匙旁邊怕忘記的新生繳費單。
variations: 短版：「他們沒有討論金額，只確認了截止日是禮拜幾。」
延伸版：「我被壓在鑰匙盤下面，那是這個家最怕忘記東西的位置。」

en.content:
I'm the sheet of paper that came out of the printer this morning, with a long string of numbers down in the corner.
They set me in the middle of the dinner table, and two adults took turns looking at me, one of them pushing his glasses up onto his forehead.
Nobody said a word about the amount; the whole conversation was about which day the deadline lands on.
Then I got tucked under the key tray, and I heard someone say to go to the bank first thing tomorrow, before it expires.
en.editorNote: For the tuition slip nobody comments on, filed under the keys so it can't be forgotten.
variations: Short: "Nobody mentioned the amount. They only checked the deadline."
Extended: "Under the key tray — the one spot in the house reserved for things we can't forget."

items.sourceNote: 以放榜後準備外宿、量窗簾尺寸的日常為背景，對照去年同日的考前生活，內容與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
去年的八月十九號，我坐在補習班第三排，桌上壓著一張倒數三百天的紙。
今年的八月十九號，我拿著捲尺在量窗戶，因為租屋處的窗簾要自己買。
兩個日期一樣，我手上算的東西換了：一個是還剩幾天，一個是還差幾公分。
幸好後面這種算錯了，還可以再量一次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合去年還在倒數、今年已經在量家具尺寸的那個人。
variations: 短版：「去年在算還剩幾天，今年在算還差幾公分。」
延伸版：「至少量錯尺寸這件事，可以重新量一次。」

en.content:
On August nineteenth last year I was in the third row of a cram school, with a countdown sheet on my desk that said three hundred days.
On August nineteenth this year I'm holding a tape measure against a window, because the curtains at my rental don't come with the place.
Same date, different math: one was how many days were left, this one is how many centimeters short.
At least with this kind, you get to measure again when you're wrong.
en.editorNote: For the person who spent last August counting down and is spending this one measuring furniture.
variations: Short: "Last year I counted days. This year I count centimeters."
Extended: "At least a bad measurement is one you get to take again."

items.sourceNote: 以錄取外地學校、離家前整理行李的心情為背景，內容與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
行李等一下再收，先去把冰箱打開。
看一看裡面有哪幾樣，是只有你會吃的。
不用拍照，記在腦子裡就好。
九月之後你會站在另一座城市的超市貨架前面找很久，找的就是那幾樣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合放榜後準備離家的人，在收行李之前先做這一件小事。
variations: 短版：「收行李之前，先去把冰箱打開看一看。」
延伸版：「你會在別的城市的貨架前站很久，找的就是冰箱裡那幾樣。」

en.content:
Leave the suitcase for later and go open the refrigerator first.
Take a look at which few things in there are the ones only you eat.
Don't photograph them, just keep them in your head.
Come September you'll be standing in a supermarket in another city, scanning a shelf for a long time, and those are what you're looking for.
en.editorNote: For anyone moving out after results, one small thing to do before the suitcase comes out.
variations: Short: "Before you pack, go open the fridge and look."
Extended: "You'll stand in front of a shelf in another city looking for exactly those."

items.sourceNote: 以放榜後即將離家住宿的新生狀態為背景，借用家電保固條款的語氣，內容與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
本機出廠時已完成三年高溫測試，可耐長時間連續運轉，但不保證每次都能一次啟動。
初次使用請先靜置兩週，讓內部零件慢慢回到室溫。
若出現無故發呆、對著行事曆看很久的情形，屬正常現象，不列入維修範圍。
保固期無限延長，唯一條件是遇到問題要打電話回原廠。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合剛考完、準備離家住宿的人，用說明書的口氣提醒自己也提醒家人。
variations: 短版：「初次使用請先靜置兩週，讓零件回到室溫。」
延伸版：「保固期無限延長，唯一條件是遇到問題要打電話回原廠。」

en.content:
This unit cleared three years of continuous high-temperature testing at the factory, so it handles long shifts, though it won't always start on the first try.
Before first use, let it sit for about two weeks so the internal parts come back down to room temperature.
Staring at nothing and reading the same calendar for ten minutes are normal operating behaviors, not defects.
The warranty never expires, and the one condition is that you call the manufacturer when something goes wrong.
en.editorNote: For anyone who just finished exams and is about to move out, written in the voice of a warranty card.
variations: Short: "Let it sit two weeks before first use so the parts cool down."
Extended: "Warranty never expires. One condition: call home when something breaks."

items.sourceNote: 以分發放榜後搬家上學、父親提起自己當年北上求學的場景為背景，內容與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
搬家那天下午，我爸一邊把箱子往後車廂塞，一邊講他當年北上唸書的事。
講到「我那時候什麼都沒帶，就一個電鍋跟」，後車廂蓋自己掉下來，砰的一聲。
他愣了兩秒，改口說這台車也真的老了。
那句話後面本來要接什麼，我到現在還在想。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合搬家那天貼，給那個話講到一半就自己收起來的長輩。
variations: 短版：「他講到一半，後車廂蓋就掉下來了。」
延伸版：「那句話後面本來要接什麼，我到現在還在想。」

en.content:
Moving day, mid-afternoon, my dad was shoving boxes into the trunk and telling me about the year he left home for school.
He got as far as "I didn't bring anything with me, just a rice cooker and" before the trunk lid dropped shut with a bang.
He stood there for two seconds, then said something about how the car's getting old.
I'm still trying to work out how that sentence was supposed to end.
en.editorNote: For moving day, and for the parent who starts a story and then puts it away.
variations: Short: "He got halfway through the sentence and the trunk slammed."
Extended: "I'm still trying to work out how that sentence was supposed to end."

items.sourceNote: 以暑假尾聲調整作息失敗的常見經驗為背景，內容與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
我有一個很真心的建議：暑假最後一週再開始調作息，這樣最省力。
前面幾週先睡到自然醒，把體力養回來，最後七天每天往前挪一小時，紙上完全成立。
我算過三次，每次都很漂亮，實際執行到第二天就整組垮掉。
這個建議我還是照樣給你，反正明年這個時候你也會再算一次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學前一週，發現自己又在重演同一套計畫的時候。
variations: 短版：「最後七天每天往前挪一小時，紙上完全成立。」
延伸版：「反正明年這個時候，你也會再算一次同樣的表。」

en.content:
Here's my completely sincere advice: wait until the last week of break to fix your sleep schedule, it's the least painful way.
Sleep in for the first few weeks, get your energy back, then move bedtime up an hour a night for seven nights. On paper it checks out perfectly.
I've run the numbers three times, they're beautiful every time, and the whole thing collapses by day two.
I'm giving you the advice anyway, because next August you're going to run those same numbers again.
en.editorNote: For the week before school starts, when you catch yourself rebuilding the same doomed plan.
variations: Short: "Move bedtime up an hour a night for seven nights. On paper it checks out."
Extended: "Next August you're going to run those same numbers again."

items.sourceNote: 以分發錄取後搭客運前往外縣市學校的長途車程為背景，內容與觀點為原創

zh-tw.content:
客運開上高速公路之後，窗外的招牌從賣豬腳飯換成賣輪胎，再換成一整排太陽能板。
前座有人在講電話，說宿舍要自己帶蚊帳，走道對面的阿姨把鞋脫了，行李箱倒了兩次。
收音機放著一首我媽會跟著哼的老歌，主持人插進來說今天下午雷陣雨機率百分之七十。
我從頭到尾只做了一件事，就是把手機裡那張錄取通知的截圖又打開來看了一次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合第一次搭長途車去報到的那天，在車上發呆的時候。
variations: 短版：「窗外的招牌一路從豬腳飯換成太陽能板。」
延伸版：「整段車程我只做了一件事，把那張截圖又打開來看。」

en.content:
Once the bus hit the freeway, the billboards outside went from braised pork rice to tires to one long field of solar panels.
Somebody up front was on the phone saying you have to bring your own mosquito net to the dorms, and the woman across the aisle kicked her shoes off while her suitcase tipped over twice.
The radio was playing an old song my mom hums along to, and then the host cut in with a seventy percent chance of thunderstorms this afternoon.
The only thing I did the entire ride was open that screenshot of my acceptance notice one more time.
en.editorNote: For the day you take the long bus ride to campus and mostly just stare out the window.
variations: Short: "The billboards went from pork rice to tires to solar panels."
Extended: "The only thing I did all ride was open that screenshot again."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 升大學考試板 開學離家 register — 轉運站送別語感，重寫為第二人稱傾訴

zh-tw.content: 轉運站的月台是照字母排的，你那班在 E，我這班在 B，中間隔著一整條走道跟兩台販賣機。你上車前把耳機分我一邊，歌播到一半就被站務員叫上去，後面那段我一個人站在原地聽完。我們以前在這裡等的是同一班回家的車，現在連發車時間都對不上。這幾句我不會傳給你，你的車要開三個小時，你大概已經靠著窗睡著了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合送朋友上車的那天下午，兩個人從同一個轉運站往不同城市走。
variations: 短版：「你那班在 E，我這班在 B，中間隔著兩台販賣機。」
延伸版：「歌播到一半你就被叫上車，後面那段我站在原地聽完。」

en.content: The gates at the terminal are lettered, so yours is E and mine is B, with a whole concourse and two vending machines in between. You handed me one earbud before you boarded, and the song was barely halfway through when they called your bus, so I stood there and finished the rest of it by myself. We used to wait in this building for the same ride home, and now our departure times don't even line up. I'm not sending you any of this, since your ride is three hours long and you're probably asleep against the window already.
en.editorNote: For the afternoon you see a friend off and the two of you leave the same terminal for different cities.
variations: Short: "Your gate is E, mine is B, two vending machines in between."
Extended: "They called your bus mid-song, so I finished it standing there."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 心情板 畢業後身分轉換 register — 舊證件與肌肉記憶的自嘲，重寫為停車場繳費機場景

zh-tw.content: 停車場的繳費機連吐三次，我很有把握地回頭跟我爸說這台壞了。第四次低頭才看清楚，我一路往投入口塞的是那張邊角磨白的高中學生證。它跟停車票差不多大，又在我外套內袋躺了整整三年，手比腦袋還熟。換成正確那張、錢繳完，我跟我爸說機器修好了，他哦了一聲就往前走。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合畢業後第一次發現，手還記得那張已經用不到的證件。
variations: 短版：「我很有把握地說機器壞了，第四次才看清楚是自己塞錯東西。」
延伸版：「那張證在內袋躺了三年，手比腦袋還熟。」

en.content: The parking kiosk spat my card back three times, and I turned around and told my dad, with total confidence, that the machine was broken. On the fourth try I finally looked down and saw I'd been feeding it my high school ID, corners worn pale. It's about the size of a parking stub, and it had been living in my jacket pocket for three straight years, so my hand knew it better than my head did. I swapped in the right one, paid, and told my dad they'd fixed the machine; he grunted and kept walking.
en.editorNote: For the first time after graduation when your hand still reaches for a card you don't need anymore.
variations: Short: "Told my dad the machine was broken. The machine was fine."
Extended: "My hand knew that pocket better than my head did."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 升大學考試板 新生報到討論 register — 家長送考生出遠門的路上互動，重寫為加油站逐行對白

zh-tw.content:
我：「九五，加五百就好。」
爸：「加滿。」
我：「又不是今天就要開下去。」
爸：「這台的油表不準，指針到一半其實剩不到三分之一。」
我：「所以你都怎麼判斷？」
爸：「加滿就不用判斷。」
我：「⋯⋯那加滿。」
爸：「順便把胎壓也打一打。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合出發去報到的前一晚，被長輩硬是加滿油的那一趟。
variations: 短版：「我：加五百就好。爸：加滿。」
延伸版：「加滿就不用判斷，順便把胎壓也打一打。」

en.content:
Me: "Ninety-five, five hundred's worth."
Dad: "Fill it."
Me: "I'm not driving down there today."
Dad: "The gauge on this car lies. Half a tank is really a third."
Me: "Then how do you ever know?"
Dad: "Fill it and you don't have to know."
Me: "...Fine. Fill it."
Dad: "And we're checking the tires while we're here."
en.editorNote: For the night before you leave, when someone insists on a full tank you don't need yet.
variations: Short: "Fill it and you don't have to know."
Extended: "I'm not driving down today. — Fill it."

items.sourceNote: PTT WomenTalk 聚餐火鍋討論串 register — 借聚餐場景，重寫為打了又刪的訊息草稿

zh-tw.content:
打了：湯底幫你點了番茄，你上次說想吃這個。（刪掉）
打了：你沒來，結果大家從頭到尾都在講你。（刪掉）
打了：沒來也沒差啦，這家很雷。（刪掉，這家明明就很好吃）
打了：你那份鴨血我先吃了，記在你帳上。（刪掉，太得意）
打了：下次你選店，我付錢。（刪掉，好像在補償什麼）
送出去的是：鍋滾了，我明天再打給你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合聚餐時少了一個人，訊息打了半天最後只送出一句的那個晚上。
variations: 短版：「打了五句，送出去的只有『鍋滾了，我明天再打給你』。」
延伸版：「打了：你那份鴨血我先吃了，記在你帳上。（刪掉，太得意）」

en.content:
Typed: We got the tomato broth, the one you said you wanted. (deleted)
Typed: You weren't here and everyone talked about you all night. (deleted)
Typed: You didn't miss much, this place is bad. (deleted, this place is great)
Typed: I ate your duck blood. Putting it on your tab. (deleted, too smug)
Typed: You pick the place next time, I'm paying. (deleted, sounds like an apology)
What I actually sent: Soup's boiling. I'll call you tomorrow.
en.editorNote: For the dinner where one seat stays empty and you draft five messages to send one line.
variations: Short: "Five drafts, one sent: soup's boiling, I'll call you tomorrow."
Extended: "Typed: I ate your duck blood, putting it on your tab. (deleted, too smug)"

items.sourceNote: HotPets 哈寵誌〈飼主帶寵物去美容最在意的8大疑問〉— 取烘毛箱、等候時間、飼主在外面焦慮等待等細節，重寫為烘毛箱第一人稱獨白

zh-tw.content: 溫度設在三十二度，門一關我就開始運轉，裡面那隻黃色的狗是第一次進來，抖得整個籠門都在響。玻璃外面有個高三生把講義攤在膝蓋上，一頁也沒翻，只是盯著門看。她隔著玻璃跟狗說再撐四十分鐘就好，那句話聽起來不太像是講給狗聽的。四十分鐘後我把牠吹得蓬蓬的，剩下的部分我烘不掉。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合放榜後心情還沒乾的那幾天，或是陪別人等待、其實自己更焦慮的時候。
variations: 短版：「四十分鐘後我把牠吹得蓬蓬的，剩下的部分我烘不掉。」
延伸版：「她說再撐四十分鐘就好，那句話聽起來不太像是講給狗聽的。」

en.content: Set to thirty-two degrees, door shut, and I start spinning. The yellow dog inside is a first-timer; he shakes hard enough to rattle the latch. Out past the glass a teenager has a study guide open on her knees and hasn't turned a page, just watching the door. She tells him through the glass that it's only forty more minutes, and it doesn't sound like she's talking to the dog. Forty minutes later he comes out fluffy, and the rest of it I can't dry.
en.editorNote: For the week after results come out, when you're the one waiting outside and pretending it's for someone else.
variations: Short: "He comes out fluffy. The rest of it I can't dry."
Extended: "Only forty more minutes — and it didn't sound like she was talking to the dog."

items.sourceNote: CashFeel 2026 各級學校開學時間整理（中小學 8/31 開學、大學多數 9 月初）— 取開學前汰換舊物的季節感，重寫為舊眼鏡第一人稱獨白

zh-tw.content: 櫃檯把我放在絨布上，量了三個地方，說鏡架已經歪到調不回來了。左邊鏡片那道刮痕，是有人趴在講義上睡著壓出來的；鼻墊發黃，是連續兩個夏天沒被拿下來過。他選了一副更輕的新的，結帳時問說舊的可以留著嗎。店員說當然可以，只是以後大概不會再戴了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學前換掉舊裝備的那天，也適合整理高中三年留下來的東西。
variations: 短版：「店員說當然可以留著，只是以後大概不會再戴了。」
延伸版：「鼻墊發黃，是連續兩個夏天沒被拿下來過。」

en.content: They laid me on the velvet pad, measured me in three places, and said the frame is bent past adjusting. That scratch on the left lens came from someone falling asleep face-down on a practice set; the nose pads yellowed over two summers of never coming off. He picked out something lighter, then asked at the register whether he could keep the old pair. Sure, they said, though he probably won't wear them again.
en.editorNote: For the day you replace the gear that got you through, right before a new term starts.
variations: Short: "Sure, you can keep them. You just won't wear them again."
Extended: "The frame is bent past adjusting. So is the year that bent it."

items.sourceNote: 蘋果仁〈2026 分科測驗放榜／115 大學分發錄取結果查詢〉— 8/17 分發放榜、8/27 前可申請複查，取放榜後出清講義的時間點，寫成二手拍賣刊登文

zh-tw.content:
品項：分科測驗全套講義，物理化學各一箱
狀況：九成新，因為只有前四十頁是我親手寫的
瑕疵：第一頁寫了一句「這次一定」，用立可白蓋不住
附贈：三支沒水的筆、兩張沒撕的標籤貼
運費：買家自付，我可以幫忙搬到宅配店門口
備註：面交請約早上，我下午要去學校報到
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合放榜後清書桌、把講義掛上二手社團的那個下午。
variations: 短版：「九成新，因為只有前四十頁是我親手寫的。」
延伸版：「瑕疵：第一頁寫了一句『這次一定』，用立可白蓋不住。」

en.content:
Item: full set of exam prep books, one box physics, one box chem
Condition: like new, since only the first forty pages have my handwriting
Flaw: page one says "this time for real" and correction tape won't hide it
Included: three dead pens, two sticky tabs I never used
Shipping: buyer pays; I'll carry the boxes to the drop-off counter
Note: meet in the morning please, I report to campus that afternoon
en.editorNote: For the afternoon you clear the desk and list a whole year of books secondhand.
variations: Short: "Like new — only the first forty pages have my handwriting."
Extended: "Flaw: page one says 'this time for real' and correction tape won't hide it."

items.sourceNote: 1111 升學情報〈116 學年度大學入學考試日程暫定〉— 116 學測 2027/1/22–24、英聽第一次 2026/10/17，取新高三倒數的時間感寫成純對話體

zh-tw.content:
學弟：「學長，學測是一月二十二號對吧？」
我：「對，順便記一下英聽十月十七號。」
學弟：「那我現在開始應該還來得及。」
我：「來得及啊，我那年也是從八月底開始說要從八月底開始。」
學弟：「⋯⋯所以你到底幾月開始的？」
我：「等你自己講到第三次的時候就知道了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合剛升高三、正在立志「這週開始」的人，也適合傳給去年的自己。
variations: 短版：「我那年也是從八月底開始說要從八月底開始。」
延伸版：「等你自己講到第三次的時候，就知道幾月開始了。」

en.content:
Junior: "The big exam's January 22nd, right?"
Me: "Right. Also put October 17th down for the listening test."
Junior: "So I've still got time if I start now."
Me: "Sure. My year, I started at the end of August — saying I'd start at the end of August."
Junior: "...So what month did you actually start?"
Me: "You'll know once you've said it three times."
en.editorNote: For anyone entering their final year and swearing this is the week it begins.
variations: Short: "I started at the end of August — saying I'd start at the end of August."
Extended: "So what month did you start? — You'll know once you've said it three times."

items.sourceNote: 臺北科技大學〈115學年度大學部新生入學須知〉— 新生需寄送紙本報到資料、八月下旬完成報到程序；取「寄件」這個動作改寫為郵局櫃檯的慢動作特寫

zh-tw.content:
我把那個裝著報到資料的牛皮紙袋放到磅秤上，手指還壓在封口，沒有真的鬆開。
櫃檯人員把單子轉過來要我簽名，筆尖停在最後一劃，我看著自己把那一撇拉得比平常長。
她說掛號兩天就會到，然後伸手要拿袋子，我的手指是在那一秒才離開的。
袋子被放進後面那台推車的時候，我還站在原地，好像多站三十秒它就會自己退回來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合把報到資料寄出去的那個上午，或任何一種「東西一離手就變成真的」的時刻。
variations: 短版：「她伸手要拿袋子，我的手指是在那一秒才離開的。」
延伸版：「我還站在原地，好像多站三十秒它就會自己退回來。」

en.content:
I set the envelope of enrollment papers on the scale and kept two fingers on the flap without actually letting go.
The clerk spun the form around for my signature, and I watched my own pen stall on the last stroke and drag it longer than usual.
She said registered mail takes two days, then reached for the envelope, and that was the second my fingers finally came off it.
When it landed in the cart behind her I was still standing there, as if thirty more seconds would send it back to me.
en.editorNote: For the morning you mail the enrollment packet, or any moment when letting go of the object is what makes it real.
variations: Short: "She reached for the envelope, and that was the second my fingers came off it."
Extended: "I was still standing there, as if thirty more seconds would send it back."

items.sourceNote: Trip.com〈學生機票怎麼買最划算？2026 多家航空學生優惠資格、行李額度與改票總整理〉— 取出國就學搭機的行李額度與改票細節，改寫為登機門前的單選題

zh-tw.content:
題目：登機門前的最後十五分鐘，你會做的是——
（A）第七次確認護照跟登機證還在同一個口袋
（B）把行李箱的輪子轉正，轉正了再轉一次
（C）傳訊息問那個下週要開學的同學，課表排好了沒
（D）假裝在看免稅店的櫥窗，其實在看送機的人走了沒
（E）以上皆非，我在想我原本可能會坐在哪一間教室
我圈了（D），圈完才發現（E）也對。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學前後要飛出去的那一天，也適合任何一種「已經選好了，還在偷看另一個選項」的心情。
variations: 短版：「我圈了（D），圈完才發現（E）也對。」
延伸版：「（D）假裝在看免稅店的櫥窗，其實在看送機的人走了沒。」

en.content:
Question: With fifteen minutes left at the gate, you will —
(A) check for the seventh time that the passport and boarding pass are in the same pocket
(B) straighten the suitcase wheels, then straighten them again
(C) text the classmate whose term starts next week to ask if his timetable is set
(D) pretend to browse the duty-free window while checking whether the people who drove you here have left
(E) none of the above; you're picturing the classroom you might have been sitting in
I circled (D), and only after circling it saw that (E) was true too.
en.editorNote: For the day you fly out around the start of term, and for anyone who picks one option while still glancing at another.
variations: Short: "I circled (D), and only after circling it saw that (E) was true too."
Extended: "(D) pretend to browse duty-free while checking whether your ride home has left."

items.sourceNote: 親子天下〈2026行事曆總整理！115學年度開學、寒暑假、考試與連假〉— 取暑假七月初到八月底、開學落在八月最後一週的時間軸，改寫為暑假尾聲一個人看完電影的假設語氣獨白

zh-tw.content:
散場的燈亮起來，我走在那條斜斜的走道上，前面兩個人正在爭論這個結局算不算圓滿。
如果去年暑假我有答應他們一起來看第一集，這條走道現在應該是四個人並排走，我大概只負責在旁邊笑。
如果真的是那樣，我今天就會知道誰在哪一段偷偷擦了眼睛，而且可以拿這件事笑他一整年。
走道走完了，門口在下雨，我站著等雨小一點，順便把開學要帶的東西再想一次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合暑假最後幾天一個人去看電影的那種下午，也適合傳給那個「當初沒去成」還卡在心裡的人。
variations: 短版：「如果那樣，我今天就會知道誰在哪一段偷偷擦了眼睛。」
延伸版：「這條走道現在應該是四個人並排走，我大概只負責在旁邊笑。」

en.content:
The house lights come up and I walk the sloped aisle behind two people arguing about whether that ending counts as happy.
If I had said yes last summer when they asked me to the first movie, this aisle would have four of us walking abreast and I'd mostly be the one laughing.
If it had gone that way, I'd know by now which scene made who wipe their eyes, and I'd have a whole year of teasing them about it.
The aisle ends, it's raining outside, and I stand by the door waiting it out and running through what I still have to pack before term starts.
en.editorNote: For the last stretch of summer when you see a movie alone, and for anyone still stuck on an invitation they turned down.
variations: Short: "If it had gone that way, I'd know which scene made who wipe their eyes."
Extended: "This aisle would have had four of us walking abreast."

items.sourceNote: 成功大學出納組〈繳費相關資訊〉— 115學年度學雜費可持繳費通知單至銀行、郵局臨櫃辦理，開學前多數新生需臨櫃處理帳戶手續；取臨櫃等候的場景改寫為旁觀者視角反轉

zh-tw.content:
等候區第三排那個高中生，把兩張證件疊得整整齊齊放在膝蓋上，每隔幾秒就用大拇指壓一次邊角。
螢幕跳號的時候他抬頭，看到前面還有十四個人，就把印章從盒子裡拿出來，看一眼又放回去。
陪他來的大人在旁邊講電話，說今天一定辦得完，語氣輕鬆得像在講別人家的事，可是腳一直在抖。
輪到他的時候他站起來，走兩步又回頭確認椅子上沒留東西——玻璃隔板反射得太清楚，我才發現自己已經看了自己十分鐘。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學前跑各種手續的那幾天，也適合那種「看別人緊張很容易，看自己緊張很難」的時刻。
variations: 短版：「玻璃隔板反射得太清楚，我才發現自己已經看了自己十分鐘。」
延伸版：「他把印章從盒子裡拿出來，看一眼又放回去。」

en.content:
Third row of the waiting area, a high schooler has two ID cards squared up on his knee and flattens the corners with his thumb every few seconds.
When the number board jumps he looks up, counts fourteen people still ahead of him, and takes his name seal out of its little box only to put it straight back.
The adult with him is on the phone saying it'll definitely get done today, breezy as if it were somebody else's errand, while one foot won't stop bouncing.
His turn comes and he stands, takes two steps, turns back to check the chair for anything left behind — and the glass partition reflects so well that I realize I've been watching myself for ten minutes.
en.editorNote: For the week of pre-term errands, and for anyone who finds other people's nerves much easier to look at than their own.
variations: Short: "The glass reflected too well — I'd been watching myself for ten minutes."
Extended: "He took the name seal out of its box just to put it straight back."

items.sourceNote: 聯合新聞網閱讀專題〈在這滾過的年輕歲月——保齡球館〉— 談保齡球館作為台灣學生時代共同休閒場景；另參新莊亞運保齡球館學生時段優惠。取『考完之後仍在球館被舊行程追著跑』的反差改寫

zh-tw.content:
上午八點　提醒　複習進度確認　重複：每天
中午十二點四十　提醒　物理第三章整理　重複：每天
晚上六點　提醒　英文單字五十個　重複：每天
三則一起跳出來的地方是保齡球館六號道，我手指還卡在球孔裡沒抽出來。
朋友問要不要先處理，我說免了，那是三月的我幫八月的我排的。
第七格全倒，螢幕又亮：晚上十點　檢討今天有沒有做完。
我把重複改成每年一次，日子設在今天，內容重寫成七個字——你已經打完了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考完之後手機還在幫你倒數的那幾週，也適合分享給那個把提醒設得比誰都認真的朋友。
variations: 短版：「那是三月的我幫八月的我排的。」
延伸版：「重複改成每年一次，內容只剩七個字。」

en.content:
8:00 AM · Reminder · Check today's review progress · Repeats daily
12:40 PM · Reminder · Physics chapter three summary · Repeats daily
6:00 PM · Reminder · Fifty English vocab words · Repeats daily
All three go off on lane six at the bowling alley, my fingers still wedged in the ball.
My friend asks if I need to deal with that, and I say nope — March me set those up for August me.
Strike in the seventh frame, and the screen lights up again: 10:00 PM · Did you finish today's list?
I switch it to repeat yearly, park it on today, and rewrite the text to four words: you already finished it.
en.editorNote: For the weeks after the last exam when your phone is still counting down for you, and for the friend who set the most diligent reminders of anyone you know.
variations: Short: "March me set those up for August me."
Extended: "Repeat yearly, four words left in the text."

items.sourceNote: 居家整聊室Blair專欄〈課本和筆記要丟還是要留〉— 談課本斷捨離與『擁有書籍不等於擁有知識』；取『留著給明年的人用』這個常見藉口改寫成母子對話

zh-tw.content:
媽在儲藏室門口喊：這幾箱講義還留著嗎。
我說留著吧，明年說不定有人要。
其實明年不會有人要，那些版本早就改版了。
我只是還沒辦法在同一個月裡，把讀完的跟沒讀完的一起搬去秤重。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學前整理房間、對著幾箱舊講義發呆的傍晚，也適合傳給那個嘴上說要丟、手一直沒動的同學。
variations: 短版：「把讀完的跟沒讀完的一起搬去秤重，我還沒辦法。」
延伸版：「我說留著吧，明年說不定有人要——其實我知道不會。」

en.content:
Mom calls from the storeroom doorway: are we keeping these boxes of handouts?
I say sure, somebody might want them next year.
Nobody will want them next year; those editions were revised a long time ago.
I just can't handle carrying the pages I finished and the pages I never got to onto the same scale in the same month.
en.editorNote: For the evening before term starts when you're staring at boxes you swore you'd clear out, and for the classmate who keeps saying they'll toss theirs.
variations: Short: "The pages I finished and the pages I never got to, weighed together — not yet."
Extended: "I said keep them, somebody might want them next year. I knew nobody would."

items.sourceNote: Roo.Cash〈自助加油怎麼加？中油自助加油完整步驟〉— 加油流程與跳停說明；取同一組加油動作在三年間換人操作的視角改寫

zh-tw.content:
爸把油槍插進去，說加九五加滿，我在旁邊背單字。
第二次是我自己下車加的，他坐在駕駛座沒下來，隔著窗說你慢慢來。
第三次還是同一支油槍、同一個手勢，只是這回換我付錢，而且加滿之後要開的那段路，終點在他不會跟過去的城市。
油錶指針從左邊爬到右邊，跟我這三年填過的每一張表格一樣，慢，但是會到。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合放榜之後、要離開家之前的那段日子，也適合送給第一次自己付油錢的人。
variations: 短版：「同一支油槍、同一個手勢，只是這回換我付錢。」
延伸版：「油錶從左邊爬到右邊，慢，但是會到。」

en.content:
Dad works the nozzle, says fill it with 95, and I keep drilling vocab in the passenger seat.
The second time I'm the one who gets out, and he stays behind the wheel and tells me through the window to take my time.
Third time it's the same nozzle and the same flick of the wrist, except now I'm paying, and the road we're filling up for ends in a city he isn't coming to.
The gauge needle crawls from left to right, like every form I filled out these three years: slow, but it gets there.
en.editorNote: For the stretch between placement results and moving out, and for anyone who just paid for a tank of gas with their own money for the first time.
variations: Short: "Same nozzle, same flick of the wrist — except now I'm paying."
Extended: "The needle crawls left to right. Slow, but it gets there."

items.sourceNote: TVBS新聞網〈消波塊防護海岸成過去式？兼具景觀、生態工法成趨勢〉— 台灣約半數海岸線布滿消波塊；取海堤邊的消波塊作為場景，寫成績造成的沉默誤會

zh-tw.content:
我原本以為他那天沒回訊息，是因為分數比我高，怕我尷尬。
那天傍晚我們坐在堤防邊上吹風，腳下一整排消波塊被浪打得啪啪響，我半開玩笑把這件事講出來。
他愣了一下，把手機轉過來給我看——那則訊息卡在傳送中，上面的日期是七月，到今天都還沒送出去。
浪聲很大，大到剛好蓋住我說的那句對不起，他也沒追問，把外套丟過來就繼續看海。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合跟朋友之間因為成績而變得小心翼翼的那段時間，也適合提醒自己：沉默常常只是訊號不好。
variations: 短版：「那則訊息卡在傳送中，上面的日期是七月。」
延伸版：「沉默常常只是訊號不好，跟分數無關。」

en.content:
I'd assumed he went quiet that day because he scored higher than me and didn't want it to be awkward.
That evening we sat up on the seawall with the wind coming in, a whole row of concrete tetrapods getting slapped by the surf below us, and I brought it up half as a joke.
He blinked, then turned his phone around — the message was stuck on sending, dated July, still not delivered.
The waves were loud enough to swallow the apology I said out loud; he didn't ask me to repeat it, just tossed me his jacket and went back to watching the water.
en.editorNote: For the season when grades make you and your friends careful with each other, and as a reminder that silence is usually just bad reception.
variations: Short: "The message was stuck on sending, dated July."
Extended: "Silence is usually just bad reception. It has nothing to do with the numbers."

items.sourceNote: 自由時報〈吳宗憲提宜蘭校安4主張 擬引進義交、AI圍籬〉— 校門口交安與專責校安人員配置的討論；取校門口警衛室這個日常關卡改寫成考季前後三次進出的體感差

zh-tw.content:
校門口警衛室那本簿子上，我在三個月內留了三次名字。
第一次簽的時候手還在抖，來意欄寫的是「拿計算機」，字卻工整得像在畫答案卡，因為那台計算機被我丟在座位上，隔天要用。
第二次去簽，是考完的隔天回教室搬走抽屜裡剩下的課本，值班的伯伯抬頭問我還好嗎，我說還可以，然後在原地多站了一會兒，才反應過來自己確實沒事了。
第三次簽名是在放榜後的早上，來意欄變成「找老師」，伯伯把筆蓋轉開遞過來，說這支筆今年已經替很多人寫過同一句話了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考完到開學之間、一次又一次找理由走回學校的那段日子，也適合送給每天替你開門的那個人。
variations: 短版：「來意欄從『拿計算機』變成『找老師』，中間隔了一整個夏天。」
延伸版：「那支筆今年已經替很多人寫過同一句話。」

en.content:
There's a visitor log in the guard booth at the school gate, and my name is in it three times in three months.
The first signature was still shaky — under reason for visit I put "picking up a calculator," in handwriting neat enough for a bubble sheet, because I'd left the thing on my desk and needed it the next day.
The second one was the day after the exams ended, when I came back for the books left in my drawer, and the guard on duty looked up and asked if I was all right; I said I was, then stood around a while before it registered that I actually was.
The third came the morning after results posted, reason for visit: "seeing a teacher" — he uncapped the pen for me and said it had already written that same line for a lot of people this year.
en.editorNote: For the weeks between the last exam and the first day of term, when you keep finding reasons to walk back onto campus — and for whoever keeps the gate for you.
variations: Short: "Reason for visit went from 'picking up a calculator' to 'seeing a teacher.' A whole summer fits in that gap."
Extended: "That pen has written the same line for a lot of people this year."

items.sourceNote: 聯合新聞網〈班上唯一個申落榜…分科測驗拚上台大 私立東山高中榜單創佳績〉— 個人申請失利後靠分科翻身的考生故事；取「熬到最後」的角度改寫成校門口警衛室的夜間對話

zh-tw.content:
那陣子我幾乎每天都是全校最後一個離開的人，經過校門口警衛室的時候，裡面那台老電風扇轉得比我還努力。
伯伯每次都問同樣一句：今天讀到哪裡了？我每次都答不上來，因為進度表跟現實之間隔著一整個太平洋。
放榜那天我特地繞回去跟他講結果，他伸手把電扇關掉，說他其實早就猜到了，因為肯留到熄燈的孩子，他看過很多個。
校門在我身後慢慢合起來，警衛室的那盞小燈還亮著，像先替下一個熬到最後的人開好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合每天讀到熄燈、覺得沒有人看見自己在撐的那段時間，也適合放榜後想回頭跟誰道謝卻不知怎麼開口的時候。
variations: 短版：「進度表跟現實之間，隔著一整個太平洋。」
延伸版：「肯留到熄燈的孩子，他看過很多個。」

en.content:
That whole season I was usually the last one out of the building, and passing the guard booth by the gate, the old electric fan inside was working harder than I was.
He asked me the same thing every night — how far did you get today? — and I never had an answer, because the distance between my study plan and reality was roughly the width of the Pacific.
The day the results posted I made a detour back to tell him, and he reached over, switched the fan off, and said he'd already guessed, that he's watched plenty of kids stay till the lights go out.
The gate swung shut behind me and the little lamp in the booth was still burning, like it had been left on early for whoever stays latest next year.
en.editorNote: For the stretch when you study till lights-out and nobody seems to notice you holding on, and for the day after results when you want to thank someone and can't find the opening line.
variations: Short: "The distance between my study plan and reality was roughly the width of the Pacific."
Extended: "He's watched plenty of kids stay till the lights go out."

items.sourceNote: 聯合新聞網〈大學分發入學錄取率97.54% 招生缺額603人創6年新低〉— 115分發放榜數據；取放榜後「終於不用再趕」的心情，改寫成同一個腳踏車位在模擬考期間、考完當晚與今天早上的三段對照

zh-tw.content:
腳踏車棚最角落那一格是我的，因為那裡會卡輪胎，從來不會有人跟我搶。
模擬考還在跑的那陣子，有天鎖卡住，我蹲在地上弄了快半小時，最後是被自己氣哭的，跟數學一點關係都沒有。
考完那天的傍晚，同一副鎖一轉就開，我反而愣在那裡，因為接下來沒有任何一件事需要我趕。
今天早上牽車出來時我沒有哭，我把車推到棚外，繞去教室窗外瞄了一下，然後騎上大路，往一個不必再回頭找車位的方向去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考完之後那種突然沒有事情要趕的空白感，也適合要離開待了三年的學校、最後一次收拾自己老位子的時候。
variations: 短版：「同一副鎖一轉就開，我反而愣在那裡。」
延伸版：「往一個不必再回頭找車位的方向去。」

en.content:
My slot was the far corner of the bike shed, the one that chews your tire, so nobody ever fought me for it.
Back when the mock exams were still running, the lock jammed on me one afternoon; I crouched on the concrete wrestling it for half an hour and ended up crying out of sheer temper at myself — nothing to do with math at all.
On the evening the exams finished, that same lock turned right open, and I just stood there, because suddenly nothing waiting for me needed hurrying.
This morning I wheeled the bike out without crying — I pushed it clear of the shed, swung past the classroom window for one last look, then rode onto the main road, in a direction that will never ask me to come back and find a slot.
en.editorNote: For the strange blank space after the exams when nothing is urgent anymore, and for the last time you clear out the spot that was yours for three years.
variations: Short: "That same lock turned right open, and that was what stopped me."
Extended: "A direction that will never ask me to come back and find a slot."

items.sourceNote: TVBS新聞網〈115分科測驗成績查詢》五標分數、登記志願時程與落點分析一次看〉— 成績公布與登記志願時程；取考季結束後這些文件失去效力的落差，改寫成收在餅乾鐵盒裡的三張准考證

zh-tw.content:
昨天整理書桌抽屜，翻出一個以前裝餅乾的鐵盒，裡面壓著三張准考證，邊角都捲起來了。
最舊的那一張是會考的，照片上的我瀏海太長，看起來像在跟鏡頭道歉；最新的那張還很平整，因為只用了兩天。
我本來想把它們丟掉，想了一下還是把蓋子原封蓋回去，順手塞進抽屜最深的地方。
那三張紙現在什麼都證明不了，可是有一段日子，我全部的生活就是靠它們決定要幾點起床。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考季結束後整理房間、突然被舊東西攔下來的那一刻，也適合想丟又丟不掉、乾脆先收起來的心情。
variations: 短版：「最新的那張還很平整，因為只用了兩天。」
延伸版：「那三張紙現在什麼都證明不了。」

en.content:
Cleaning out my desk drawer yesterday I found an old biscuit tin with three exam admission tickets pressed inside, every corner curled.
The oldest is from the junior-high exam — my bangs in that photo are so long I look like I'm apologizing to the camera — while the newest is still perfectly flat, because it only got used for two days.
I meant to bin them, thought about it, put the lid back exactly the way it was, and pushed the tin into the deepest part of the drawer.
Those three slips can't prove anything now, but for a stretch of my life everything I did ran on what time they said I had to be awake.
en.editorNote: For the moment when post-exam tidying gets ambushed by an old object, and for the things you can't throw out yet so you put the lid back on instead.
variations: Short: "The newest one is still flat. It only got used for two days."
Extended: "Those three slips can't prove anything now."

items.sourceNote: 聯合新聞網〈116學測、分科簡章公告 攜帶AI眼鏡視同舞弊不計分 拒交出取消資格〉— 試場規則要求文具盒與透明墊板不得有文字符號；取「把一塊板子擦到什麼都不說」的動作改寫

zh-tw.content:
你把那塊透明墊板從鉛筆盒旁邊抽出來，對著窗戶照了照，確認上面真的什麼字都沒有。
它原本印著一整排注音符號，被你用去光水擦了兩個晚上，邊角現在霧霧的。
進場之前你又拿起來對光看了一次，然後才放進透明夾鏈袋。
鐘響之後那塊板子就墊在答案卡下面，一整節你都沒有再翻過它。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考前一晚檢查文具、把每樣東西都翻來覆去看三遍的時候，也適合傳給那個為了一塊板子擦到半夜的同學。
variations: 短版：「那塊墊板被你擦了兩個晚上，就為了讓它什麼都不說。」
延伸版：「一整節它都在答案卡下面，你沒有再翻過它。」

en.content:
You slide the clear writing board out from beside your pencil case and hold it up to the window, checking that there really isn't a single character left on it.
It used to have a whole row of phonetic symbols printed across the front; two evenings with nail polish remover took them off and left the corners cloudy.
You hold it to the light one more time before you go in, then zip it into the clear pouch.
After the bell it just sits under your answer sheet, and you never turn it over once the whole period.
en.editorNote: For the night before, when you check every item in your pencil case three times over — and for the friend who spent two evenings scrubbing a plastic board clean.
variations: Short: "You scrubbed that board for two evenings just to make it say nothing."
Extended: "It sat under your answer sheet the whole period. You never turned it over."

items.sourceNote: ETtoday〈好懷念～這10樣小時候用過的文具 1500元就能全打包〉— 台灣學生時代文具懷舊清單；取印卡通角色的舊墊板被磨到只剩輪廓的細節改寫

zh-tw.content:
你在抽屜最底下摸到那塊舊墊板，正面印的卡通角色已經被磨得只剩下輪廓。
國小的時候你用它壓過生字簿，也拿它當過扇子，午休搧到手很酸。
現在它被你墊在成績單下面，因為桌面有一道裂縫，寫字會晃。
那個角色叫什麼名字你想不起來了，你只記得它以前是綠色的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考完之後清抽屜、被一件小東西攔下來的那幾分鐘，也適合分享給同一個年代長大的朋友。
variations: 短版：「你用它壓過生字簿，也拿它當過扇子。」
延伸版：「那個角色叫什麼你忘了，你只記得它以前是綠色的。」

en.content:
Your fingers find the old writing board at the very bottom of the drawer, the cartoon character on the front worn down to an outline.
In elementary school you pressed your character workbooks flat with it and fanned yourself through nap time until your arm ached.
These days it lives under your report card, because there's a crack in the desk and the pen wobbles over it.
You can't come up with the character's name anymore; the only thing you're sure of is that it used to be green.
en.editorNote: For the few minutes when clearing out a drawer after exam season gets interrupted by one small object, and for friends who grew up in the same years.
variations: Short: "You pressed workbooks flat with it and fanned yourself with it."
Extended: "You forgot the character's name. You only remember it used to be green."

items.sourceNote: 聯合新聞網〈又一間老字號熄燈！台北在地72年文具店出清 網喊：我的回憶〉— 老文具店結束營業引發共鳴；取在文具店貨架前站很久卻只買一支筆的畫面改寫

zh-tw.content:
你在文具店的第三排站了快十分鐘，手上兩支筆長得一模一樣，只有筆蓋顏色不同。
你最後把藍色那支放回架上，理由是去年考完那天你用的就是黑色的。
走出店門的時候塑膠袋很輕，輕到你懷疑自己剛才站那麼久是在挑什麼。
回家路上你把筆從袋子裡拿出來，握了一下，又放回去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考前買文具買到有儀式感的時候，也適合送給每次都要挑很久、最後買一樣的那個人。
variations: 短版：「兩支筆長得一模一樣，只有筆蓋顏色不同。」
延伸版：「塑膠袋輕到你懷疑自己剛才站那麼久是在挑什麼。」

en.content:
You stand in the third aisle of the stationery shop for the better part of ten minutes, holding two pens that are identical except for the color of the cap.
You put the blue one back in the end, on the grounds that the one you used the day you finished last year's exam was black.
The plastic bag weighs almost nothing on the way out, light enough that you wonder what exactly you were deliberating over.
Walking home you take the pen out of the bag, hold it for a second, and put it back.
en.editorNote: For the pre-exam stationery run that quietly turns into a ritual, and for the friend who deliberates forever and buys the same thing every time.
variations: Short: "Two pens, identical except for the color of the cap."
Extended: "The bag was light enough to make you wonder what you were deliberating over."

items.sourceNote: 聯合新聞網〈114會考／考生注意！國中會考周末登場規定一次看 這些物品禁入考場〉— 考前一晚整理應試用品的提醒；取把書包倒空重新裝一次的動作改寫

zh-tw.content:
你把書包倒過來抖，掉出來的東西比你想的多：橡皮擦屑、一張皺掉的座位表、半包喉糖。
你一樣一樣分好，該丟的丟掉，剩下的排在桌上，排得很整齊。
排完之後你發現書包空了，空到可以聽見拉鍊在裡面撞的聲音。
你把明天要用的課本一本一本放回去，放到最後一本的時候你停住，想了一下明天要坐哪個位子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考前或開學前一晚整理書包、明明五分鐘的事卻做了一小時的時候。
variations: 短版：「書包空到可以聽見拉鍊在裡面撞的聲音。」
延伸版：「放到最後一本你停住了，想了一下明天要坐哪個位子。」

en.content:
You turn your backpack upside down and shake it, and more falls out than you expected: eraser crumbs, a creased seating chart, half a pack of throat lozenges.
You sort it all into piles, bin what needs binning, and line the rest up on the desk, very neatly.
Once everything's out you notice the bag is empty — empty enough that you can hear the zipper pull knocking around inside it.
You put tomorrow's textbooks back in one at a time, and on the last one you stop and spend a moment wondering where you'll be sitting tomorrow.
en.editorNote: For the night before an exam or the first day of term, when repacking a bag takes an hour instead of five minutes.
variations: Short: "The bag was empty enough to hear the zipper pull knocking around inside."
Extended: "On the last book you stopped, wondering where you'd be sitting tomorrow."

items.sourceNote: 自由時報〈要開學了幾度是發燒？ 疾管署：建議量耳溫、38度就算燒〉— 開學量耳溫與發燒判定標準；取校內量測後躺著休息的畫面改寫

zh-tw.content:
你在保健室的床上躺了二十分鐘，冰枕壓在額頭上，位置被你挪過三次。
護理師量完耳溫，把數字念了出來，三十七度二，再把那張紙夾回板夾。
你翻身面對牆壁，外面有人跑過去，跑了幾步又折回來。
上課鐘響的時候你把冰枕拿下來，用手背碰了一下額頭，又躺回去五分鐘。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考試週跑保健室躺一下、其實也不太確定自己怎麼了的時候。
variations: 短版：「冰枕壓在額頭上，位置被你挪過三次。」
延伸版：「上課鐘響你把冰枕拿下來，用手背碰了一下額頭，又躺回去五分鐘。」

en.content:
You lie on the bed in the school nurse's room for twenty minutes, ice pack on your forehead, moved three times already.
The nurse takes your ear temperature, reads the number out loud, ninety-nine flat, and clips the slip back onto the board.
You roll over to face the wall; someone runs past outside, takes a few steps, and comes back.
When the bell rings you lift the ice pack off, touch your forehead with the back of your hand, and lie down again for five more minutes.
en.editorNote: For the exam week trip to the nurse's room when you're not entirely sure what's wrong with you either.
variations: Short: "Ice pack on your forehead, moved three times already."
Extended: "You lifted the ice pack off, touched your forehead, and lay down again for five more minutes."

items.sourceNote: 聯合新聞網〈同學惡作劇保溫瓶裝熱水波及女學生 家長心疼二級燙傷〉— 校園意外後送保健室處理；取陪同學跑一趟、在門口幫忙拿東西的畫面改寫

zh-tw.content:
隔壁班的同學被送進保健室，你幫他拿著水壺跟外套，站在門邊沒有進去。
你把外套折成四方形，折到第三遍才放到旁邊的椅子上。
裡面傳出量血壓的機器聲，響了很久，你數到二十三下就不數了。
他出來的時候你把水壺遞過去，瓶身全是手汗，你先在褲子上抹了一下。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合陪同學跑一趟保健室、幫忙拿東西站在門口的那種角色。
variations: 短版：「你把外套折成四方形，折到第三遍才放下。」
延伸版：「他出來的時候你把水壺遞過去，瓶身全是手汗。」

en.content:
A kid from the class next door gets walked over to the nurse's room, and you hold his water bottle and jacket, standing by the door without going in.
You fold the jacket into a square, and it takes three goes before you set it down on the chair beside you.
A blood pressure machine hums away inside, going on long enough that you count twenty-three beats and then stop counting.
When he comes out you hand the bottle back; it's slick with your palm sweat, so you wipe it on your pants first.
en.editorNote: For the friend who ends up holding everyone's stuff outside the nurse's room and never goes in.
variations: Short: "You folded the jacket into a square, three goes before you set it down."
Extended: "When he came out you handed the bottle back, slick with your palm sweat."

items.sourceNote: 聯合新聞網〈115會考／地震影響4考場延長作答時間 考生故意毀損試題本、提前離場〉— 會考試場現場規範與座位配置；取入座後整理桌面的動作改寫

zh-tw.content:
監試老師把你的名條貼在桌角，貼歪了一點，你等他走遠才用指甲把邊角壓平。
你把准考證放在右上角，擺正，再往左移一公分，又擺回原來的位置。
鉛筆在桌面上滾了半圈，你伸手接住，把它橫著放在橡皮擦旁邊。
鈴響之前你把手放在膝蓋上，手指在褲縫上敲了六下，然後停住。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合進考場坐定、把桌面東西排來排去的那十分鐘。
variations: 短版：「你等他走遠才用指甲把名條的邊角壓平。」
延伸版：「手指在褲縫上敲了六下，然後停住。」

en.content:
The proctor sticks your name label on the corner of the desk a little crooked, and you wait until he's far enough away to press the edge flat with your thumbnail.
You put your admission ticket in the top right corner, straighten it, slide it half an inch to the left, then move it back where it was.
Your pencil rolls half a turn across the desk, you catch it, and lay it sideways next to the eraser.
Before the bell you rest your hands on your knees and tap the seam of your pants six times, then stop.
en.editorNote: For the ten minutes after you sit down in the exam room and rearrange everything on the desk twice.
variations: Short: "You waited until he was far enough away to press the label flat with your thumbnail."
Extended: "You tapped the seam of your pants six times, then stopped."

items.sourceNote: 中央社〈教育部：學生發燒應在家休息 不列出缺席紀錄〉— 校園健康照護與請假規定；取身體不適仍照常應試、先去拿藥的畫面改寫

zh-tw.content:
早自習的考卷發下來之前，你先去保健室拿了一顆胃藥，藥袋捏在手裡沒放進口袋。
你把水喝掉三分之一，剩下的擺在桌子右邊，瓶蓋轉緊又轉鬆。
考卷傳到你手上時你先把它翻面，用手掌從中間往兩邊推平。
寫到第二頁你停下來，把藥袋從手裡放到抽屜最裡面，動作很輕。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考前腸胃先有反應、但還是照常把考卷寫完的日子。
variations: 短版：「藥袋捏在手裡，沒放進口袋。」
延伸版：「寫到第二頁你停下來，把藥袋放到抽屜最裡面。」

en.content:
Before the morning quiz goes out, you stop by the nurse's room for a stomach tablet, and the packet stays pinched in your hand instead of going into your pocket.
You drink a third of your water and park the rest on the right side of the desk, screwing the cap tight and then loose again.
When the paper reaches you, you turn it face down first and smooth it flat with your palm, middle to edges.
On the second page you stop, move the packet from your hand to the very back of your drawer, very gently.
en.editorNote: For the days your stomach reacts before the exam does, and you sit down and finish the paper anyway.
variations: Short: "The packet stayed pinched in your hand instead of going into your pocket."
Extended: "On the second page you stopped and moved the packet to the very back of your drawer."

items.sourceNote: 聯合新聞網〈整理包／巴威颱風來襲！115分科測驗延至7月13、14日舉行 考場規定、8科衝刺總整理〉— 應試有效證件規定（學生證不算）；取家中白板上把應帶物品與家事寫在一起的畫面改寫

zh-tw.content:
報名最後一天：11月11日（紅筆寫的，媽圈了三次）
還剩幾天：38（這一格被擦掉重寫過兩次）
要帶的東西：身分證（學生證不算）、照片兩張、那張收據
順便一提：你椅子左後腳又鬆了，六角板手在電視櫃下面那格，自己轉緊
最下面一行是我補的：知道了
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合家裡有人幫你盯著日期、順手把家事寫在同一塊白板上的時候。
variations: 短版：「還剩幾天：38（這一格被擦掉重寫過兩次）」
延伸版：「六角板手在電視櫃下面那格，自己轉緊。」

en.content:
Last day to register: November 11 (in red pen, circled three times by Mom)
Days left: 38 (this box has been wiped and rewritten twice)
What to bring: ID card (student ID doesn't count), two photos, that receipt
While I'm at it: the back left leg of your chair is loose again, the hex key is on the lower shelf of the TV cabinet, tighten it yourself
The bottom line is mine: got it
en.editorNote: For when someone at home is keeping track of your dates and adding chores to the same whiteboard.
variations: Short: "Days left: 38 — this box has been wiped and rewritten twice."
Extended: "The hex key is on the lower shelf of the TV cabinet, tighten it yourself."

items.sourceNote: 聯合新聞網〈對申請入學放榜結果不滿意？轉戰115分科測驗還來得及 報名規定、放棄流程全攻略〉— 報名與各種繳費方式的截止時間；取截止前一天手機整天跳提醒的畫面改寫

zh-tw.content:
7:02　繳費截止提醒跳出來，我按掉，繼續睡
12:40　同一則又來一次，標題後面多了一個驚嘆號
