19:15　剩一天，數字變成紅色
21:03　媽在家庭群組問：弄好了沒
21:04　我回：弄好了
23:58　我起床把手機拿去客廳充電，回房間之前又打開系統確認一次
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合截止日前一天，手機整天提醒同一件事、而你其實早就知道的那種焦慮。
variations: 短版：「19:15　剩一天，數字變成紅色。」
延伸版：「21:03 媽問弄好了沒，21:04 我說弄好了，中間那一分鐘我在補資料。」

en.content:
7:02　The payment deadline reminder pops up, I swipe it away and go back to sleep
12:40　The same one lands again, this time with an exclamation mark in the subject line
19:15　One day left, and the number has turned red
21:03　Mom in the family chat: is it done yet
21:04　Me: it's done
23:58　I get up to charge my phone in the living room, and log into the system one more time before going back to bed
en.editorNote: For the day before a deadline, when your phone spends all day reminding you of the one thing you already know.
variations: Short: "19:15 — one day left, and the number has turned red."
Extended: "21:03 Mom asks if it's done; 21:04 I say it's done; the minute in between I spent filling in the form."

items.sourceNote: 聯合新聞網〈115學測／考前必看！重要試務日期出爐 考程安排、歷屆五標、試題一把抓〉— 考前試務時程與倒數；取自己畫倒數格、目標愈改愈小的畫面改寫

zh-tw.content:
牆上那張倒數表是我自己畫的，38格，畫歪了也沒重畫
第38格：叉
第37格：叉
第36格：原本寫「今天讀完第三章」，塗掉，改成「讀到哪算哪」
第35格：空的
第34格：空的，邊邊被我摳破一個洞
右下角那行小字是我媽補的：吃飯
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合倒數表畫得很認真、格子卻愈填愈短的那種進度。
variations: 短版：「第36格：原本寫今天讀完第三章，塗掉，改成讀到哪算哪。」
延伸版：「右下角那行小字是我媽補的：吃飯。」

en.content:
The countdown grid on the wall is one I drew myself, 38 boxes, crooked and never redrawn
Box 38: crossed out
Box 37: crossed out
Box 36: originally "finish chapter three today," scratched out, rewritten as "however far I get"
Box 35: empty
Box 34: empty, with a hole where I picked at the corner
The small line in the bottom right is my mom's: eat something
en.editorNote: For a countdown chart drawn with great seriousness whose entries get shorter every day.
variations: Short: "Box 36: originally 'finish chapter three today,' rewritten as 'however far I get.'"
Extended: "The small line in the bottom right is my mom's: eat something."

items.sourceNote: 聯合新聞網〈115分科測驗落幕 8月3日寄發成績通知單〉— 成績寄發日期；取把日期寫在家具組裝卡背面、和工具一起收在抽屜的畫面改寫

zh-tw.content:
書桌附的那張組裝卡背面是空白的，我拿它來寫日期。
正面印著步驟五和一個扭力數字，背面是我寫的「8月3日，成績單」，字寫得很小。
卡片跟六角板手一起塞在同一個抽屜的深處，翻出來的時候兩樣東西黏在一起。
成績單真的寄到那天，我把卡片翻回正面，才發現步驟五我當初根本沒做。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合等成績那陣子，把日期寫在隨手撿到的紙上、然後假裝忘記的人。
variations: 短版：「背面是我寫的『8月3日，成績單』，字寫得很小。」
延伸版：「成績單寄到那天我把卡片翻回正面，步驟五我當初根本沒做。」

en.content:
The back of the assembly card that came with the desk was blank, so I used it to write down a date.
The front has step five and a torque number printed on it; the back has "August 3, score notice" in my handwriting, very small.
The card lived in the depths of the same drawer as the hex key, and when I dug it out the two were stuck together.
On the day the score notice actually arrived, I turned the card back over and realized I had never done step five.
en.editorNote: For the waiting-on-results stretch, when you write the date on whatever scrap is nearby and then pretend to forget it.
variations: Short: "The back had 'August 3, score notice' in my handwriting, very small."
Extended: "The day the notice arrived I turned the card over and saw I had never done step five."

items.sourceNote: 懷舊文具報導：削鉛筆機曾是書桌必備，改寫為同一台機器在兩個時期的狀態差

zh-tw.content:
書桌邊夾著的那台削鉛筆機，國二那年天天轉，屑盒兩天就要倒一次。
筆袋裡換成自動筆之後，它還卡在桌沿，手把轉起來會空轉半圈。
分科測驗要用2B鉛筆，我把它拆下來沖水，倒出來的木屑還是舊的那一批。
削完兩支筆，屑盒底下露出一張紙條，是我國二寫的課表。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合為了考試把塵封的舊文具翻出來用的那種時刻。
variations: 短版：「它還卡在桌沿，手把轉起來會空轉半圈。」
延伸版：「倒出來的木屑還是舊的那一批，屑盒底下還壓著我國二寫的課表。」

en.content:
The pencil sharpener clamped to the edge of my desk got cranked every day in eighth grade, and the shavings bin had to be emptied twice a week.
After my pencil case filled up with mechanical pencils, it stayed clamped there, the handle spinning half a turn on nothing.
The subject exam needs 2B pencils, so I took it off and rinsed it out, and the shavings that fell out were still the old batch.
Once I had sharpened two pencils, a slip of paper showed up under the bin, a class schedule I wrote in eighth grade.
en.editorNote: For when an exam makes you dig out a piece of stationery you had stopped using.
variations: Short: "It stayed clamped to the desk, the handle spinning half a turn on nothing."
Extended: "The shavings that fell out were still the old batch, with a class schedule pressed under the bin."

items.sourceNote: 分科測驗落幕考生心情報導，改寫為補習班共用文具在考前考後的狀態差

zh-tw.content:
補習班窗邊那台削鉛筆機是共用的，去年冬天我一次削四支，削完排在桌上像柵欄。
它轉到一半會卡，大家都知道要往回轉半圈再繼續，沒有人講過這件事。
考完那天我又去轉了一支，卡住的位置變了，往回轉半圈沒有用。
那支筆我沒帶走，留在筆筒裡，筆尖削得比誰都尖。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在補習班待到最後一天、離開時留下一點東西的心情。
variations: 短版：「大家都知道要往回轉半圈再繼續，沒有人講過這件事。」
延伸版：「考完那天卡住的位置變了，那支筆我留在筆筒裡，筆尖削得比誰都尖。」

en.content:
The sharpener by the window at cram school was shared, and last winter I would do four pencils at once and line them up on the desk like a fence.
It jams halfway through, and everybody knows to crank it back half a turn before going on, and nobody has ever said so out loud.
On the day the exam ended I ran one more pencil through it, the jam had moved, and cranking back half a turn did nothing.
I left that pencil behind in the pen cup, sharpened to a finer point than anyone else's.
en.editorNote: For the last day at cram school, when you leave something small behind on purpose.
variations: Short: "Everybody knows to crank it back half a turn before going on, and nobody has ever said so out loud."
Extended: "The day the exam ended the jam had moved, and I left that pencil in the pen cup, sharpened finer than anyone else's."

items.sourceNote: 過來人回看志願與備考歷程的報導，改寫為一本總複習講義從新到舊的痕跡

zh-tw.content:
那本數學總複習剛買的那天，我用月曆紙包了書套，邊角折得很整齊。
翻到第三章，書套從書背裂開一條縫，我黏了兩次膠帶就放棄。
考完隔天整理書架，前半本捲得像被水泡過，最後三分之一還是新的。
我把書套拆下來攤平，月曆那面朝上，印的是去年十月。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考完整理書桌、發現自己讀到哪裡就停了的時候。
variations: 短版：「前半本捲得像被水泡過，最後三分之一還是新的。」
延伸版：「我把書套拆下來攤平，月曆那面朝上，印的是去年十月。」

en.content:
When I brought that math review book home, I wrapped it in a page from an old calendar, with the corners folded neatly.
By chapter three the wrapper had split along the spine, and after taping it twice I gave up.
Clearing the shelf the day after the exam, the first half was curled like it had been soaked, and the last third was still new.
I peeled the wrapper off and flattened it out, calendar side up, printed with last October.
en.editorNote: For clearing your desk after the exam and seeing exactly where you stopped.
variations: Short: "The first half was curled like it had been soaked, and the last third was still new."
Extended: "I peeled the wrapper off and flattened it out, calendar side up, printed with last October."

items.sourceNote: 重考生人數創新高的報導，改寫為一顆橡皮擦被用了一整年的狀態差

zh-tw.content:
新橡皮擦拆開那天，我在紙套上用原子筆寫了名字，寫得很用力。
模擬考擦掉太多題，它被磨成一個斜的形狀，握起來剛好卡在虎口。
分發結果出來那天，我在筆袋角落把它翻出來，只剩下拇指指甲那麼大。
紙套還套在上面，名字磨掉了兩個字，剩下那一個我看了很久。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合等分發結果那幾天，翻筆袋翻到用了一整年的東西。
variations: 短版：「它被磨成一個斜的形狀，握起來剛好卡在虎口。」
延伸版：「紙套還套在上面，名字磨掉了兩個字，剩下那一個我看了很久。」

en.content:
The day I unwrapped the new eraser I wrote my name on the paper sleeve in ballpoint, pressing hard.
Too many rubbed-out answers on mock exams wore it into a slanted shape that sat right in the web of my thumb.
On the day placement results came out I dug it out of the corner of my pencil case, down to the size of a thumbnail.
The sleeve was still on it, two characters of my name rubbed away, and I looked at the one that was left for a long time.
en.editorNote: For the days waiting on placement results, when your pencil case turns up something you used all year.
variations: Short: "It wore into a slanted shape that sat right in the web of my thumb."
Extended: "The sleeve was still on it, two characters of my name rubbed away, and I looked at the one left for a long time."

items.sourceNote: 分科測驗落幕、等寄成績通知單的報導，改寫為考前夜裡隔壁傳來的練習聲

zh-tw.content:
隔壁房間的小號一個晚上停了十四次。
後來聲音突然變得很悶，他把弱音器塞進了喇叭口。
我的數學講義還停在同一頁，鉛筆在空白處畫滿了小格子。
悶掉的音一直吹到兩點，我摘下耳機，發現自己在等下一個音。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考前熬夜那幾天，書讀不進去，卻靠別人的聲音撐在桌前。
variations: 短版：「他把弱音器塞進了喇叭口，聲音突然變得很悶。」
延伸版：「我摘下耳機，發現自己在等下一個音。」

en.content:
The trumpet in the next room stopped fourteen times in one night.
Then the sound went suddenly muffled; he had pushed a mute into the bell.
My math workbook was still open to the same page, the margin filled with little penciled squares.
The muffled notes went on until two, and when I took my earphones off I found I was waiting for the next one.
en.editorNote: For the late nights before an exam, when nothing goes in and someone else's noise is what keeps you at the desk.
variations: Short: "He pushed a mute into the bell and the sound went suddenly muffled."
Extended: "I took my earphones off and found I was waiting for the next note."

items.sourceNote: 台大資工分發分數大降的報導，改寫為備考期間被收進櫃子的樂器

zh-tw.content:
琴袋外袋裡有兩個弱音器，一個橡膠的，一個金屬的。
橡膠那個是老師規定晚上練習要夾上去的，金屬那個買來就沒用過。
模擬考開始密集之後我把琴收進櫃子，兩個都留在外袋裡滾來滾去。
昨天拉開拉鍊，金屬的邊緣起了一點鏽，橡膠的上面積了一層灰。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考完回頭看被擱著的興趣，東西都還在，只是變舊了。
variations: 短版：「兩個都留在外袋裡滾來滾去。」
延伸版：「金屬的邊緣起了一點鏽，橡膠的上面積了一層灰。」

en.content:
There are two mutes in the outer pocket of my violin case, one rubber and one metal.
The rubber one my teacher requires for evening practice; the metal one has gone unused since the day I bought it.
Once the mock exams got dense I put the violin away in the cupboard and left both of them rolling around in that pocket.
I opened the zipper yesterday: the metal one has rusted a little at the edge, and the rubber one has collected a layer of dust.
en.editorNote: For looking back at a hobby you set down for exams — all of it still there, just older.
variations: Short: "Both of them were left rolling around in that pocket."
Extended: "The metal one has rusted a little at the edge, and the rubber one has collected a layer of dust."

items.sourceNote: 分科測驗成績開放查詢的報導，改寫為考場裡對著准考證做的小動作

zh-tw.content:
准考證上的照片被我剪掉了半公分，才塞得進透明夾。
監考老師走過來把夾子翻正，說照片要朝上，我點了兩下頭。
收卷之後夾角被指甲摳出一排白色月牙，我一個也沒有壓回去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考場裡手沒地方放、只好一直摳東西的那種緊張。
variations: 短版：「監考老師把夾子翻正，說照片要朝上。」
延伸版：「夾角被指甲摳出一排白色月牙，我一個也沒有壓回去。」

en.content:
I trimmed half a centimeter off the photo on my admission slip to get it into the clear sleeve.
The proctor came over, turned the sleeve the right way up, said the photo faces out, and I nodded twice.
After the papers were collected the corner had a row of white crescents dug in by my thumbnail, and I did not press a single one back down.
en.editorNote: For the kind of nerves where your hands have nowhere to go, so they pick at whatever is on the desk.
variations: Short: "The proctor turned the sleeve the right way up and said the photo faces out."
Extended: "A row of white crescents dug in by my thumbnail, and I pressed not one of them back down."

items.sourceNote: 大學分發入學錄取率的報導，改寫為交卷之後才想起沒用到的備用筆

zh-tw.content:
作文的格子紙我用掉了三張半。
最後那半張只寫了兩行。
剩下的空格白得發亮。
交卷時手指壓在紙的下緣，壓出一道摺痕。
走出校門才想起來，筆袋裡還有一支沒拆封的備用筆。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫不完又不想承認的那種收尾，事後才看見自己漏掉什麼。
variations: 短版：「最後那半張只寫了兩行。」
延伸版：「走出校門才想起來，筆袋裡還有一支沒拆封的備用筆。」

en.content:
I used up three and a half sheets of grid paper on the essay.
The last half sheet had only two lines on it.
The empty squares were bright white.
Handing it in, my fingers pressed the bottom edge into a crease.
Only outside the school gate did I remember the spare pen still sealed in my pencil case.
en.editorNote: For the kind of finish where you didn't get it done and won't say so, and only notice later what you missed.
variations: Short: "The last half sheet had only two lines on it."
Extended: "Only outside the school gate did I remember the spare pen still sealed in my pencil case."

items.sourceNote: 驗光流程與瞳距測量的科普文，改寫為放榜後去配眼鏡那天的一場雨

zh-tw.content:
雨是在我走進眼鏡行的那一刻打下來的。
成績單摺成四折，塞在外套口袋裡。
師傅把瞳距尺橫過來，抵著我的鼻梁量。
玻璃門外的水痕一條接一條往下跑，我盯著看。
他說別動，我就沒有動。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合放榜那幾天發的貼文，只寫天氣和手上的動作，不解釋自己在想什麼。
variations: 短版：「雨是在我走進眼鏡行的那一刻打下來的。」
延伸版：「他說別動，我就沒有動，直到雨聲小下去。」

en.content:
The rain came down the exact moment I walked into the optical shop.
My score report was folded in four, shoved in my jacket pocket.
The optician turned the pupil-distance ruler flat and held it against my nose bridge.
Outside the glass door the water drew one streak after another downward, and I watched.
He said hold still, so I held still.
en.editorNote: For the days around results coming out: only the weather and what your hands are doing, never what you are thinking.
variations: Short: "The rain came down the exact moment I walked into the optical shop."
Extended: "He said hold still, so I held still, until the rain went quiet."

items.sourceNote: 驗光單上 PD 瞳距欄位的說明文章，改寫為考完隔天去驗光遇上晨霧

zh-tw.content:
清晨的霧把對面那排路樹吃掉一半。
我把考卷背面朝上塞進書包，走去驗光。
瞳距尺架到眼睛前面的時候是涼的。
師傅唸出兩個數字，中間停了一下。
回程霧散了，路樹一棵一棵長回來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考完不想討論分數的時候，把注意力整個放到別的東西上。
variations: 短版：「清晨的霧把對面那排路樹吃掉一半。」
延伸版：「回程霧散了，路樹一棵一棵長回來。」

en.content:
Morning fog had eaten half the row of street trees across the road.
I slid my exam paper into my backpack face-down and headed out for an eye test.
The pupil-distance ruler was cold when it came up in front of my eyes.
The optician read out two numbers, with a pause in the middle.
On the way home the fog thinned and the trees grew back one at a time.
en.editorNote: For when the exam is done and you would rather not talk about the score, so you park your attention somewhere else.
variations: Short: "Morning fog had eaten half the row of street trees across the road."
Extended: "On the way home the fog thinned and the trees grew back one at a time."

items.sourceNote: 考前壓力調適的六個技巧，改寫為放榜當天在大太陽下走來走去

zh-tw.content:
正午的太陽把柏油曬出一層晃動的空氣。
放榜那天我沿著人行道走了三站的距離才停。
手機拿出來又放回口袋，來回四次。
路邊只有一小塊樹影，我站進去。
影子往東邊移，我跟著挪腳。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合等成績的那幾個小時，什麼都做不了，只能一直走路。
variations: 短版：「路邊只有一小塊樹影，我站進去。」
延伸版：「影子往東邊移，我跟著挪腳，太陽一直沒有偏。」

en.content:
At noon the sun cooked a shimmering layer of air off the asphalt.
On results day I followed the sidewalk for three stops' worth of road before stopping.
Phone out of my pocket, back in my pocket, four times around.
There was one small patch of tree shade at the curb, and I stepped into it.
The shade slid east, and I shuffled my feet after it.
en.editorNote: For the few hours of waiting on a result, when there is nothing left to do but keep walking.
variations: Short: "There was one small patch of tree shade at the curb, and I stepped into it."
Extended: "The shade slid east, and I shuffled my feet after it; the sun never budged."

items.sourceNote: 學生輔導中心談考試焦慮的三種類型，改寫為讀不完的那晚一直灌進來的風

zh-tw.content:
風從走廊那頭灌進來，把攤在桌上的講義掀了三頁。
我用手肘壓住，另一隻手繼續寫。
窗戶關到剩一道縫，聲音就變成細細的哨音。
筆記本的邊角被吹得翹起來，我沒有壓回去。
天黑之前，風停了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考前一直讀不完的那種傍晚，寫天氣就好，別寫自己有多急。
variations: 短版：「窗戶關到剩一道縫，聲音就變成細細的哨音。」
延伸版：「筆記本的邊角被吹得翹起來，我沒有壓回去。」

en.content:
Wind funneled in from the far end of the hallway and flipped three pages of the handout spread on my desk.
I pinned it down with an elbow and kept writing with my other hand.
I shut the window to a single gap, and the sound turned into a thin whistle.
The corner of my notebook curled up in the draft, and I left it alone.
Before dark, the wind stopped.
en.editorNote: For an evening of studying that will not end: write the weather, not how much of a hurry you are in.
variations: Short: "I shut the window to a single gap, and the sound turned into a thin whistle."
Extended: "The corner of my notebook curled up in the draft, and I left it alone."
